Maintain strong customer satisfaction by ensuring timely and effective support.

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for escalations and complex problem\-solving.

Shift \& Work Flexibility

Comfortable with a hybrid working model, with flexibility to operate from KTP or ECP depending on organizational requirements.

Required Qualifications

Graduate, preferably BCA or equivalent technical background.

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in technical support or IT helpdesk roles.

Strong understanding of computer hardware, OS concepts, system configurations, and troubleshooting methods.

Good English communication skills, both verbal and written.

Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced support environment.

Knowledge of basic networking (LAN, Wi\-Fi, IP configuration)

Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset

 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.

 Genesys is looking for an experienced Salesforce Support technical resource with expertise in supporting Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud applications. This is a fast\-paced and highly collaborative environment requiring strong technical troubleshooting, customer support, and operational skills.
   

  

 The role will focus on providing production support, maintaining system stability, supporting business users globally, and collaborating with development teams to support ongoing application enhancements and operational excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Provide production support and administration for Salesforce CRM applications and related integrations.
   

  

 Troubleshoot and resolve application, data, and user issues in a timely manner.
   

  

 Configure and maintain Salesforce users, roles, profiles, security, workflows, reports, dashboards, and customizations.
   

  

 Support data management activities including data imports, validation, and integrity monitoring.
   

  

 Debug issues related to Apex, Flows, Workflows, integrations, and automation components.

 Create and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
   

  

 Support AI\-enabled operational workflows and automation initiatives where applicable.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
 6\+ years of experience in Salesforce Administration, Application Support, or Production Support.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Revenue Cloud.
   

  

 Good understanding of Salesforce security model, users, roles, profiles, sharing rules, and data management.
   

  

 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Experience with SOQL, Data Loader, Apex debugging, Flows, and Workflows.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Salesforce reports, dashboards, and CRM processes.
   

  

 Experience with integrations, REST/SOAP APIs, and enterprise applications.
   

  

 Strong communication, customer support, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Good understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management) Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced support environment. Experience or exposure to Agentic AI, AI\-driven automation, copilots, or AI\-assisted operational workflows is desirable.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The Product Support Specialist provides customer service and technical support to users of Thomson Reuters Legal Tracker, helping resolve product and system\-related issues. The role involves troubleshooting, guiding users on product features, collaborating with internal teams on complex cases, and ensuring a positive customer experience. Strong communication, problem\-solving, and customer support skills are essential, while familiarity with legal technology and CRM tools is a plus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Respond to customer inquiries via phone and e\-mail, providing timely and accurate solutions to product\-related questions and technical issues.
* Guide users through product features, functionalities, and troubleshooting steps for various legal software and platforms.
* Document customer interactions, issues, and resolutions accurately in the CRM system.
* Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., product development, sales) to escalate complex issues and provide customer feedback.
* Stay up\-to\-date with product updates, new features, and changes in legal practices relevant to Thomson Reuters offerings.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer satisfaction in all interactions.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to knowledge base articles.
* Work Mode: Hybrid (2\-3 days work from office is mandatory every week).
* Shift Timing: 3:30am IST to 12:30pm IST.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 2\-4 years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience in a Call Center, Customer Service, or Technical Support environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high\-quality support.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Proficiency in CRM software and customer support tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with legal practices, legal operations, or legal terminology.
* Prior experience supporting SaaS or enterprise software applications.
* Experience providing technical support via phone, email, or ticketing systems.
* Knowledge of Thomson Reuters Legal Tracker or similar legal/e\-billing platforms.
* Experience creating knowledge base articles or contributing to process improvements.
* Exposure to cross\-functional collaboration with Product, Sales, or Development teams.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real\-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
   

  

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace.
   

  

 We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job description:**

Job Overview:  
We are seeking a skilled Windows and Network System Administrator with expertise in VMware technologies to manage our Windows\-based infrastructure, virtualized environments, and network systems at Rhinexa India Pvt. Ltd. This role focuses on administering Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, VMware virtualization, basic networking, and antivirus solutions while handling day\-to\-day system administration tasks. The ideal candidate will excel in communication and problem\-solving to support users and maintain seamless operations.

Key Responsibilities:

* Administer Windows Server environments (e.g., Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\), including installation, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Active Directory services, including user/group management, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), domain controllers, and LDAP integration for secure access control.
* Oversee Microsoft Exchange Server or Microsoft 365 Exchange Online, managing email configurations, mailbox policies, spam filtering, and high availability.
* Deploy and manage VMware virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter), including virtual machine creation, resource allocation, and performance optimization.
* Monitor and maintain network infrastructure, including routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall configurations to ensure connectivity and security.
* Implement and manage antivirus and endpoint protection solutions (e.g., Microsoft Defender, TrendMicro, Kaspersky) to detect and mitigate security threats.
* Handle day\-to\-day system administration tasks, such as user account provisioning, hardware/software troubleshooting, backups, restores, and system performance tuning.
* Perform VMware\-related tasks, including vMotion, DRS, HA configurations, and integration with Windows and network environments.
* Provide technical support to end\-users via ticketing systems, remote assistance, or on\-site help, communicating solutions clearly and effectively.
* Collaborate with IT teams on system upgrades, migrations (e.g., to Azure AD, hybrid cloud, or VMware\-based solutions), and maintain detailed documentation.
* Conduct system audits, vulnerability assessments, and compliance checks to align with Rhinexa’s cybersecurity and operational standards.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in system administration, with strong expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, and VMware technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows technologies, including Active Directory (AD DS, AD FS), Group Policies, and PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Proficiency in VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter, including VM management, clustering, and storage configurations (e.g., vSAN).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Exchange administration, including hybrid setups, DAGs (Database Availability Groups), and Outlook/OWA integration.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and tools for monitoring network performance.
* Experience with antivirus/EDR solutions and best practices for malware protection and incident response.
* Certifications such as Microsoft MCSA/MCSE, VMware VCP\-DCV, or CompTIA Network\+ are highly preferred.
* Excellent communication skills to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users and document procedures clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to manage complex, day\-to\-day IT challenges independently or collaboratively.

Preferred Skills:

* Knowledge of backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, VMware vSphere Data Protection) and disaster recovery planning.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating Windows and VMware tasks.

* Night Shift (Preferred)

 TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no\-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission\-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate\-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi\-enterprise processes at global scale.
   

  

 Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi\-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
   

  

 Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Workday Analyst combines hands\-on Workday configuration expertise with technical build skills to support and evolve the organization's Workday HCM platform. This role partners with HR and cross\-functional business stakeholders to gather requirements, configure and test system changes, and support integrations, reports, and calculated fields. The Analyst plays a key role in bi\-annual release management, day\-to\-day system support, data integrity, and delivery of HR technology projects, reporting directly to the Manager, HR Technology.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Partner with HR and business stakeholders to gather requirements, re\-design current processes, and configure new functionality to support growing business operations.
* Assist with ongoing Workday projects including application testing, implementation, enhancements/upgrades, report writing, and new functionality investigation and deployment.
* Diagnose and resolve end\-user, business process, and security issues; provide day\-to\-day support to HR and other Workday end\-users.
* Develop and maintain documentation of Workday business processes, configuration decisions, and support procedures.
* Perform routine audits for system data validation and integrity, and partner with key stakeholders to make necessary corrections.
* Assist with special projects and annual initiatives such as Open Enrollment, compensation review cycle, performance reviews, and year\-end processing.

* Support Workday security architecture, including domain and business process security policies, role\-based security groups, and periodic access reviews.
* Monitor integration event logs and resolve errors.

* Serve as a subject\-matter resource on Workday capabilities, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Support change management activities, including test scripts, training materials, and end\-user communications.


**Qualifications**

* Strong and effective written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to collaborate with team members and business stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

title: Expert Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Technical Support Engineer**
==============================

**Position Summary**
--------------------


We are seeking a skilled Technical Support Engineer to act as the critical link between Level 2 Support and Development teams. The role involves investigating, diagnosing, and resolving complex technical escalations across enterprise healthcare applications and secure messaging solutions.


The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Windows Server environments, SQL Server, HL7 interfaces, and application troubleshooting. This role requires excellent analytical skills, root cause analysis capabilities, and experience managing escalations through to resolution while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Infrastructure \& Database Support**

* Troubleshoot issues within Windows Server environments.
* Utilize PowerShell for connectivity validation, service management, process monitoring, and system diagnostics.
* Manage certificates, security configurations, and Event Viewer analysis.
* Interpret and troubleshoot SQL Server and ODBC\-related errors.
* Monitor, execute, and support SQL Agent jobs.
* Perform SQL\-based troubleshooting and data integrity validations.

### **Application \& Integration Support**

* Trace and troubleshoot HL7 message flows and interface\-related issues.
* Investigate message queue backlogs and integration failures.
* Support secure messaging solutions and endpoint connectivity.
* Troubleshoot IIS, ASP.NET, and application\-layer issues.
* Review application configurations and identify root causes across the technology stack.

### **Escalation Management**

* Reproduce issues in test and production environments.
* Analyze and classify defects based on severity, frequency, and software versions.
* Gather diagnostic evidence including application logs, SQL traces, network traces, and user recordings.
* Document findings, workarounds, root cause hypotheses, and reproduction steps.
* Coordinate escalations between Support, Engineering, and Development teams.
* Manage incidents through ITSM platforms and track PRBs and defect tickets.

### **Documentation \& Client Communication**

* Communicate technical findings effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Create and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles.
* Provide detailed troubleshooting documentation and escalation summaries.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

### **Operating Systems \& Infrastructure**

* Windows Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Services
* Event Viewer
* Certificate Management
* Citrix and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)

### **Web \& Application Technologies**

* IIS
* ASP.NET / .NET Framework
* Application Configuration Management
* Stack Trace Analysis
* Authentication and Security Tokens

### **Database Technologies**

* Microsoft SQL Server
* SQL Agent Jobs
* ODBC
* SQL Extended Events
* SQL Troubleshooting and Query Development

### **Integration Technologies**

* HL7
* Enterprise Interface Engines
* Secure Messaging Solutions
* Identity \& Access Management Systems
* EHR Integrations

### **Networking**

* TCP/IP
* DNS
* Firewalls
* Network Ports
* PKI and Certificate Management

### **Tools \& Platforms**

* Azure DevOps
* GitHub
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
* Log Analysis and Diagnostic Tools
* AI\-enabled troubleshooting and automation tools

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Browser Developer Tools
* Fiddler
* Wireshark
* Linux
* Docker
* Container Technologies
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)

**Preferred Domain Experience**
-------------------------------


Experience within Healthcare IT environments is highly desirable, including knowledge of:

* HL7 Workflows
* ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer)
* Patient Matching
* EHR Systems
* EDMS/DMR Platforms
* Clinical Workflows and Healthcare Integrations

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Environment isolation and issue reproduction
* Escalation and incident management
* Defect classification and release mapping
* Strong customer communication skills
* Technical documentation and knowledge management
* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

title: Senior IT Administrator (Global)
description:
Role: Senior IT Administrator (Global)  

  

About Us:  

  

AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend\-to\-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence  

accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that  

organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business  

decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows  

to read, understand, and make real\-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading  

to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises,  

including one\-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen's invoice, expense, and card transaction  

solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their  

businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com.  

  

About the Role:  

  

As a Senior IT Administrator (Global), you will work closely with the rest of our team to ensure  

that our company is using the most up\-to\-date technology to run our business. We are seeking  

a hands\-on IT administrator who will own the day\-to\-day reliability, security, and scalability of  

our hardware, software, and internal network, while directly supporting our staff across global  

offices.  

  

Roles and Responsibilities:  

  

* Administer, maintain, and support the company's IT infrastructure (network, endpoints,


servers, cloud accounts) across global offices.  

* Manage day\-to\-day IT operations, ensuring 24x7 availability and reliability of systems


and services.  

* Own the user onboarding and offboarding process, including access provisioning and


deprovisioning across systems.  

* Administer SaaS applications — user provisioning, license tracking, and renewal


coordination.  

* Execute the IT asset life cycle end\-to\-end: procurement, deployment, tracking, and


secure disposal.  

* Monitor systems and infrastructure proactively; troubleshoot, resolve, and escalate


incidents within SLA.  

* Support the CISO/security function on day\-to\-day compliance tasks, security tooling


configuration, and audit evidence gathering.  

* Identify repetitive manual tasks and build automation (Shell/Python scripting, API


integrations) to streamline IT operations.  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support integration projects and resolve


tooling gaps.  

* Maintain and enforce existing IT policies and procedures; flag gaps for review.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery execution — testing, documentation,


and runbook upkeep.  

* Act as the escalation point for Tier 2/3 technical support and helpdesk operations.


Senior IT Administrator (Global) \| Confidential  

AppZen – Senior IT Administrator (Global) JD  

* Document processes, configurations, and runbooks to build team knowledge and reduce


single points of failure.  

* Coordinate with vendors on day\-to\-day support tickets, renewals, and issue resolution.
* Mentor junior IT staff and interns on troubleshooting approach and best practices.
* Track IT performance metrics (uptime, ticket resolution time, SLA adherence) and report


on trends.  

  

Experience and Qualifications:  

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 2\-6 years of hands\-on experience administering IT infrastructure and operations;


experience in a global, multi\-office, or distributed\-team environment preferred.  

* Strong working knowledge of network administration, endpoint management, and SaaS


application administration.  

* Practical experience with automation/scripting (Shell, Python) to streamline recurring IT


tasks.  

* Comfortable working in a startup/scale\-up environment. This role will require occasional


overlap with US/UK time zones.  

* Working knowledge of ITIL\-aligned support processes (incident, change, and problem


management).  

* Hands\-on experience integrating applications via APIs.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to support end users and collaborate across


cross\-functional teams.  

* Prior experience mentoring junior team members or interns is a plus.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and tickets simultaneously.


Technologies:  

* Hardware: Cisco Meraki Network Infra, Apple Devices, Windows, IoT thin clients, AV


Equipment, Printers  

* Operating Systems: MacOS, Windows, iOS, and Linux
* Platforms \& Tools: Google Suite, JumpCloud or similar, Jira, OpsGenie, Bitbucket,


Confluence, Jenkins, Zoom Admin, Slack Admin, AWS EC2 and S3, MySQL or  

PostgreSQL, GitHub, Postman, working knowledge of using and integrating APIs, ITIL  

methodology, Shell and Python scripting, etc.  

  

Please share your updated resume on: \[email protected]
We may use artificial intelligence tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.

title: IT systems administrator for Atlassian and endpoint management
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
   

  

 As a System Administrator within .Monks, you will be responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and ongoing operation of computer systems and cloud platforms. Working as part of the SysOps IT team, your observations and input will help drive the evolution of tech administration within our company as we look to establish stronger policies, more security, better organization, and enhanced efficiency. As the IT, and especially AI, needs of the company continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to learn new technologies and propose projects. Automating IT tasks will be a focus.
   

  

 This role is well\-suited for those who are self\-sufficient, dependable, looking for new challenges, and are interested in expanding their skillset.
   

  

 This is a primarily remote role, with infrequent, pre\-arranged onsite tasks at our Noida or Gurugram offices.
   

  

**Responsibilities Will Include**
 Atlassian Platform Stewardship
   

  

  

* Operational Oversight: Serve as the primary administrator for the Atlassian Organization.
* System Hygiene \& Cleanup: Lead regular "environmental audits" to identify and archive stale projects, unused custom fields, and redundant schemes. You will ensure that Jira remains performant and easy to navigate for all users.
* Tempo Administration: Manage Tempo configurations, including worklog attributes, period locking, and team structures to ensure accurate time tracking and reporting.
* Financial Optimization: Take a lead role in Atlassian license renewals. Monitor seat utilization, identify inactive accounts, and optimize tiering to ensure we are only paying for what we use.
* Platform Awareness: Stay ahead of Atlassian’s rapid release cycle. Be the first to know about upcoming changes, assess their impact on our apps, and communicate updates to the business.


 Regional SaaS \& MDM Escalation
   

  

  

* Regional Support: Act as the primary escalation path during local office hours for tools managed by the global team (including Slack, Google Workspace, Jamf, and Intune).
* Tier 2/3 Resolution: Resolve complex technical issues that standard IT support cannot handle, ensuring seamless operation for the local team before the global admins come online.


 ISO 27001 Compliance \& Audit
   

  

  

* Audit Readiness: Help prepare the IT environment for ISO 27001 audits by maintaining strict access controls and change management records.
* Evidence Collection: Be an active participant in audit interviews, providing "point\-in\-time" evidence such as access logs, termination of access reports, and proof of system patching.


**Background Sought**
**Technical Background Sought:**
* Cloud\-Based Business Platform Administration: Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, Microsoft365/Azure and Atlassian Org Administration.
* OS: Windows server, Linux.
* Networking Hardware: Fortinet, Ubiquiti.
* Identity \& Endpoint Management: OneLogin, Jamf, Intune, and A1\.
* Bonus points for experience with automation or APIs.
* Familiarity with at least one scripting language.


**General Requirements**
* Typically 2–5\+ years in systems administration or a similar operational role.
* Experience running audits/reports and presenting findings.
* Flexibility in working hours.
* Exhibits patience and resilience under pressure.
* Detail\-oriented and strong organizational skills.
* Strong verbal \& written communication skills.
* Self\-sufficient, proactive, and ready for a challenge.
* Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities.


**About Monks**
 Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.
   

  

 Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023\) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

title: IT Support Engineer I
description:
**About NCR Atleos**


NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**


Act as the technical and process expert for the IT Help Desk function, supporting analysts with complex incidents, service requests, escalations, and process clarifications. Provide advanced Level 1 / Level 1\.5 support for desktop, laptop, operating system, Office 365, browser, printer, network connectivity, remote access, and standard enterprise application issues. Review escalated tickets to ensure correct troubleshooting, accurate categorization, proper documentation, and appropriate routing to Level 2 or resolver groups. Drive first contact resolution improvement by identifying recurring issues, creating troubleshooting guidance, and mentoring analysts on effective resolution steps. Maintain and improve Knowledge Base articles, SOPs, process documents, call scripts, and troubleshooting guides. Monitor ticket quality, adherence to process, SLA compliance, aged tickets, and critical priority incidents; follow up with analysts and resolver teams as required. Support new hire training, refresher training, floor support, and coaching for Help Desk Analysts. Identify process gaps, tool issues, knowledge gaps, and recurring incident trends; recommend corrective and preventive actions. Participate in major incident support, outage communication, and bridge calls as required. Works in 24x7 rotational shift environment.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**


Strong knowledge of Windows 11 and above operating systems, including troubleshooting user profiles, device performance, drivers, updates, and common OS errors. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, browsers, VPN, remote access tools, and internet technologies. Good understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/Wi\-Fi connectivity, proxy, and basic network troubleshooting. Ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, printer, access, authentication, and end\-user productivity issues. Experience using ITSM tools for ticket logging, categorization, prioritization, escalation, SLA tracking, and reporting. Ability to analyze incident trends and translate them into knowledge articles, coaching points, and process improvements. Working knowledge of ITIL concepts such as incident management, request fulfillment, escalation management, and knowledge management.

**EDUCATION \& WORK HISTORY:**


Minimum qualification: Technical diploma or graduate degree. Minimum 4\-6 years of experience in IT Help Desk, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or technical support operations. Prior experience as a senior analyst, floor support, quality analyst, trainer, technical lead or SME in a voice\-based technical support environment is preferred. Experience in a 24x7 support model is preferred.

**COMMUNICATION SKILLS:**


Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical users. Strong listening, probing, and questioning skills to identify root cause quickly. Ability to provide constructive feedback, coaching, and guidance to analysts. Professional communication style for emails, escalations, outage updates, and stakeholder interactions.

**OTHER ESSENTIAL SKILLS:**


Strong customer service orientation with patience, empathy, ownership, and a positive attitude. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills. Ability to work independently and support team members during high\-volume or critical situations. Strong attention to detail in ticket documentation, process adherence, and knowledge updates. Ability to manage multiple priorities, follow up on pending actions, and meet operational deadlines. Flexible to work rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as required by business operations.


Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

title: Senior Technical Support Analyst- L1
description:
**Netradyne** 
 harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern\-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward\-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
   

  

**Job Overview:**
 Senior Engineer Technical Support acts as a key First‑level(L1\) liaison between Netradyne and our customers. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues reported by customers while collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure timely and effective resolutions. You will directly engage with customers to troubleshoot in‑field hardware and software issues related to Netradyne’s connected vehicle platforms. This position plays a critical role in ensuring customer success by providing prompt and accurate resolutions to customer‑reported issues and service requests. The ideal candidate will have strong English communication skills, excellent customer‑relationship abilities, and prior experience supporting international customers (US or UK preferred). As a 24x7x365 operations center, we require candidates who are flexible to work in any shift based on business needs, including weekends (Saturday and/or Sunday)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Troubleshoot and resolve customer\-reported issues via Teams Meeting, Calls, chat, and remote tools.
* Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to resolve technical challenges.
* Work with engineers, support rotations, including incident escalation handling.
* Maintain proper case documentation and timely follow\-ups with customers.
* Escalate unresolved or critical issues with supporting technical details.


**Mandatory Skills:**
* 3\-6 years of technical support experience, preferably with SaaS or cloud\-based platforms.
* Good experience in Incident management Process.
* Basic SQL knowledge and working experience with one or more databases (Postgres, MySQL, etc.).
* Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, JIRA, or Salesforce).
* Good hands\-on experience with REST APIs and webhooks.
* Experience in analyzing, investigating, and identifying the root cause of complex customer issues, and communicating findings to the relevant group for resolution.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work in shifts and under pressure.
* Proven ability to collaborate in a dynamic, fast\-paced team environment. The candidate should also contribute positively to team culture and foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace.


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Exposure to cloud technologies (Microservices).
* Experience with at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Shell).
* Familiarity with monitoring tools and incident management processes.
* Understanding of network protocols, system\-level troubleshooting.
* Awareness of AI/ML concepts and their application is a plus.


**Qualifications And Education Requirements**
* A bachelor's degree in a tech\-related field \- B.E. / BTech / MCA


 We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.
   

  

 If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.
   

  

 Netradyne is an equal\-opportunity employer.
   

  

**Applicants only \- Recruiting agencies do not contact.**
**Recruitment Fraud Alert!**
 There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set\-up and does not use recruitment or job\-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ‘@netradyne.com’ or ‘@us\-greenhouse\-mail.io’.
   

  

 Please review and apply to our available job openings at Netradyne.com/company/careers. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's job scams website.

title: Senior Endpoint Engineer (Microsoft Intune & Windows Autopilot)
description:
**Role Description**
 Senior Endpoint Engineer (Microsoft Intune \& Windows Autopilot) Job Summary
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Endpoint Engineer to manage and support modern endpoint management services across the enterprise device estate. The role focuses on Microsoft Intune administration, Windows Autopilot deployment, application packaging, device management, compliance monitoring, and automation. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient endpoint operations while supporting Windows 10/11 lifecycle management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Administer and support Microsoft Intune for endpoint management, device enrollment, application deployment, and compliance monitoring.
* Configure and manage Windows Autopilot profiles for Windows 11 deployments, including branding, device provisioning, and policy configuration.
* Perform Windows 10/11 Deployment activities, including operating system upgrades, feature update testing, validation, and rollout support.
* Package, test, deploy, upgrade, repair, and uninstall applications using Application Packaging technologies such as MSI, MSIX, App\-V, or .intunewin.
* Manage device enrollment, retirement, lock, wipe, and lifecycle operations as part of Endpoint Security \& Device Management.
* Administer Windows update and patch deployment rings, monitor rollout success, track compliance, and remediate failed systems.
* Manage Device Certificates and support secure device authentication and access management.
* Utilize PowerShell / Automation capabilities to streamline endpoint administration, reporting, and operational tasks.
* Support Device Compliance initiatives by monitoring endpoint health, policy adherence, and organizational security standards.
* Investigate endpoint management, compliance, and patch\-related incidents, and coordinate resolution activities.
* Contribute to disaster recovery testing, audit activities, compliance reviews, and maintenance of endpoint\-related records.
* Support Endpoint Monitoring activities and proactively identify device performance and management issues.


**Required Skills**
 Proficient
   

  

* Microsoft Intune
* Windows Autopilot
* Application Packaging


 Intermediate
   

  

* PowerShell / Automation
* Endpoint Security \& Device Management


 Basic
   

  

* Endpoint Security
* Entra ID / Conditional Access
* Device Certificates


 Knowledge
   

  

* Windows 10/11 Deployment
* Device Compliance
* Endpoint Monitoring


 Experience
   

  

* 9 to 11 years of experience in Endpoint Engineering or Standard Operating Environment (SOE) Engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Intune deployment and endpoint management.
* Experience supporting Windows 10/11 device lifecycle management and enterprise endpoint services.


 Certifications
   

  

* MD\-102 Endpoint Administrator certification or equivalent preferred.


**Skills**
 Compliance Management, High Availability and Disaster Recovery, Microsoft Entra ID

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Workday Technical Consultant Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps clients maximize value from their investments in finance, supply chain, and IT operations through strategy, process design, and technology enablement. As a Workday Technical Consultant, Managed Services, you will support clients in optimizing Workday solutions, strengthening operational performance, and advancing their digital transformation objectives. You will work with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable, technology\-enabled solutions that help organizations operate more effectively in a dynamic business environment.
   

  

**Level** 
 : Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As a Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for Workday integrations and perform regression testing across enhancements and releases.
* Oversee integration scheduling and monitoring to support stable and timely operations.
* Configure and support Workday integration solutions using Connector, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), and Studio.
* Create and maintain calculated fields for integrations and coordinate requirements across teams to support consistency and efficiency.
* Collaborate with solution architects and cross\-functional teams to support integration design reviews, issue resolution, ticket management, and service delivery.


**The team**
 The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a collection of Offerings that helps clients achieve the maximum possible impact and value from their investments in Finance, Supply Chain and IT operations. By taking a holistic view of these key business functions from strategy articulation through process design and technology enablement, we can help our clients navigate their challenges while operating components of their business.
   

  

 As our clients drive towards their digital future, Finance, Supply Chain, and IT play an increasingly important role in how these organizations interact with their customers, suppliers, and other key stakeholders. By combining our strategy, operations improvement, implementation, and operate capabilities, we can be more creative in how we deploy our resources and drive innovation at market pace.
   

  

**Location** 
 : Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune / Chennai
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required** 
 :
   

  

* Experience providing Tier 2 or Tier 3 support for Workday integrations.
* Experience performing regression testing for Workday integrations.
* Experience with Workday integration scheduling and monitoring.
* Experience with Workday object\-oriented data models and integration approaches, including Connector, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), and Studio.
* Experience creating and maintaining calculated fields for integrations.
* Experience working across platforms integrated with Workday.
* Experience with data governance, integration development standards, and ticket management.


**Preferred** 
 :
   

  

* Experience collaborating with technical solution architects on integration design reviews and approvals.
* Experience supporting workflow\-based integration solutions in a managed services environment.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Position: Forward Deployed Engineer
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 ️ Working Days: Monday to Friday
   

  

 Experience Required: 6 months to 1 years
   

  

 Forward Deployed Engineer \|
   

  

**Solving agent problems across the lifecycle — build, deployment, tuning and steady state — measured on what the agent achieves.**
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to solve agent problems wherever they occur in the lifecycle. During build, that means getting a configuration to actually do what the use case requires. Through deployment and tuning, it means finding why an agent underperforms and fixing it at the right layer. In steady state, it means holding an agent's numbers where they were promised and catching drift before a client does. The common thread is not a phase; it is that an agent is not performing and you are the person who makes it perform.
   

  

 Your scorecard is the agent's outcome metrics. Connectivity, engagement and the outcome rate the use case exists to move — per agent, per use case. Tickets closed, response times and patch counts are hygiene we will look at, never the measure. A month with forty tickets closed and a drifting outcome rate is a bad month; a month with four and every agent holding its numbers is a good one.
   

  

 This role sits in the application layer, not core platform. That has a consequence worth stating plainly: you are partly an SDE. A fix that only ever helps one client is the weakest version of your work. Because you hold more context than anyone on why agents fail in the field, you are expected to recognise when a recurring fix should become a platform capability every client can use, and then to build it — pairing with SDE 1 and SDE 2 to ship it properly.
   

  

 It is hands\-on and customer\-facing at once. You will read production code, logs, transcripts and configuration; reproduce faults; write and ship changes; and speak directly to a client's operations or IT counterpart about what went wrong and what you changed. An FDE who cannot form an independent technical opinion becomes a ticket router, and a ticket router cannot move an outcome metric.
   

  

 What you are walking into
   

  

 Several enterprise accounts are live on real customer timelines while the platform is under active build. Most of what changes customer\-visible behaviour here is not code — it is configuration: a prompt, a disposition taxonomy, a threshold, a routing rule — shipping through a thinner review path than code. And our worst defects are not escaped, they are undetected: a configuration fault once put a placeholder outcome on two thirds of one campaign's calls for about a month, and the client found it, not us. None of that should discourage you; all of it is why the role exists.
   

  

 What you are measured on
   

  

 One primary metric, four supporting ones. The supporting metrics explain a movement in the primary; they never substitute for it.
   

  

 Metric Definition, and how it can be gamed
   

  

**Agent Outcome Metrics (primary)**
 Connectivity, engagement and outcome rate per agent and use case, against the committed baseline. This is the scorecard. Counter\-metric: baselines are set once and not renegotiated downward after a bad month.
   

  

**Detection latency**
 Median time from a customer\-visible regression starting to someone at our client's knowing. A fault we find in an hour is an incident; the same fault found by a client in five weeks is an account risk.
   

  

**Root\-cause accuracy**
 Share of issues where the first fix held. Re\-opens mean a symptom was patched at the wrong layer. Counter\-metric: time to first response, so accuracy is not bought with indefinite investigation.
   

  

**Escalation precision**
 Share of items sent to core platform that were genuinely platform gaps, and share you resolved that never needed to go there. Both directions fail: over\-escalation taxes platform engineering, under\-escalation buries a real signal in patches.
   

  

**Reusability**
 Share of your fixes that became a configurable capability available to every client rather than a one\-account patch. A high patch count with zero productised output is a warning sign, not throughput.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own agent performance, wherever the agent is in its lifecycle. Hold a current picture of every agent you touch: what outcome it exists to move, what it is moving this week, and what changed. When a number drifts, find out why before the client asks. Where the instrumentation to see the drift does not exist, building it is your work, not the reason it was invisible.
* Diagnose at the right layer before you change anything. Almost every issue arrives as a symptom. Place it first: context assembly, disposition or configuration error, or broken integration. These have different fixes and different owners, and a patch at the wrong layer holds for a fortnight and returns in a new shape. Read the transcripts, logs and configuration, and state a root cause you can defend.
* Treat configuration as production. A change to a prompt, a disposition taxonomy or a threshold changes what a customer experiences with no deployment at all. It gets a review, a version and a rollback path exactly as code does. Where a configuration change cannot yet be governed that way, closing that gap is your work. This is the single strongest belief we screen for.
* Sustain the trust loop with the client. Test, flag, patch, retest — visibly, on a cadence the client can see, during UAT and long after. In our verticals confidence is rebuilt by watching us find and fix our own faults, not by an absence of faults. Changes touching live campaign behaviour go out staged and reversible.
* Ship the fix, and the instrumentation that would have caught it. Every fix carries a second question: how would we have known sooner? A meaningful share of your output should be monitoring, alerting and evaluation coverage that turns the next instance of that fault into an alert rather than a client email.
* Build features with the SDEs, not requests for them. When a fix generalises, you take it to SDE 1 and SDE 2 as a designed capability — the problem, the evidence across accounts, and a proposal for how it should work — and you pair on building it. You hold the field context they do not; they hold the codebase depth you may not. Where a change touches core platform, the CTO is consulted before it is built, not after.
* Be the technical face on live accounts. You will speak directly to a client's operations and IT counterparts: what broke, why, what you changed, when it is verified. The CSM owns the relationship; you own the technical truth inside it. Being plain about a fault we caused buys more trust than a clean\-sounding account of a bad week.


 Who you will work with
   

  

 Stakeholder Your relationship with them
 **Chief Product Officer** 
 Your manager. Owns the application layer this role sits in. Reviews agent outcome metrics, reusability and escalation precision.
 **Chief Technology Officer** 
 Owns core platform engineering. Consulted when a change reaches into the platform, and the escalation point for genuine architecture gaps.
 **SDE 1 and SDE 2** 
 Your build partners. You bring the field context and the problem definition; you ship the generalised capability together.
 **Associate Product Managers** 
 Owns the change train and intake. Your changes ship under that discipline; your recurring\-failure patterns tell the APM where defects cluster.
 **Customer Success / Account Managers** 
 Own the customer relationship. They bring the escalation; you give the technical truth and a date you can defend.
 **Client operations and IT counterparts** 
 Your direct contacts on live accounts — CRM and telephony integrations, data issues, UAT and verification of fixes.
   

  

 What we are looking for
   

  

 Must\-haves
   

  

* At least 1 year building or running software in production. We are hiring on judgement and ownership, not tenure — but you must have shipped something real that other people depended on.
* Strong Python and comfort with SQL, and the ability to read an unfamiliar codebase and follow a request end to end through it.
* Hands\-on work with LLM applications: prompting, context assembly, retrieval, tool or function calling, and evaluation. If you have built an eval harness for a component whose output is a distribution rather than one correct answer, lead with that.
* Real debugging discipline — you can hold a hypothesis, test it, and discard it. We assess this on a live, messy artifact, not a whiteboard algorithm.
* API and integration work: REST, webhooks, queues, retries, auth, and the failure modes of somebody else's system that you cannot change.
* You treat configuration as production. If you have shipped systems governed by config, flags, rules or prompts, and have opinions on how those get reviewed, versioned and rolled back, say so early.
* Willingness to face a customer during a failure and be plain about it, and excellent written communication — root\-cause notes and change summaries are artifacts people act on. You will be assessed on writing, not asked about it.
* Comfort with ambiguity and half\-built process. You will operate without a runbook and then write the runbook.


 Nice\-to\-haves
   

  

* Voice or conversational AI: telephony, dialers, STT and TTS, latency and barge\-in behaviour, call\-quality debugging.
* Regulated environments — BFSI, insurance, healthcare — and the data\-handling, DPDP and audit gates that come with them.
* Observability tooling (Grafana, Looker, Metabase or equivalents), CRM and contact\-centre integrations, and Indian\-language deployments where transcription quality varies by language, accent and channel.


 Disqualifiers
   

  

* Treating a configuration change as exempt from release discipline because it is not a deploy.
* Patching symptoms — adjusting a prompt until a complaint stops, without a stated root cause.
* Escalating as a reflex, or the opposite: absorbing a genuine platform gap into patch work for months, and optimising for the queue while the agent's outcome metrics drift.
* Declaring something fixed because it worked in one test, on a component whose output is a distribution.


 What this role is not
   

  

* Core platform architecture and technical direction — layering, security model, technology choices (CTO).
* Release cadence, intake gating and cross\-service contract governance (TPM).
* Product roadmap ownership and prioritisation (Product, with your input from the field).
* Owning the customer relationship, WBRs and QBRs (CSM).
* Commercial scoping, pricing and renewal (AM).


 What success looks like
   

  

 By day 30
   

  

* You can state, for every agent you own, its intended outcome, current numbers and top two failure modes — without asking anyone.
* You have taken over the live\-issue queue end to end, and platform engineering has stopped being pulled into it by default.
* At least one recurring issue is traced to a root cause and fixed there, rather than at the symptom.


 By day 60
   

  

* Agent outcome metrics are holding at or above the baseline you measured in week one, and that baseline is written down.
* At least one customer\-visible regression was caught by us before the client raised it, and you can point at what caught it.
* At least one field fix has been generalised with the SDEs into a capability other clients can use.
* Every agent you touched has its configuration under version control and a reversible path to production.
* A written handover exists that would let a second FDE pick this up: known faults, baselines, patterns worth productising.

description:
Shift Requirements

 Batch Monitoring \& Incident Management

 Job Scheduling \& Change Management

title: Analyst – IT Service Desk IND
description:
**About us:**  

OsbIndia (OSBI) is an offshore subsidiary of OSB Group. OSBI was incorporated in 2004 as a key part of the OSB Group’s business strategy to provide operational service support. OSBI works with the Group’s trading brands in the UK, providing exceptional customer support and service delivery to new and existing customers.
  
  

OSBI also prides itself on offering operational excellence by devising and utilizing process improvements and functional efficiencies.
  
  

The principal purpose of this role is to provide L1 Support to the end users related to technical IT queries and issues.
  
The role involves handling incidents, service requests and events ensuring delivery of IT services are of the highest standards to the Business.
  
The person fulfilling this role may need to travel to UK or Internationally as expected by the IT or Business for supporting migration, automation, or continual improvement related activities for a number of IT Services.
  
  

1\. Core Responsibilities
  
* First Point of Contact: As the first point of contact for end\-users, a ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for receiving, documenting, and prioritizing requests and incidents.
* Ticket Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for managing the ticket queue, ensuring that tickets are properly categorized, assigned and tracked to resolution.
* Troubleshooting and Support: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for providing technical support to end\-users, troubleshooting issues and resolving incidents within established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Communication and Customer Service: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for maintaining communication with end\-users, providing updates on incident status and resolution and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained.
* Knowledge Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for maintaining and updating a knowledge base of common issues and their solutions, to improve efficiency and reduce resolution time.
* Escalation Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for escalating incidents to appropriate levels of support when necessary and ensuring that escalation paths are clearly defined and followed.
* Monitoring and Reporting: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for monitoring the health of IT systems, alerting appropriate support teams to issues and producing regular reports on incident trends and resolution times.
* Documentation and Process Improvement: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for documenting incident resolution procedures, identifying areas for process improvement, and contributing to the development and maintenance of IT service management (ITSM) processes and policies.
* Flexible to work in 24/7 rotational shifts to support End users and to monitor the health of IT Systems.
* Provide client / IT end users support and technical issue resolution via E\-Mail, phone and other electronic medium 24/7/365 days within agreed SLA and standards
* Support Clients / Internal Server – Network Infrastructure and coordinate with Service Owners / vendors for issues resolution and reporting
* Manage IT ServiceDesk tickets within SLA with minimal functional escalation.
* Assess recurring incidents and provide feedback on the accuracy of the Known Errors. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), Change Management Processes (CRP) and Problem Handling Procedures (PHP)
* Perform Windows (IT) / Core System operational tasks and report (E.g. Backups, Tape Rotation, VMWare, Antivirus reports etc.
* Perform operational tasks and business processes
* Maintain and manage checklists, standard reports etc.
* Provide out\-of\-hours support when required (Assigned on rotational basis)
* Create, update document/procedures etc. IT operation tasks using OSB / EG standard format in coordination with service owners
* Liaise with external suppliers / vendors
* Liaise with internal customers
* Undertake any other duties, commensurate with grade and job title, requested by Line Manager or above.
* As nominated Risk Champion for your function, work alongside the Risk function in developing and maintaining a risk management agenda, acting both to ensure the necessary levels of transparency for potential risks and promoting a positive culture of awareness and accountability throughout your function
* Maintain the company’s compliance standards and ensure timely completion of all mandatory on\-line training modules and attestations
* Performs moderately complex and varied tasks
* Guides and trains junior team members


2\. Experience Requirements
  
Essential
  
* 2 to 5 years of L1 technical support experience is essential
* Experience of working in a Windows/Citrix/VMWare/Active Directory and/or Applications service support role is essential
* Operating Systems: Experience in supporting and troubleshooting various operating systems such as Windows 10/11, MacOS and Linux.
* Software Applications: Familiarity with a range of software applications including productivity tools (e.g. Microsoft Office Suite), email clients, and web browsers.
* Remote Access: Experience in remote access technologies such as Remote Desktop, Virtual Private Network (VPN), and Remote Assistance.
* Incident Management, Knowledge Management and Service Request fulfilment.


Desirable
  
* Experience in working with ServiceNow (user level) or an equivalent ITSM system is desirable.


3\. Knowledge Requirements
  
Essential
  
* Excellent knowledge in Desktop support / End user computing / Applications support on Citrix platform/environment is essential.
* Hardware: Knowledge of computer hardware including desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices is essential.
* Networking: Understanding of basic networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.


Desirable
  
* Knowledge of ITSM best practices is desirable.


4\. Skill and Competency Requirements
  
Essential
  
* Strong English language skills are essential (both written \& verbal).
* Good skills in respect of stakeholder management are essential.
* Good skills in respect of documentation, problem solving, analytical and time management are essential.
* User Administration: Ability to manage Office 365 user accounts, licenses, and permissions.
* Troubleshooting Skills: The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues related to Office 365 applications and services.
* Active Directory User and Group Management: Knowledge of how to create, manage, and delete user and group accounts in AD is necessary for responding to requests related to access and permissions.
* Active Directory Account Lockouts: Knowledge of account lockout policies and troubleshooting account lockout issues is important for resolving issues related to user account lockouts.


Desirable
  
* PowerShell Scripting: Knowledge of PowerShell scripting for automating routine AD tasks and troubleshooting issues.


Why join OSBI?
  
  

We understand your career and how you progress is as unique as your individual personality. We've created a culture and an environment that encourages personal growth and offers our people opportunities to learn and succeed. Whether you're in the early stages of your career or already have an established profession, we're constantly seeking to hire talented individuals who want to make a difference and grow with us. We're a connected company working together to create a business in which we can all take pride and prosper.

 The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross\-functional collaboration, and a customer\-focused approach to problem resolution.

* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure


**Preferred/Good to Have:**
* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)

 The Field Engineer – IT is responsible for onsite installation, configuration, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and technical support of IT infrastructure and related products at customer sites and onboard vessels. * Strong hands‑on IT field support experience.

 Knowledge of marine communication equipment installation, configuration, and maintenance onboard vessels will be considered an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

+ Deliver comprehensive, end\-to\-end infrastructure\-level problem resolution across Layer 2/3 network fabrics, overlays, virtualization layers, and compute/storage integrations.

* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Proactive Prevention:
+ Conduct deep\-dive RCAs featuring rigorous root\-cause findings, structured remediation paths, and proactive prevention strategies.
+ Manage software escalation referrals for critical or recurring anomalies across IOS XR, ASR, NCS, and related Service Provider platforms.

* Strategic Collaboration \& Operations:
+ Partner with the High Touch Operations Manager (HTOM) to monitor operational trends, contribute to quarterly technical reviews, analyze performance metrics, and build strategic action plans.
+ Leverage deep contextual knowledge of customer network architecture and change\-control processes to fast\-track critical escalations.
+ Collaborate seamlessly with Account Teams, Cisco TAC, Product Business Units, and HTOM stakeholders to coordinate unified resolution strategies.

* Deployment \& Ecosystem Leadership:
+ Provide remote or onsite support for complex network expansions, migrations, and architecture rollouts; act as Lead Engineer across High Touch Technical Support (HTTS) and TAC frameworks when required.
+ Foster long\-term customer success by building enduring relationships and contributing reusable automation tools, diagnostic scripts, and best\-practice documentation.


**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (Computer Science / Electrical Engineering preferred) or equivalent, backed by 5\+ years of specialized networking experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical discipline.
* Communication \& Execution: Exceptional verbal, written, and executive\-level presentation skills, capable of commanding technical authority in front of enterprise stakeholders.
* Autonomy \& Mindset: Highly self\-driven, analytical, and autonomous, with a proven track record of untangling complex technical roadblocks in high\-performance Service Provider networks.
* Agile Problem\-Solving: Ability to evaluate strict operational requirements, architect solutions within defined constraints, and leverage agile methodologies for rapid delivery, testing, and value realization.


**Technical Competencies – Service Provider Focus**
* Platforms \& Hardware: Cisco ASR 9000/1000 Series Routers; Cisco NCS 5400/5500/5600/6000 Platforms.
* Operating Systems \& Protocols: Cisco IOS XR Operating System; MPLS, Segment Routing (SR\-MPLS/SRv6\), EVPN, LDP, Carrier Ethernet, and IP/MPLS Transport.
* Routing \& Switching Core: BGP, ISIS, OSPF, RSVP\-TE, QoS, CGNAT, BNG, Multicast, and IPv6\.
* Architecture \& Troubleshooting: Deep working knowledge of TCP/IP, STP, HSRP, VRRP, and Service Provider core/edge architectures. Expert\-level packet\-level analysis using tools like Wireshark.
* Telemetry \& Tooling: IOS XR troubleshooting, Model\-Driven Telemetry (MDT), and Crosswork/CNC/NCS toolsuites.
* Preferred Credentials: Active CCNP / CCIE Service Provider certification.
* Additional Advantage: Exposure to NMS, advanced monitoring tools, Service Provider security frameworks, infrastructure protection, and zero\-trust architectures.

description:
**Job Role: Network Support Engineer — Zscaler and security \- SG** 




**Experience: 4\-7 years** 




  





**Project context** 




 This position carries secure internet and private access operations for the whole estate. Its holder resolves the user\-facing problems that sit between the endpoint, the cloud security platform and the network.
 



 A second technology is required, and one only. Candidates are expected to be genuinely operational on Zscaler and to bring credible working knowledge of either Palo Alto firewalls, campus LAN and Wi\-Fi, or Cisco Catalyst SD\-WAN.
 



**Goals and deliverables** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Resolve incidents and service requests within agreed SLA targets, with structured troubleshooting and analysis before any escalation.
 



 • Maintain complete, evidence\-based ticket documentation; escalate to Level 3 only with full diagnostic detail.
 



 • Own backlog hygiene, timely stakeholder updates and disciplined shift handovers to guarantee operational continuity.
 



 • Author and maintain Knowledge Base Articles and runbooks; identify repeat incidents suitable for shift\-left to Level 1\.
 



 • Apply ITIL incident, change and problem management, and comply with internal security and audit requirements.
 



 • Contribute to Major Incident support, KPI reporting and operational performance reviews, and to problem management investigations.
 



**Specific responsibilities** 




  





**In addition to the core responsibilities stated above:** 




 • Operate Zscaler Internet Access: ZIA Policies Management including: Bandwidth Control, DNS Security, URL Filtering, SSL Inspection, Firewall Policies, handling \& troubleshooting of ZIA\-related incidents and changes.
 



 • Operate Zscaler Private Access: App Segments and Access Policies management, App Connector health monitoring / troubleshooting.
 



 • Use Zscaler Digital Experience evidence to arbitrate between user\-side and network\-side causes.
 



 • Manage traffic forwarding: Client Connector behaviour, PAC files, GRE and IPsec tunnels, and their failover.
 



 • Support the second technology at working level within the change governance in force.
 



**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or equivalent experience.
 



 • Working knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting and end\-to\-end packet flow reasoning; Ethernet switching, VLAN, STP and 802\.1Q.
 



 • Practical exposure to Infoblox DNS, DHCP and IPAM operations.
 



 • Familiarity with ITSM tooling, BMC Helix or equivalent, and experience in SLA\-driven environments with KPI accountability.
 



 • Experience raising, chasing and challenging carrier tickets, including RFO follow\-up.
 



 • Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken.
 



 • Availability for rotating shift work in a follow\-the\-sun model.
 



**Expected skills** 




 DHCP
 



 IPAM
 



 ZSCALER
 



 VLAN
 



 DNS
 



 Ethernet Switching
