title: Manager, Quality – Digital Systems
description:
**Role Summary:**
 The Manager, Quality – Digital Systems is a business\-facing role that serves as the primary point of contact between RQA’s digital quality systems and the stakeholders who depend on them, with working technical depth in Veeva eQMS administration and GxP\-regulated system operations anchoring that work. This role is accountable for the reliable administration and continuous improvement of Veeva eQMS processes, including access management, business administration, release coordination, and reporting. The successful candidate will bring enough configuration fluency \- understanding vault object relationships, shared versus instance\-specific configuration, and the downstream consequences of proposed system changes \- to translate technical trade\-offs into clear guidance for stakeholders and support faster, better\-informed decisions on enhancement requests and system design questions.
   

  

 The successful candidate must communicate clearly across technical and business audiences, understand stakeholder needs, assess business and technical trade\-offs, and support technology decisions that advance quality operations and broader business objectives. Beyond day\-to\-day operations, this role independently represents the RQA Digital Systems team within cross\-functional programs and enterprise initiatives, scoping RQA’s responsibilities within a given program and developing and driving the execution plan on behalf of the team. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, maintaining clear situational awareness across assigned responsibilities and bringing issues and decisions forward proactively.
   

  

 This position requires strong communication and analytical skills, working Veeva domain knowledge, genuine curiosity about applying AI and emerging technology to quality operations, and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated pharmaceutical environment — both as a business partner and as an accountable owner of complex, cross\-functional work.
   

  

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Veeva eQMS Operations \& Administration**
* Serve as the primary business administrator for Veeva eQMS on behalf of Regulatory Quality Assurance.
* Triage and resolve business admin requests requiring business\-level judgment, partnering with technical teams on complex issues.
* Own access request intake and provisioning across RQA’s digital systems environments.
* Support Veeva release coordination through UAT, business approvals and communications, and production deployments.
* Maintain and continuously improve job aids, quick reference guides, and user\-facing documentation for Veeva eQMS and integrated supporting tools, keeping materials current across system releases.
* Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.


**eQMS Systems Expertise \& Advisory**
* Provide guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of business needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes, partnering with technical teams to fill configuration depth as needed.
* Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing business context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision\-making.
* Stay current on Veeva platform developments and GxP digital systems best practices, especially with respect to emerging AI technologies, applying that knowledge to identify and champion opportunities to modernize system design and operations.
* Participate in eQMS governance forums, representing RQA Digital Systems’ interests and staying current on platform developments.


**Cross\-Functional Program Support**
* Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
* Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
* Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross\-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.


**Reporting \& Data Operations**
* Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes.
* Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks, including basic dashboarding and data queries, in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
* Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.


**Transformation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA’s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
* Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and drive adoption of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
* Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team’s operations and delivery.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field with 5\+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear documentation, user\-facing guidance, and stakeholder\-ready reports.
* Demonstrated experience working directly and iteratively with business stakeholders to understand their underlying needs and workflows.
* Working knowledge of Veeva Vault eQMS or a comparable enterprise quality/GxP system, including working knowledge of vault object relationships and configuration dependencies.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on curiosity about AI\-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics, with concrete examples of applying them to improve processes and drive innovation.
* Experience in a GxP\-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross\-functional work.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable decisions.


**Preferred:**
* Basic coding, scripting, and/or dashboarding experience (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Spotfire, or similar).
* Background as a Veeva Vault business administrator, business analyst, or similar business\-technology liaison role.
* Experience with Veeva Vault configuration in a pharma or CRO setting, including participation in system releases, eQMS governance forums, or enhancement request management.
* Familiarity with Pfizer enterprise data and/or source systems.
* Exposure to data platforms – Snowflake, DSS/Dataiku – or related data engineering tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate or similar automation tools.

title: IT AI and Automation Analyst
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Responsibilities \-**
**AI \& Automation Enablement Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain AI\-driven support workflows using Microsoft Copilot and related platforms
* Develop and manage Copilot Studio agents integrated with ITSM, asset management, IT catalog, and request management systems
* Build Power Automate flows and API\-based automations to reduce repetitive Tier 1 and Tier 2 support tasks
* Integrate internal systems via APIs and connectors to enable conversational IT support and self\-service experiences
* Identify high\-volume ticket patterns and propose scalable automation solutions
* Maintain and optimise automation scripts, workflows, and AI prompt structures
* Monitor chatbot and automation performance using usage analytics and continuously improve effectiveness
* Ensure governance, auditability, and security controls are applied to all automation implementations
* Research emerging AI tools relevant to IT operations and propose pilot initiatives
* This role is expected to spend a meaningful portion of time driving automation initiatives alongside core support responsibilities.


**Core IT Service Desk Responsibilities**
* Local support of the Gurgaon office on site 5 days a week
* Global support of all Sprinklr users
* Tracking and documenting all support activities within the ITSM platform
* Supporting macOS, Windows, AV, and enterprise software including Microsoft 365, Adobe, and cloud SaaS applications
* Laptop provisioning, inductions, hardware troubleshooting, and repair
* Conference room, telephony, printer, and office network support
* Application deployment, upgrades, and performance troubleshooting
* Endpoint management and antivirus security enforcement
* Supporting high\-level events and proactive monitoring of meeting rooms
* Onboarding and offboarding support including device preparation, access provisioning, and secure asset return
* Collaborating with cross\-regional IT teams on escalated issues
* Maintaining SOPs, knowledge base documentation, and user guides
* Supporting VIP users and executives with high\-priority service
* Coordinating with IT vendors


**About You \-**
* 5\+ years’ experience in IT Support or IT Operations within an enterprise environment
* Strong hands\-on experience supporting macOS, Windows, and Microsoft 365
* Experience with JAMF Pro and enterprise device lifecycle management
* Experience supporting senior stakeholders and executives


**Required Automation \& Systems Capability**
* Hands\-on experience building automations using Power Automate, scripting, or workflow platforms
* Practical experience working with APIs, connectors, or system integrations including authentication concepts and data flows
* Experience contributing to ITSM improvements, service catalog automation, or self\-service enablement
* Ability to analyse ticket trends and design scalable solutions that reduce repetitive manual effort
* Strong interest in AI\-driven service delivery and demonstrated experience experimenting with or implementing AI tools


**Professional Attributes**
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail
* Able to prioritise effectively across operational support and project work
* Comfortable working in a fast\-changing, global environment
* Proactive mindset with curiosity around emerging technologies


**Essential Technologies**
* Microsoft 365 including Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
* Microsoft Power Platform including Power Automate
* ITSM platforms


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Short Summary** 




  





**Skills** 
 : Strong technical troubleshooting ability, customer service, excellent communication
 



**Experience** 
 : 2\-5 years of experience at a SaaS company
 



**Office location** 
 : Gurgaon, at Patina Tower, near Sikanderpur Metro Station, DLF Phase 1
 



**Company website** 
 : https://www.sumtracker.com
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 Sumtracker is inventory management and replenishment software for Shopify and Amazon merchants, powering 2,000\+ e\-commerce brands across 50\+ countries. Founded in 2020, we're bootstrapped and profitable. We’ve built a product our customers genuinely love. We're a small, fast\-growing team based in Gurugram, working in\-office, and looking for people who want real ownership over their work.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer who sits at the intersection of technical troubleshooting and customer service \- someone who can dig into logs, APIs and integrations to actually solve a customer's problem, not just log a ticket.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who enjoys the puzzle of figuring out
 *why* 
 something broke \- whether it's a Shopify sync failure, a webhook that didn't fire, or a rate\-limit issue with a marketplace integration \- and can explain the fix to a customer in plain, non\-jargon language.
 



  





 You'll work closely with engineering and product to escalate genuine bugs, and you'll be the voice of the customer internally, flagging patterns before they become bigger problems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role
 



  




* **Troubleshoot \& resolve** 
 : Diagnose technical issues customers report \- bugs, integration failures, configuration problems, API errors. Reproduce issues, check logs, and identify root causes
* **Escalate with clarity** 
 : When something is a genuine bug, escalate to engineering with clear reproduction steps so it can be fixed fast
* **Manage expectations** 
 : Keep customers informed on timelines for fixes and workarounds
* **Go deep on integrations** 
 : Understand Sumtracker's architecture well enough to debug beyond surface\-level \- reading logs, making light SQL/API calls, and understanding how integrations like Shopify, Amazon and other marketplaces sync, fail, and recover
* **Document \& build knowledge** 
 : Write and update help center articles and FAQs based on recurring issues; maintain internal runbooks for common problems
* **Support onboarding** 
 : Occasionally get involved in onboarding or implementation for technically complex accounts



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **Proven Experience** 
 : 2\-5 years of experience in a technical support, support engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical role, ideally at a SaaS company
* **Technical Aptitude** 
 : Comfortable reading logs, working with APIs, and picking up enough of a product's architecture to debug real issues \- prior hands\-on exposure to SQL, APIs, or webhooks is a strong plus
* **Excellent Communication** 
 : Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in plain language
* **Customer\-Centric Approach** 
 : A genuine passion for helping customers succeed and a strong commitment to providing outstanding service
* **Ownership\-Driven** 
 : Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple tickets/issues effectively



  





**Why should you join us?** 




  




* **Competitive compensation** 
 : Attractive salary with annual increments
* **Growth opportunities** 
 : Take on a pivotal role with full ownership, accelerating your career
* **Global exposure** 
 : Work with customers across the US, UK, Australia, and more
* **Cutting\-edge work** 
 : Solve real problems using AI and modern tools



  





**Work Policy** 




 We are an in\-office company with a 5\-day work week
 



  





**Team and Culture** 




 At Sumtracker, we foster a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and transparency.
 



  




* **Process\-driven and autonomous:** 
 Well\-defined processes that empower you to work independently
* **Transparency:** 
 Open communication about company progress and individual contributions
* **Direct access:** 
 Share your thoughts and ideas directly with the founders
* **Great workspace:** 
 Work from our office at WeWork Platina Tower
* **Continuous learning:** 
 Enhance your skills with company\-sponsored courses

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess**
 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
   

  

 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
   

  

**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.**
**As the Specialist, Oracle HCM, you will:**
**Operational BAU Support**
* Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
* Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,


**Recruitment, Onboarding And Compensation \& Benefits.**
* Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
* Provide ongoing L2/L3 functional and technical support for production issues, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA\-driven system stability.
* Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
* Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
* Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.


**Projects**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Support the rollout of Oracle HCM across different geographies, and Thiess businesses working with regional HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
* Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.
* Take part in fit\-gap analysis and recommend target\-state design and process improvements.
* Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.


**Enhancements**
* Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
* Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
* Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards using BI Publisher and OTBI for actionable HR insights.
* Support change impact assessment and user communication or training for new enhancements.


 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships
   

  

* Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
* Engage others by focusing on common ground and shared objectives.
* Consult with stakeholders before making decisions.


**People \& Leadership**
* Work towards plans to achieve team and business goals.
* Support others to deliver results and improvements.
* Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
* Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.


 Health, Safety \& Sustainability
   

  

* Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
* Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.


**About You**
**Formal Education**
* Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.


**Work Experience**
* 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
* In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
* Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
* Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
* Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
* Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
* Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
* Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.


**What's On Offer**
 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.
   

  

* Competitive salary package.
* Ongoing training \& development opportunities.
* A strong safety\-first culture across all operations, built on care, respect and accountability.
* Range of corporate discounts including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products.


**About Thiess**
 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.
   

  

 The pioneering spirit of our founders – the legendary Thiess brothers – is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change.
   

  

 At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.
   

  

 We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning – supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining.

title: Contact Center Specalist
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Drive the delivery and continuous improvement of robust, scalable contact center solutions by managing escalations, integrating advanced technologies, and optimizing omnichannel interactions to support seamless customer experiences across Orange’s platform ecosystem.
   

  

* Troubleshoot and resolve escalated incidents related to IVR, call routing, SIP trunks, and omnichannel interactions.
* Collaborate with Genesys Support and vendors to address critical platform issues effectively.
* Manage incident response processes and conduct root cause analysis for outages and service disruptions.
* Provide operational support for Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, and Webex Contact Center solutions aligned with business requirements.
* Develop and configure IVR flows, call routing strategies, and omnichannel interaction paths.
* Integrate Genesys Cloud with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, as well as databases and third\-party applications.
* Configure and optimize ACD, Workforce Management, and Workforce Engagement Management features.
* Guide the team in daily monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of the contact center environments.
* Optimize SIP trunking, voice quality, and telephony infrastructure to ensure high performance.
* Manage user roles, permissions, and security configurations within the Genesys platform.
* Develop and maintain APIs, webhooks, and system integrations to enhance automation and scalability.
* Implement AI\-powered chatbots, speech analytics, and automation solutions to drive efficiency.
* Utilize cloud service providers such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud to support scalable integration solutions.


**About You**
 You bring over 5 years of experience in Contact Center Engineering, including a minimum of 3 years with hands\-on work in Genesys Cloud CX. You possess deep technical knowledge in ACD, IVR, SIP, WebRTC, and omnichannel functionality, along with experience in scripting and API integrations. You are proficient with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and adept at integrating contact center solutions with CRM systems. Your background includes workforce engagement management and AI\-driven technologies, and you hold relevant certifications such as Genesys Cloud CX/NICE CXone CIP Core.
   

  

**Your professional skills:**
* Demonstrate extensive experience with Genesys Cloud CX and contact center engineering spanning more than 5 years.
* Apply in\-depth knowledge of telephony systems including ACD, IVR, SIP, WebRTC, and omnichannel communication features.
* Utilize programming and scripting skills in JavaScript, Python, JSON, and RESTful APIs to support system integrations and automation.
* Leverage expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and adhere to security best practices.
* Integrate contact center platforms with CRM software including Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Microsoft Dynamics to enhance customer data flow.
* Employ hands\-on experience with Architects, Composer, and Interaction Routing tools within contact center environments.
* Incorporate workforce engagement solutions, speech analytics, and AI\-driven technologies to improve contact center operations.


**Your soft skills:**
* Effectively address and resolve complex technical problems with clear troubleshooting strategies.
* Communicate complex concepts and technical information clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders.
* Adapt to evolving technologies and dynamic project requirements with flexibility and continuous learning.
* Collaborate effectively within cross\-functional teams to achieve shared goals and maintain operational excellence.


 Join Orange as a Contact Center Specialist to contribute to innovative customer experience solutions in a collaborative and dynamic environment. Your expertise will drive impactful enhancements across cloud\-based contact center platforms, enabling seamless interactions and operational excellence. Experience an environment that values skill development, adaptability, and continuous improvement, aligned with Orange’s mission to connect and empower communities.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Data Migration Specialist
description:
**About Loop**
 Loop is a subscription management platform built for e\-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.
   

  

 We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We grew 5x in 2023, 3x in 2024, and are on track for 2\.5x growth in 2025\. With $10M\+ ARR built through organic channels and a small, high\-performing team, we believe in doing more with less.
   

  

**Our DNA**
* High Agency action over instruction
* High Ethics trust is the foundation
* Positive Attitude solutions over excuses
* Impact\-Driven if it doesn't move the needle, it doesn't matter


**About The Data Migration Specialist Role**
 This role ensures merchants move to Loop smoothly by owning the technical side of onboarding and subscription data migration. You will manage end\-to\-end migration workflows, support onboarding specialists, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high data accuracy with zero\-error execution. The role blends backend operations, basic scripting, Shopify know\-how, testing, and documentationideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with data, and enabling seamless merchant go\-lives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Client Onboarding: Collaborate with the onboarding specialists to understand the technical requirements and ensure smooth onboarding of the merchants.
* Data migration: Own the migration infrastructure to help merchants migrate their subscriptions data from their previous platform to Loop ensuring no data loss and errors.
* Technical Support: Provide technical support to clients during the onboarding process, addressing any issues or concerns promptly.
* Documentation: Create and maintain documentation for common configurations, data migration process and popular troubleshooting for speed resolution.
* Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and quality assurance to ensure no escalations or issues reported after the merchant is onboarded.
* Shopify Expertise: Leverage your knowledge of Shopify to better assist merchants in having the custom requirements implemented as per the expectation.


**Ideal Profile**
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in a related role.
* Proficiency in Excel and Python scripts
* Experience in working with e\-commerce platforms, particularly Shopify, is a significant advantage.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced and dynamic team environment.
* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently when required.


**Perks**
* Annual Leaves
* Free lunch and snacks
* Annual company retreat
* Insurance

description:

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 In this role, you will manage the day\-to\-day operations and governance of a portfolio of finance technology and analytics solutions, ensuring the reliable delivery and support of business\-critical reporting and data processes. You will work closely with various stakeholders to drive operational excellence, manage incidents and service performance, and deliver continuous improvements across the platform landscape. Leveraging your expertise in data analytics, Power BI, SQL, and modern data technologies, you will translate business requirements into scalable solutions while mentoring team members and fostering a strong service\-oriented culture.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with 7\+ years’ experience in data analytics, technology delivery, production support, or operations management.
* Strong expertise in Power BI, SQL, Alteryx, and enterprise data platforms, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and support of business\-critical reporting solutions.

title: Technical Support Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Technical Support Manager** 
 to lead, mentor, and scale B2B SaaS support operations. This role is accountable for delivering exceptional customer experiences, building a high\-performing technical support team, and driving cross\-functional collaboration to resolve complex customer issues. The ideal candidate has a proven background in B2B SaaS, preferably within hospitality technology, strong people leadership skills, and a practical understanding of how modern AI tools can improve support quality, efficiency, and scalability.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**People Leadership \& Support Operations**
* Lead, coach, and scale a team of Technical Support Engineers delivering support across global communication channels, including chat, email, and phone.
* Establish, monitor, and improve key support metrics, including CSAT, Time to First Response, Mean Time to Resolution, and SLA compliance.
* Drive individual and team performance through regular one\-on\-ones, skill assessments, performance reviews, and career development planning.
* Promote clear ownership, accountability, urgency, and consistency in customer\-facing support execution.


**Cross\-Departmental Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Technical Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success.
* Establish feedback loops that convert support ticket trends, recurring defects, and customer pain points into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams.
* Partner with Customer Success to manage critical account escalations, protect high\-value customer relationships, and improve retention outcomes.
* Ensure escalations are clearly documented, prioritized, and resolved with appropriate urgency and follow\-through.


**AI \& Process Optimization**
* Evaluate, integrate, and champion AI\-driven tools such as auto\-triage, generative AI response drafting, automated ticket routing, and predictive analytics.
* Improve self\-service capabilities by strengthening knowledge base quality, AI\-powered search, and support documentation workflows.
* Balance automation with a high\-touch customer experience, ensuring efficiency gains do not reduce customer trust or issue ownership.
* Continuously identify workflow gaps, manual bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve support scale without sacrificing quality.


**Job Requirements**
* Experience \- Seeking a candidate with experience of 5\+ years in technical support, including at least 2 years in direct people management leading technical teams.
* Domain Expertise \- Strong background in B2B SaaS models. Hospitality technology experience, including PMS, POS, or guest management systems, is highly preferred.
* Technical Skills \- Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, database querying, system integrations, and enterprise support tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Jira.
* AI Exposure \- Hands\-on experience or demonstrated strategic understanding of incorporating AI tools into modern technical support workflows.
* Leadership \- Proven ability to mentor staff, manage high\-pressure client escalations, and build a collaborative, accountability\-driven team culture.


**Success Profile**
 The successful candidate will combine technical fluency, disciplined operational management, and strong people leadership. They should be comfortable operating in a fast\-moving B2B SaaS environment, translating customer issues into business and product insights, and using AI\-enabled tools to improve support speed, consistency, and scalability.
   

  

**Work Schedule**
 This position requires working in 24/7 rotational shifts, including evenings, late nights, and weekends. The role will be working in a hybrid work mode, with a minimum of two days required in the office each week, based in Hyderabad or Gurugram.

Improper interference with the ability of Cendyn’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

 OmniMD is an AI\-driven digital health company with over two decades of experience transforming traditional care models into intelligent, cloud\-based platforms. The organization delivers integrated solutions that support secure, interoperable exchange of health information across systems and providers. With a portfolio of more than 25 products, including EHR, Practice Management, AI Front Desk, AI Medical Scribe, AI RCM, and Chronic Care Management tools, OmniMD serves over 20 medical specialties. Its solutions enhance patient engagement, improve financial outcomes, and streamline workflows through automation, telehealth, remote monitoring, and patient\-facing digital tools. OmniMD fosters an inclusive, innovation\-focused culture built on collaboration, expertise, and continuous improvement in healthcare delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Implementation Trainer – EHR/RCM is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for training healthcare clients and their teams on OmniMD’s EHR and Revenue Cycle Management solutions, including system workflows, best practices, and product features. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting individual and group training sessions, creating training materials and documentation, and supporting clients during implementation, go\-live, and post\-implementation phases. The Implementation Trainer collaborates closely with implementation specialists, product teams, and client stakeholders to gather feedback, troubleshoot user challenges, and refine training approaches. The role also involves monitoring user adoption, preparing reports on training effectiveness, and ensuring that clients can use OmniMD solutions efficiently and compliantly in their clinical and billing operations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of EHR workflows, clinical documentation processes, and healthcare practice operations.
* Experience with Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), including patient registration, coding, billing, claims, and payment posting.
* Proficiency in delivering software training: conducting classroom, virtual, and one\-on\-one sessions; developing user guides, manuals, and training materials.
* Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical users.
* Comfort with cloud\-based healthcare applications and general IT literacy, including basic troubleshooting and user support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to document processes and feedback clearly.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams (implementation, product, support) and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Prior experience in healthcare technology, medical billing, or clinical operations is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, IT, business, or a related field preferred; relevant professional certifications in healthcare IT or training are a plus.
* Willingness to work onsite in Ahmedabad and, when required, travel to client locations for training and implementation

* Experience: 6\+ years in the Software/SaaS industry, 3\+ years in the supply chain domain, and experience with customer support in Supply Chain software.

With Blue Yonder, you’ll unify your data, supply chain and retail commerce operations to unlock new business opportunities and drive automation, control and orchestration to enable more profitable, sustainable business decisions. * Understand the SaaS offering, features and functionality deployed for a given customer.
* Work closely with the Blue Yonder Planning SCPO Solution Experts for complex issue resolution including Product Development.
* Continuous learning on latest Blue Yonder Planning Solutions.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Industry experience:
* 6\+ years of experience in the Software/SaaS industry
* 3\+ years of Supply chain Planning (SCPO)
* Supply chain Experience with customer/client support in Supply Chain software.
* Ideal candidate will have experience working with Blue Yonder products, specifically Supply Chain Planning solutions.
* Technical/Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder suite of solutions preferred specifically, ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning), Demand, Fulfilment, Promotions, Inventory Optimization, SCPO Platform is preferred.


**Mandatory**
**Technical Skills:**

* Good Knowledge Programming language (C\#, ASP.Net)

**Preferred**

title: IN-Sr Technical Consultant - Cloud - AS400, IBM i OS administration

* Proficiency in IBM i OS administration: system values, work management, security/authorities, PTF management, and OS upgrades.
* Experience with backup/recovery on IBM i (BRMS and/or Commvault).
* Working knowledge of CL programming and IBM i command environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes (Incident, Change, Problem) and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
* Ability to work in a shift/on\-call model supporting 24x7 operations.

title: IT Support Executive
description:
Location : Cochin
 



 Department: IT / Operations
 



 Reports to: IT Manager / IT Lead
 



 Employment type: Full\-time, on\-site
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an active, dependable IT Support Executive to handle day\-to\-day L1 technical support across our offices. The role combines hands\-on first\-level troubleshooting with strong coordination skills \- you'll be the first point of contact for users and the key link between our team and external software/hardware vendors. We also value working knowledge of AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, drafting, and day\-to\-day tasks. Clear communication, ownership, and consistent follow\-up are at the heart of this job.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L1 (first\-level) IT support to end users for hardware, software, network, email, and login issues.
* Log, track, and resolve support tickets promptly; escalate to L2/L3 or vendors when needed.
* Coordinate with software and hardware vendors for issue resolution, installations, updates, licenses, and warranty/AMC support.
* Follow up persistently with vendors and internal teams until issues are fully closed — no loose ends.
* Set up and configure desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals for new and existing users.
* Support basic network connectivity, Wi\-Fi, and access\-related issues.
* Maintain accurate records of assets, tickets, vendor interactions, and resolutions.
* Communicate clearly with users on issue status, expected timelines, and resolutions.
* Assist with routine IT maintenance, backups, and system checks.
* Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar assistants) to research solutions, draft communications, and resolve issues faster.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Basic L1 troubleshooting knowledge: Windows OS, MS Office, email clients, common business applications, printers, and basic networking.
* Strong command of language and communication — able to explain technical points simply to non\-technical users.
* Good vendor coordination and follow\-up skills; able to chase issues to closure.
* Comfortable handling multiple requests and prioritizing without dropping tasks.
* Working knowledge of AI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar) and how to apply them practically for support, troubleshooting, and documentation.



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Active and proactive — takes initiative rather than waiting to be told.
* Honest and trustworthy — handles systems and data with integrity.
* Strong work ethic — committed, reliable, and focused; no slacking or shortcuts.
* Service\-minded — patient and approachable with users.
* Willing to work on\-site at the assigned location.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Diploma / Degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 0–3 years of experience in IT support / helpdesk (freshers with the right attitude and basics may apply).



  





**What We Offer** 



* A stable, on\-site role with clear responsibilities.
* Exposure to vendor management and end\-to\-end issue ownership.
* A team that values reliability, honesty, and clear communication.

title: Lab Technician
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Lab Technician
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 Lab technician to support end\-to\-end software, firmware and product testing and validation. Assists the Lab Lead with build\-out and design.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build, cable, configure, maintain and document lab systems, devices and test environments under the direction of the Lab Lead.
* Execute end\-to\-end software, firmware, configuration and product test plans and record clear, reproducible results.
* Support Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android plus enterprise AV endpoints, peripherals and infrastructure.
* Provision and reset devices using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID and approved deployment procedures.
* Monitor device health, collect logs, reproduce reported defects and support technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Maintain lab inventory, asset labels, firmware and software baselines, test accounts, spares and configuration records.
* Assist with rack, room and bench build\-out, including connectivity checks and safe equipment handling.
* Raise defects with complete evidence, track retesting and help maintain test scripts, knowledge articles and operating procedures.
* Coordinate with engineering, vendors and support teams while following lab access, change and security controls.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Technical diploma, degree or relevant hands\-on experience in AV, IT, electronics or a related field.
* Practical troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to executing and documenting tests.
* Good written and verbal English communication and the ability to work effectively with distributed teams.
* Attention to detail, safe working practices, customer orientation and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to manage multiple test tasks, shifting priorities and repetitive validation activities accurately.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Hands\-on Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android deployment, configuration and lifecycle support.
* Enterprise AV systems installation, integration and troubleshooting, including cameras, microphones, speakers, displays, DSPs and control devices.
* Windows and Android device troubleshooting plus basic Microsoft 365 administration awareness.
* Microsoft Intune device management, Autopilot provisioning and Microsoft Entra ID fundamentals.
* Basic networking knowledge including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP and device connectivity.
* PowerShell fundamentals for device checks, log collection and repeatable tasks.
* Experience using monitoring and management platforms such as Teams Admin Center, Control Hub, Poly Lens or Neat Pulse.
* Ability to follow test plans, capture evidence and maintain accurate inventory and configuration documentation.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Azure Administration knowledge aligned to AZ\-104 concepts.
* Azure Monitor and Log Analytics exposure.
* Power Automate, Logic Apps or Microsoft Graph API familiarity.
* Python or scripting experience for test automation.
* ServiceNow incident, request and asset\-management experience.
* AV industry certification such as CTS or relevant Crestron training.
* Experience with secure print, smart lockers or workplace spaces technology.


**What We Look For**
* We’re looking for a dependable, curious and detail\-oriented technician who enjoys hands\-on testing, follows disciplined processes and communicates defects clearly.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on challenging projects and gain access to an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: You’ll have the tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: You’ll gain the insights, coaching and confidence to help build the leadership capabilities the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

***Who We Are***
 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best\-in\-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out\-of\-the\-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.
   

  

***What We’re Looking For***
 The Customer Bug (Jira) Analysis Team is a team within SOTI's Executive Escalations team that consists of team members with intensive EMM (SOTI MobiControl) product knowledge, proven customer\-facing, troubleshooting and escalations experience. Also skilled with deep\-level analysis of JIRA tickets. The team’s main function is to thoroughly analyze, debug, and provide fixes or workarounds to incoming JIRA tickets before reaching the core development team. The contribution of this team will in turn result in high\-quality bug tickets that truly need code fixes and will also alleviate workloads from developers. Software Analyst is responsible for reviewing and troubleshooting JIRA tickets coming from various departments such as the Technical Support team, Professional Services, Pre\-Sales, etc. The role involves critical issue analysis and research, testing, and advanced\-level troubleshooting techniques. Code referral and fix suggestions are also needed to identify potential bugs and solutions, respectively.

 \- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry\-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.

You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.

* Familiar with Git, software development, and the JIRA platform
* Familiar with Agile and project management
* Knowledgeable in SQL, Windows, and server management and administration
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts and various IT architectures and infrastructures

title: MS Exchange Administrator
description:

 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 350,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Responsible for supporting and administering global Messaging and Directory services, with primary accountability for Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching, maintenance and related infrastructure activities.
   

  

 The role also requires working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange to support end\-to\-end service operations, troubleshooting and coordination across the messaging environment.
   

  

 This entails following ITIL methodologies and may include infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, migrations, vendor coordination, documentation, knowledge sharing and training of team members.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises administration and infrastructure support.
* Plan, coordinate and execute Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching activities, including Security Updates (SUs), Hotfix Updates (HUs), Cumulative Updates (CUs), Windows updates and required prerequisites.
* Review Microsoft security advisories, release notes, known issues, prerequisites and dependencies, and translate them into patch\-readiness assessments and implementation plans.
* Prepare Exchange servers for maintenance using approved procedures, including service health checks, Database Availability Group (DAG) and database validations, transport queue checks, load\-balancer coordination and server maintenance mode.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures and post\-patching issues using Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, PowerShell, HealthChecker output and other approved diagnostic tools.
* Create and manage change records, implementation plans, validation evidence, rollback plans, stakeholder communications and closure documentation in accordance with established change\-management processes.
* Coordinate patching across production and non\-production environments, including maintenance windows, shift coverage, technical bridge support, vendor engagement and escalation to Microsoft Support when required.
* Provide operational support for Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and escalation of cloud\-side issues.
* Share technical knowledge through operational documentation and classroom or hands\-on training.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong ownership of Exchange Server On\-Premises patching in large, business\-critical environments.
* Methodical approach to patch assessment, risk identification, dependency validation, implementation, validation and rollback planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across Exchange Server, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, networking and load\-balancing dependencies.
* Ability to work effectively during critical maintenance windows, service\-impacting incidents and accelerated security\-patching activities.
* Strong attention to detail in change records, technical procedures, validation evidence, server inventories and compliance reporting.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, implementation status and service impact clearly to technical teams, service owners, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong teamwork, organization, prioritization and time\-management skills in a globally distributed and cross\-cultural environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to standardize patching processes and identify safe automation opportunities.
* Willingness to share knowledge and provide classroom or hands\-on training to team members.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Exchange Server administration, including recent experience with Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and/or Subscription Edition.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing Exchange Server On\-Premises patching across multiple servers, including SUs, HUs, CUs, Windows updates, prerequisites, reboot coordination and rollback readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Exchange maintenance mode, DAGs, database copy health, transport queues, mail\-flow validation, certificates, virtual directories and post\-patching verification.
* Proficiency in Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, remote health checks, validation, reporting and automation.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and Exchange Online PowerShell.
* Experience working within ITIL incident, problem and change\-management processes, including implementation planning, rollback planning, testing, evidence collection and closure.
* Experience supporting a large, highly available or geographically distributed Exchange environment and coordinating with infrastructure teams, monitoring teams, vendors and Microsoft Support.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, sound judgment, cross\-cultural awareness and effective stakeholder\-management skills.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, night shifts, weekends and critical security\-patching windows when required.


**Technical skills to include:**
* Microsoft Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Security Update, Hotfix Update, Cumulative Update and Windows patch deployment.
* Patch\-readiness assessment, maintenance mode, pre\-patching and post\-patching validation, and rollback planning.
* Exchange DAGs, databases, database copy health, transport services, mail\-flow components, connectors, certificates, namespaces and virtual directories.
* Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, automation, reporting and remote server health validation.
* Exchange HealthChecker, Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, SCOM or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange administration, troubleshooting and mail flow.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with Exchange HealthChecker, SCOM or equivalent monitoring platforms, load balancers and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* Knowledge of Exchange high availability, backup, disaster recovery, site resilience, email security, archiving and retention.
* Experience improving or automating patching workflows, compliance reporting and post\-patching validation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance, Exchange Online Protection and Defender for Office 365\.
* Experience managing Exchange certificates, TLS configuration, namespaces and certificate\-renewal activities.
* Experience supporting Hybrid Configuration Wizard activities and troubleshooting hybrid mail flow and connectivity.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support during critical patching or service\-restoration activities.


**What We Look For**
* A technically strong Exchange On\-Premises administrator who can independently own patching activities from assessment and change planning through implementation, validation and evidence\-based closure.
* A reliable team member who works safely in a controlled enterprise environment, communicates risks early and collaborates effectively across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in night shifts or outside standard business hours when required for maintenance and critical security updates.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation and stability of services. The position includes providing support through remote and onsite engagements, adhering to established procedures and operational frameworks to maintain high\-quality service delivery and minimize downtime.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform and Azure DevOps.

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to Kubernetes, AKS clusters and related components like Istio, GitOps, Autoscaling, Helm, Kustomize etc. Need to troubleshoot issues related to Terraform during AKS Cluster deployment.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure.
  

  

ITSM: Need to work on incidents, Change Requests, RCAs, CMDB etc.
  

  

Documentation: Need to create documentation related to AKS.
  

  

Shifts and On\-call: Need to work on night shifts and on\-calls on a rotational basis, as and when required by the team.
  

  

Meetings and Calls: Need to participate in various calls and discussions with different teams as AKS SME and to share required inputs as Kubernetes / AKS SME.  

  

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps.


Kubernetes : In\-depth knowledge of Kubernetes concepts, architecture, and administration.
  

  

Should have in\-depth knowledge on core Kubernetes concepts like Pods, Deployments, Services, Namespaces, PVs, PVCs, Storage Classes, Role Assignments, Kubernetes Networking, PDBs, HPA etc. Need to have proficiency on working with kubectl tool. Need to have good knowledge and understanding on YAML files related to Kubernetes.
  

  

AKS : Should have in\-depth knowledge on AKS concepts like Node Pools, AKS RBAC, AKS upgradation, Node OS upgradation, AKS Monitoring, AKS Logging, Workload Identity etc.
  

  

Azure DevOps: Working knowledge of Azure DevOps , which includes Azure Repo, branching strategy, pull requests, and git commands. Must know how to use Azure DevOps through IDE tool like VS Code.
  

  

Azure : Proficiency in using Azure services, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  

  

Should have good knowledge on Azure Services like VNet, Subnet, UDR, NSG, Private Endpoint, Private DNS, Managed Identity, Role Assignment, Key Vault, Storage Account , Load Balancer etc.
  

  

Terraform: Should have experience in using terraform to deploy Azure Services and AKS Cluster.
  

  

AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform.
  

  

Monitoring and Logging: Should have good knowledge on monitoring and logging solutions to gain insights into cluster performance, application behavior, and resource usage.
  

  

Security: Should have good knowledge on security best practices for AKS, including RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), network policies, and secure container images.
  

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to AKS clusters, Kubernetes, Terraform, and infrastructure components.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure, using in\-line or blue\-green upgradation approach.
  

  

GitOps : Working knowledge of any of the GitOps tool (Flux / ArgoCD) is preferred.
  

  

Service Mesh : Knowledge of a Service Mesh product (ex: Istio) is preferred.
  

  

Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve issues related to Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  

  

Cloud Native Ecosystem: Awareness of other cloud\-native tools and technologies such as Istio, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

Communication and Teamwork: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.
   

  

 At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Support Engineer – L1
   

  

**Location:** 
 Onsite – Bangalore
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Position Summary**
 To enhance our global support team, we are hiring a Technical Support Engineer – L1 with strong and proven customer service experience in the IT market to be based in our Bangalore, India office. The role will provide professional technical support to Kaseya customers through chats, phones, and tickets, while meeting or exceeding internal KPI targets and expectations. The successful candidate will bring strong problem\-solving skills, technical troubleshooting expertise, and a professional, courteous, customer\-first attitude.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide L1 technical support to Kaseya customers through chat, phone, and ticket\-based channels while maintaining a professional and customer\-first approach.
* Troubleshoot Linux/UNIX and Windows operating systems, including system boot, BIOS/UEFI, hardware, and Windows Server issues.
* Perform basic virtualization troubleshooting across VMware and Hyper\-V environments.
* Use Linux commands and PuTTY/SSH to investigate and troubleshoot technical issues, including basic system and application log analysis.
* Support Windows Server Core administration, including roles and features, disk management, Active Directory permissions/ACLs, and Group\-related administration.
* Troubleshoot storage and recovery environments involving NAS, SAN, tape, USB, RAID, virtual storage, and common file systems such as NTFS, FAT, and ext4\.
* Troubleshoot networking issues using the OSI model and TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS concepts, CLI tools, firewall rules, ports, latency, and packet\-related troubleshooting.
* Meet or exceed internal support KPIs and expectations while contributing to customer satisfaction and maintaining strong technical and communication standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and Windows operating systems, virtualization technologies (VMware and Hyper\-V), and Windows server/workstation hardware.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux commands, PuTTY/SSH, system boot troubleshooting, BIOS/UEFI, and basic system/application log analysis.
* Knowledge of Windows Server Core administration, Active Directory permissions/ACLs, Group administration, storage technologies, file systems, and backup/recovery concepts.
* Basic knowledge of networking and troubleshooting, including OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, firewall rules, ports, latency, and CLI tools such as ping, ipconfig, Nmap, and traceroute.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven customer service experience in an IT support environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry\-accepted certification or equivalent work experience in CompTIA A\+.
* CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Server\+, or CompTIA Security\+ certification or equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator certification or equivalent experience.
* Red Hat Linux certification or equivalent experience.
* VMware VCP certification or equivalent virtualization experience.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification or equivalent cloud experience.
* Additional hands\-on experience with MS Exchange Server, MS SQL, or Oracle Database.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

description:
