title: IT Executive
description:
Job Tittle: IT Executive
 



 Shift: Rotational shift
 



 Location Bangalore
 



  





**About the company** 




  





 Pixis (Leapus Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a next\-generation marketing\-AI platform that harnesses the targeting capabilities of social media and digital advertising platforms. It takes an end\-to\-end approach to the identification, creation, and optimisation of ads — collecting data, understanding target\-group behaviour, creating the ad, and delivering the right content at the right time, so every customer receives uniquely relevant advertising on a one\-to\-one basis. Pixis works with brands such as Swiggy, Amazon, Rapido, HDFC Bank, TATA AIG, Yes Bank, GoAir, Livspace, and MPL Gaming, delivering an average upside of around 50% on CPL, CPI, CPC, and CPM, along with a significant improvement in acquired customer LTV.
 



  





**Role summary** 




 The IT Executive handles day\-to\-day IT support for employees, maintains the IT asset inventory, manages the office network, and assists the IT Manager with new IT projects and system rollouts. The role requires a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on IT operations experience and a strong, practical grasp of IT infrastructure and best practices.
 



  





**Scope** 




 The role is based in Bangalore, India and supports the Bangalore office and India\-based employees, with remote support extended to other Pixis group entities as needed. The IT Executive works closely with the People team on new\-hire and exit processes and with vendors on hardware procurement and repairs.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 Responsibilities are organised by area and are carried out under the direction of the IT Manager.
 



**IT Support** 




 • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and access issues for employees on macOS, Windows, and mobile devices.
 



 • Log and track tickets, resolve them within agreed timelines, and escalate to the IT Manager when needed.
 



 • Set up laptops and accounts for new hires; recover devices and revoke access when employees exit.
 



 • Maintain simple how\-to guides and conduct IT orientation for new employees.
 



**IT Asset Inventory** 




 • Maintain an up\-to\-date inventory of all hardware assets — assignment, serial number, condition, warranty, and location.
 



 • Coordinate laptop procurement, tagging, deployment, repairs, and secure disposal of old equipment.
 



 • Track software licenses and remove unused licenses to control cost.
 



**Network Management** 




 • Manage and monitor the office network — firewalls, switches, Wi\-Fi access points, and internet links.
 



 • Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues; make routine configuration changes as approved.
 



 • Keep network documentation current and coordinate with ISP and building IT teams when required.
 



**IT Projects \& Systems** 




 • Assist in the design and deployment of new IT systems and services — office setups, network upgrades, and tool rollouts.
 



 • Assess vendors and test new hardware and software before company\-wide rollout.
 



 • Document setup steps and standards for the changes delivered.
 



**Monitoring \& Improvement** 




 • Monitor the performance of IT systems and report issues, ticket trends, and costs to the IT Manager.
 



 • Recommend improvements to IT infrastructure, tools, and processes. • Ensure endpoint security basics are in place — device management enrolment, patching, and antivirus/EDR coverage.
 



**Vendor Coordination** 




 • Liaise with hardware suppliers, repair centres, ISPs, and software vendors for quotes, orders, warranty claims, and renewals.
 



 • Maintain vendor contact details and the renewal calendar.
 



  





**Required qualifications** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience working in IT operations or IT support.
* Excellent working knowledge of computer systems, security, network and systems administration, databases and data storage systems, and phone systems.
* Hands\-on experience with office networking — firewalls, switches, and access points — including basic configuration and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Windows and macOS troubleshooting, and of Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 user administration.
* Strong critical thinking and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent IT skills and a strong ability to prioritise across tickets, projects, and walk\-up requests.
* A firm grasp of IT infrastructure and operations best practices.
* Good communication skills — able to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical employees and leadership.

title: IT Admin and Support Specialist
description:
ReOrbit is looking for an IT Admin and Support Specialist to provide hands\-on IT support and administration for our growing Bangalore office.
   

  

 As our IT Admin and Support Specialist, you will be the primary on\-site IT presence in Bangalore, ensuring that employees, devices and local infrastructure are properly supported and ready to operate. You will take ownership of everything from hardware lifecycle management and employee onboarding to access controls, device management and local IT troubleshooting.
   

  

 You will work closely with ReOrbit's IT Infrastructure, Operations \& Support teams, particularly HQ in Helsinki, helping to implement global standards, policies and security requirements locally. You will also play an important role in establishing Bangalore as part of ReOrbit's follow\-the\-sun support model, providing remote support to colleagues across other locations when required.
   

  

 It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start\-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the local hardware inventory for the Bangalore office, including device setup, repair, replacement, lifecycle management and shipment coordination.
* Provide hands\-on support for regional IT projects, technology rollouts and infrastructure initiatives in Bangalore.
* Own the onboarding and offboarding process for Bangalore employees, including device provisioning, account setup, security requirements and access controls.
* Manage and support local physical security systems, including CCTV and access\-related infrastructure.
* Support the implementation of HQ\-driven security policies, processes and IT standards at the Bangalore location.
* Support Microsoft Active Directory design and administration, including Group Policy management and cloud or hybrid server environments.
* Manage software licences and subscriptions for Bangalore\-based users and devices.
* Deploy and maintain standardised laptop and mobile device configurations.
* Troubleshoot local server, infrastructure and end\-user technology issues.
* Manage Windows support tickets and provide timely resolution or escalation where required.
* Administer MDM enrolment and device lifecycle processes for Bangalore devices.
* Provide remote support to other ReOrbit locations as part of the follow\-the\-sun IT support model.
* Coordinate with the global IT team and escalate infrastructure, security or service issues to Helsinki when required.
* Maintain accurate documentation of local IT assets, configurations, procedures and support activities.


**Skills And Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration and end\-user support, ideally supporting a regional, satellite or multi\-site office.
* Hands\-on experience with hardware inventory management, device repair and replacement, and end\-to\-end device lifecycle management.
* Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, security and physical access controls.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy and cloud or hybrid server administration.
* Experience with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools for device management and onboarding or offboarding.
* Strong Windows end\-user support and troubleshooting skills.
* Comfortable working as the primary on\-site IT presence and independently managing local priorities while escalating to global teams when needed.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to support and implement globally defined policies and processes locally.
* Strong organisational and documentation skills.


**What does ReOrbit do?**
 ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software\-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.
   

  

 ReOrbit’s top\-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in\-house software, procure hardware from the best\-in\-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Working at ReOrbit**
 At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.
   

  

 We offer
   

  

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance \- but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society.


 Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications
   

  

 and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era.
   

  

 The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies
   

  

*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

title: Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer - SaaS Product Support
description:
Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer \- SaaS Product Support
 


 Bengaluru \| Hybrid • Full\-time \| UK business hours • Compensation: up to 5 LPA
 





 Technical Support Engineer \| Application Support Engineer \| Product Support \| Software Support \| SaaS Support \| Customer Support \| Ticket Management \| Incident Management
 




 About the role
 


 Script Assist is hiring junior Technical Support / Application Support Engineers to investigate and resolve customer issues within our software platform.
 





 We are primarily looking for people with approximately 6\-24 months of professional support experience who already understand how to work from a ticket queue, respond to customer or user issues, gather information, investigate a problem, follow a support process, escalate appropriately, document what happened and keep ownership until resolution.
 





 You do not need healthcare experience. You do need some genuine professional experience supporting a software application, SaaS product or digital platform.
 




 You may currently be working as a:
 


 •  Technical Support Engineer
 





 •  Application Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Analyst
 





 •  Application Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Engineer
 





 •  Product Support Associate
 





 •  Software Support Engineer
 





 •  Software Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Associate
 





 •  SaaS Support Analyst
 





 •  SaaS Support Engineer
 





 •  Production Support Analyst
 





 •  Support Engineer
 





 •  Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Analyst
 





 •  Client Support Analyst
 





 •  Technical Customer Support Executive
 





 Your exact title is not important. What matters is that your current or previous work involved responding to software/application support tickets and helping resolve user or customer issues.
 




 About Script Assist
 


 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company. Our software supports complex private clinical and pharmacy services and connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 





 Our platform contains many interconnected workflows, users and roles, permissions, statuses, customer data, configuration, integrations and operational processes. Our support team helps customers understand and resolve problems when something does not behave as expected.
 





 Healthcare is a complex environment, but previous healthcare experience is not required. We will teach you the product and healthcare workflows.
 




  





 What you will do
 


 •  Receive and manage customer support tickets.
 





 •  Respond to customers and users clearly and professionally.
 





 •  Investigate reported software problems.
 





 •  Gather the information needed to understand an issue.
 





 •  Reproduce problems where possible.
 





 •  Review application behaviour and available information.
 





 •  Identify straightforward causes and resolutions.
 





 •  Escalate more complex issues with clear notes and evidence.
 





 •  Maintain accurate ticket histories and track issues through to resolution.
 





 •  Communicate updates to customers.
 





 •  Work with Product, Engineering, QA and Operations.
 





 •  Retest issues after fixes.
 





 •  Help maintain support documentation and identify repeated problems.
 





 •  Learn increasingly complex areas of the Script Assist platform.
 




 The type of person we want
 


 You are likely to have approximately 6\-24 months of experience working in some form of software or application support. You already understand what it means to:
 





 •  Work from a queue and manage tickets or cases.
 





 •  Meet response expectations.
 





 •  Ask users the right questions.
 





 •  Document an issue properly.
 





 •  Follow up with another team and escalate when appropriate.
 





 •  Keep customers updated and close issues properly.
 





 You should also have very good spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, good organisation, a logical approach to problems, strong ownership, the ability to learn new software quickly and confidence communicating with customers and colleagues.
 




 Useful experience
 


 •  Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk or Salesforce.
 





 •  CRM or ticketing platforms.
 





 •  Incident management, application support, SaaS support or product support.
 





 •  Software troubleshooting, production support or issue reproduction.
 





 •  Basic SQL, databases, APIs or software testing.
 





 •  Root\-cause analysis.
 





 You do not need all of these.
 




 Healthcare experience
 


 Previous experience with healthcare software, EHR / EMR, HIS / HMIS, Practice Management Systems, clinical software or pharmacy software would be useful, but is not required.
 





 We are deliberately open to strong junior support candidates from other SaaS, fintech, ERP, e\-commerce, workflow, logistics or enterprise software businesses.
 




 What this role is not
 


 This is not primarily desktop or infrastructure support. Experience focused mainly on laptop repair, hardware support, printer support, network support, router / switch administration, Windows installation, NOC monitoring or generic IT helpdesk is less relevant.
 





 We want candidates whose experience is primarily about supporting users of software applications or digital products. This is also not a Software Developer, QA Tester, Automation Tester or Manual Testing role. We are recruiting for Customer / Product / Application Support.
 




 Why join Script Assist?
 


 This is an opportunity to build a career inside a growing international software company. You will work closely with Support, Product, Engineering, QA and Operations and gain experience supporting a sophisticated live SaaS platform.
 





 Strong performers can progress into Senior Technical Support, Product Support, Application Support, Technical Operations, Implementation, Business Analysis, Customer Success, QA or Product.
 




  






 If you already understand ticket\-based software support and want to develop quickly inside a more complex product environment, we would like to hear from you.

description:
**Summary:**



 As the Data Platform \& Production Support Engineer, you will oversee, optimize, and support our comprehensive enterprise data ecosystem, including Tableau Online, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Altimate AI, AWS EC2, OKTA, and Wisdom AI. This hybrid role combines system administration, identity and access management (IAM), AI\-enhanced workflow optimization, data pipeline oversight, and advanced tier\-2/3 support across business applications to ensure the security, performance, and reliability of our data platforms.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* Manage user provisioning, site administration, and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) across core data platforms, including Tableau Online, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Altimate AI, AWS EC2, Revifi, Obsidian, and Wisdom AI.
* Administer OKTA groups, application tiles, API credentials, and execute routine OAuth token rotations across all supported tools.
* Lead quarterly User Access Reviews (UAR) to ensure security compliance across Snowflake, Tableau Online, Fivetran, dbt, Wisdom AI, and related enterprise apps.
* Implement robust security measures, including managing service accounts, IP whitelisting, and formulating cross\-tool network policies.
* Monitor Tableau Online environment health and site performance, tracking dashboard load times, extract statuses, and user engagement via built\-in administrative views.
* Ensure the successful execution of scheduled data extracts and Tableau\-to\-Snowflake flow refreshes, quickly addressing any failures to prevent business downtime.
* Facilitate the deployment and publication of optimized dashboards post\-Change Advisory Board (CAB) approval.
* Conduct daily health checks on Fivetran connectors, provision new integrations, refresh expired tokens, validate data syncs, and partner with Fivetran support for advanced troubleshooting.
* Track dbt job execution and speed. Leverage Altimate AI to automate model documentation, enforce testing, track column\-level lineage, and perform blast radius impact analysis before code deployments.
* Maintain and support background engineering scripts and cron jobs on EC2 instances. Handle user/role administration, rotate credentials, and troubleshoot process failures.
* Monitor virtual warehouse compute performance, storage utilization, and query runtimes in Snowflake.
* Utilize Altimate AI FinOps features alongside Snowflake's auto\-suspend and scaling policies to pinpoint resource\-heavy queries, right\-size compute instances, and drive cost efficiencies.
* Provide ongoing administration and technical support for Wisdom AI, managing non\-SCIM manual user onboarding, RBAC, JIRA ticket workflows, and OKTA tile configurations upon manager approvals.
* Partner with Revifi support to resolve issues related to platform spend, data observability, and governance.
* Actively triage and resolve support tickets within the JIRA and Salesforce data queues.
* Spearhead Proofs of Concept (POCs) for evaluating new platforms, connectors, and AI tools, collaborating across teams for seamless implementation.
* Author and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), system configurations, and user documentation.


**Requirements:**
* Proven experience administering SaaS and cloud environments, particularly Tableau Online, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Altimate AI, AWS EC2, and specialized application platforms like Wisdom AI.


**Required Skills:**
* Deep knowledge of OKTA, RBAC methodologies, OAuth token management, non\-SCIM user provisioning, IP allowlisting, and executing UAR compliance audits.
* Familiarity with Altimate AI capabilities and AI\-assisted data tools for user support, documentation, and query execution.
* Advanced SQL proficiency for system troubleshooting and query optimization; capable of managing automated bash/Python scripts within Linux/EC2 environments.
* Strong grasp of modern ELT/ETL pipelines, data synchronization, and data quality platforms (e.g., Revifi).
* Skilled in navigating JIRA, Salesforce ticketing, Git version control, and Change Advisory Board (CAB) deployment standards.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration, technical documentation, and proactive system\-alert messaging.

description:
*Schneider Digital \| Global IT \| Integration \& API Development Focus*
**About Schneider Electric**
 Schneider Electric (SE) is the global specialist in energy management and automation. SE develops connected technologies and solutions to manage energy and processes in ways that are safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable. SE provides an integrated approach designed for the reality of the digital economy (Plant\-to\-Plug). The versatile product portfolio addresses all energy needs of industries as well as residential customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Schneider Digital**
 All IT needs for Schneider Electric are managed by a group called Schneider Digital (SD), spread across 303 locations in 60 countries with over 2,300 staff, along with various engagements with all major Global IT Service Providers. Schneider Digital drives the digital transformation agenda of the company by delivering best\-in\-class IT services, platforms, and solutions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a driven and technically astute DocuSign Application IT Owner \& Integration Analyst to join the Schneider Digital team. This role combines application ownership accountability with deep integration and API development expertise, serving as the central technical authority for the DocuSign platform within Schneider Electric's global IT landscape.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong hands\-on experience in designing, building, and maintaining integrations between DocuSign and enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other platforms via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven architectures. You will be responsible for ensuring seamless, reliable, and secure digital agreement workflows across the organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Application Ownership
   

  

* Act as the primary IT owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for the DocuSign application across Schneider Electric globally.
* Manage the full application lifecycle including onboarding, configuration, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
* Govern application SLAs, availability, and performance metrics; drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the DocuSign vendor and internal procurement teams for license management, support escalations, and contract negotiations.
* Maintain comprehensive application documentation including architecture diagrams, integration maps, and runbooks.


 Integration \& API Development
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain integrations between DocuSign and enterprise platforms (Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow etc.) using REST APIs, SOAP, and middleware tools.
* Implement Connect notifications, and event\-driven patterns to trigger downstream business processes in real time.
* Build and maintain integration middleware pipelines using tools such as Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi, or equivalent platforms.
* Develop and manage authentication flows using OAuth 2\.0 (JWT grant, Authorization Code grant) to securely connect DocuSign with enterprise applications.
* Create reusable integration components, code libraries, and templates to accelerate future integration delivery.


 Configuration \& Workflow Automation
   

  

* Design and configure DocuSign envelopes, templates, and signing workflows tailored to complex, multi\-stakeholder business scenarios.
* Automate contract lifecycle management processes including initiation, routing, signing, storage, and archival.
* Support DocuSign CLM and integrations where applicable.


 Support, Monitoring \& Governance
   

  

* Monitor integration health, API usage, envelope status, and failure alerts; drive rapid incident resolution.
* Provide support for DocuSign\-related integration issues, coordinating with business stakeholders, Middleware teams, and the DocuSign vendor.
* Ensure compliance with data security, GDPR, and information governance policies in all integration designs.
* Conduct regular audits of user access, API keys, connected apps, and integration configurations.
* Engage in CHRs release cycles for new integrations and significant enhancements.


 Stakeholder Engagement \& Delivery
   

  

* Partner with business team to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Present integration designs and solution proposals to technical and non\-technical stakeholders with clarity.


**Required Technical Skills**
* DocuSign eSignature REST API
* OAuth 2\.0 (JWT Bearer Grant, Authorization Code Grant), SAML 2\.0, SSO
* REST \& SOAP API development and consumption
* Middleware / iPaaS platforms: Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi, or equivalent
* JSON / XML data transformation and mapping
* Integration with Oracle Fusion HCM, SAP, Salesforce and ServiceNow platforms
* Scripting / programming proficiency: Python, JavaScript, or Java for API automation
* API management tools: Postman, API gateways
* Cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP (integration services context)
* Version control \& CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps


**Required Skills (Must Have)**
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise application integration and API development.
* Proven hands\-on experience with DocuSign administration and API\-based integrations.
* Strong techno\-functional expertise — ability to bridge business requirements and technical integration design.
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum methodology.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Experience working in a highly matrixed Global MNC environment with multiple stakeholders across geographies.
* Strong design thinking and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to work across global, distributed teams.

It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. title: Escalation Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As the Escalation Manager, Weekend Global Coverage, you will serve as the crucial command lead safeguarding customer trust during high\-stakes, critical events across AMER, APJ, and EMEA. Operating within our global follow\-the\-sun coverage model, you are the decisive voice when a Sev1 or critical customer event occurs, rapidly uniting engineering, support, and executive leadership to stabilize complex enterprise scenarios. This high\-impact role sets the standard for weekend operational excellence, turning chaotic technical crises into clear, swift paths to resolution and ensuring seamless cross\-regional transitions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

* Lead Executive \& Customer Communications: Translate fast\-moving, complex technical diagnostic details into precise, highly coherent updates for executive leadership and global enterprise customers, keeping stakeholders continuously aligned.
* Drive Global Follow\-the\-Sun Handovers: Execute complete, high\-quality shift handovers across regional teams, eliminating duplicated investigation, protecting customer context, and ensuring zero loss of momentum across time zones.
* Prevent Recurrent Risk: Track service restoration through to post\-incident review, capturing actionable root\-cause insights and partnering with functional owners to eliminate systemic operational or product risks.


**What You Bring**
* Incident Leadership Mastery: Proven background leading cross\-functional response teams through severe enterprise outages, data access incidents, or business\-critical infrastructure events under high\-pressure conditions.
* Strategic Communication \& Command: Superior ability to lead war rooms and synthesize complex enterprise technical issues into clear, impactful executive briefings and step\-by\-step customer action plans.
* Enterprise Tech \& Process Savvy: Functional understanding of enterprise infrastructure (such as storage, cloud platforms, or virtualization) alongside disciplined adherence to incident management frameworks.
* Operational Drive \& Ownership: High organization skills to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, establish rapid accountability, and meticulously track follow\-up commitments to complete resolution.
* Location \& Shift Availability: Ability to work a fixed Thursday–Monday operational shift structure. We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Technical Support Receptionist
description:
### **Description**

  

As a Receptionist supporting our Technical Support team, you are the crucial first point of contact for our customers. In this high\-volume role, you will answer incoming calls, capture key details about customer issues, and perform seamless warm transfers to available Tech Support Agents. You will also ensure misrouted calls reach the correct departments efficiently while maintaining a professional and welcoming demeanor.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Call Handling \& Intake:** Answer incoming calls promptly, maintaining a high volume of 30–40 calls daily per team member.
* **Troubleshooting Documentation:** Active\-listen to customer issues, capturing detailed, accurate notes on their technical inquiries and symptoms.
* **Warm Transfers:** Execute seamless, warm hand\-offs of qualified technical issues to available Tech Support agents with context provided.
* **Call Routing:** Direct misrouted or non\-technical calls efficiently to the appropriate internal departments.
* **Customer Care:** Act as the first point of contact, providing a professional and welcoming initial impression for all incoming callers.
* **High\-Level Escalation:** Solve complex hardware and firmware challenges, providing real\-time guidance on on\-site wiring, terminations, and device programming.
* **Agile Queue Management:** Thrive in a high\-volume environment, managing a "round\-robin" flow of emails and chats with precision and speed.
* **Emphasize Ownership, Urgency, and Positive Persistence:** Own issues that are presented to you and drive them with the urgency you would if it were you waiting for the solution. Persist in your efforts to resolve issues \- engaging with necessary resources inside and outside your team.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

 **Technical Mastery*** **Education:** B.E./B.Sc. in Electronics, Electrical, or Telecommunications.
* **Experience:** 1\+ years in a technical helpdesk or hardware support role.
* **The "Toolbox":** Solid understanding of electronic components (Relays, Resistors, etc.), low\-voltage power principles, and the ability to read circuit diagrams.
* **Networking:** Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, and networking troubleshooting. **CCNA or CompTIA Network\+** certifications are a major plus.

**Communication \& Soft Skills*** **Clarity:** You can explain a complex electrical ground loop issue simply and professionally.
* **Ownership:** A "stick\-to\-it" mindset. You own the problem until the dealer’s door locks and unlocks as intended.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable toggling between high\-level cloud software (SaaS) and "boots\-on\-the\-ground" hardware issues.
* **Communication:** Exceptional communication skills to deal with global clientele. We're looking at folks who have managed global communications in the past.

  

### **About Brivo**

  

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.  

  

As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.  

  

With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.  

  

*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

**Job Description**

 We are looking for a talented Technical Support Specialist to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
   

  





 The
 **Technical Support Specialist** 
 is the
 **first line of support** 
 for Sectigo's growing global customer base — enterprises, partners, and organizations that rely on our industry\-leading security solutions to protect their digital infrastructure. This individual works in a structured, collaborative support environment where their networking knowledge, troubleshooting instincts, and customer communication skills are put to work every day.
   

  

  

  

 Please Note: The Reporting Manager and the Work Arrangement requirements may be modified and redesigned based on business needs to ensure operational flexibility and organizational effectiveness.
   

  





  

  

 This is a full\-time and in\-office position, working 5 days a week from our Chennai office at DLF IT Park, Manapakkam.
   

  





 Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:
   

  





**Customer Support \& Engagement**



* Serve as the
 **first point of contact** 
 for inbound technical support requests submitted via phone, email, and chat.
* Deliver prompt, clear, empathetic, and professional responses to customers of varying technical backgrounds.
* Conduct structured troubleshooting conversations to quickly identify, isolate, and document customer issues.
* Guide customers step\-by\-step through technical problems using approved knowledge base articles and support workflows.
* Proactively communicate case status updates to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the resolution process.



**Technical Troubleshooting \& Issue Management**



* Apply strong
 **network and systems troubleshooting skills** 
 to diagnose and resolve common technical issues.
* Utilize internal tools, ticketing systems, and external resources to investigate reported problems efficiently.
* Prioritize and manage multiple open cases simultaneously, adhering to SLA (Service Level Agreement) response and resolution targets.
* Accurately document all findings, steps taken, and outcomes in the support ticketing system to support auditability and root cause tracking.
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate trends to Team Leads for further investigation.



**Escalation \& Team Collaboration**



* Recognize when a case requires escalation and ensure a
 **high\-quality handoff** 
 to senior support staff or specialist teams, complete with:
	+ Clear problem summaries
	+ Diagnostic data, logs, and screenshots
	+ Reproduction steps and customer environment details
* Collaborate with Shift Leads, Team Leads, and cross\-functional teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Participate in team meetings, quality reviews, and training sessions to continuously sharpen your skills.



**Knowledge \& Process Contribution**



* Contribute to the team's internal
 **knowledge base** 
 by documenting resolved issues, common troubleshooting steps, and customer\-facing FAQs.
* Follow established support procedures to ensure consistency, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by flagging process gaps or recurring friction points to team leadership.
* Participate in additional projects and initiatives aligned with the team's goals and Requirements



 Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Education:**



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Administration, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience is strongly recommended.



**Experience:**



* Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support, help desk, IT administration, or network operations role.
* 1–3 years of experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using ticketing or service desk platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills are required. Additional language proficiency is a significant asset.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and network troubleshooting methodologies is required.
* Working knowledge of DNS (Domain Name System) — record types, resolution, and common misconfigurations is required.
* Familiarity with Active Directory and directory services concepts is required.
* Experience with Windows Server and/or Linux environments is required.
* Comfort using command\-line tools for diagnostics (e.g., ping, tracert, nslookup, curl, netstat) is required.
* Understanding of web technologies including HTTP/HTTPS, web servers, and hosting platforms is required.
* Familiarity with API request/response structures and basic web security principles is required.



 The following certifications are considered an excellent fit for this role and will be given significant weight in the hiring process:
   

  




* CompTIA Network\+ or CompTIA Security\+
* Cisco CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)
* CompTIA A\+ or CompTIA CySA\+
* Microsoft, AWS, or equivalent cloud/infrastructure certifications are also an asset.



**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**



* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with attention to detail and ability to multitask.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in different time zones, rotational shifts with Skeletal staffing on weekends.
* Superior customer service and phone mannerism required to handle support of Sectigo's customer base.
* Experience working with customers across geographies like US \& UK customers.
* Computer literacy skills, including the use of email, and word processing applications.
* Possess qualities such as integrity, curiosity, fair\-mindedness, and a persuasive, team player.
* Ability to thrive in a start\-up environment while applying existing skill sets and training to increase knowledge base.
* Must be able to work shifts, including holidays based on business needs, with possible weekends and after\-hours.
* Must be willing to carry the after\-hour support pager.

 At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.
   

  





 Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

 To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.
   

  





**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**
  

  

  

 At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston\-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
 



 Discover us at www.gradiant.com.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 The L1 IT Infrastructure Administrator \& IT Procurement Specialist is responsible for providing first\-level IT infrastructure support and managing end\-user computing services, while playing a key role in IT procurement activities. A significant focus of this role is engaging with internal business stakeholders to understand their technology requirements, identifying and evaluating suitable vendors and solutions, coordinating procurement activities, and ensuring partner deliverables are tracked and fulfilled on time. Contract negotiation and partner finalization are handled by a dedicated Procurement team; this role focuses on the upstream requirements and solution\-alignment work as well as downstream delivery follow\-up.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**IT Procurement \& Vendor Coordination** 



* Engage with internal stakeholders (IT, Finance, Operations, HR, etc.) to gather and clarify business technology requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear technical and functional specifications for vendor evaluation.
* Research, identify, and shortlist vendors based on capability, fit, track record, and pricing benchmarks.

* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations; validate technical compliance with requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors during active engagements, ensuring: Timely delivery, Milestone tracking, Escalation of delays or quality issues
* Maintain procurement trackers for: Purchase requests, Expected vs. actual delivery, Issue resolution status
* Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams for: Purchase Requisitions (PRs), Purchase Orders (POs), Service Entry Sheets (SES), Invoice approvals
* Track IT contracts, software subscriptions, and warranties; proactively manage renewals.
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory including hardware, software licenses, and accessories.
* Ensure license compliance and monitor minimum stock levels.
* Support vendor onboarding documentation and maintain updated supplier records.
* Assist in budgeting, cost tracking, and identifying IT cost optimization opportunities.
* Ensure all procurement activities adhere to company policies, approval workflows, and audit standards.



**IT Infrastructure Support (L1\)** 



* Provide Level 1 support for end\-user devices including laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Support Microsoft 365 services such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
* Manage user accounts in: Active Directory, Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365
* Handle device onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle management.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, and connectivity issues.
* Assist in deployment and management of Microsoft Intune\-managed devices.
* Support endpoint security tools including: Antivirus, BitLocker, Conditional Access policies
* Monitor IT alerts and escalate issues to higher support levels when needed.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Support office infrastructure including switches, Wi\-Fi access points, conference room systems, and ISP connectivity.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty claims, and service requests.



  





**Requirements**

description:

 At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935\. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50\+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.
   

  

 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
   

  

 At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Diagnostic Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**Company Overview:**
 https://www.msxi.com/en/
   

  

 At
 **MSX International** 
 , we’ve been partnering with leading automotive companies for over 25 years, helping them enhance their retail strategies and streamline operations. Our expertise in areas like dealer performance, repair optimization, and consumer engagement positions us as a trusted partner in the evolving mobility industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 The Diagnostic Support Engineer will be responsible for monitoring DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) and CAN (Controller Area Network) parameters at the Command Centre (CC) 24/7\. The role involves guiding customers and drivers, managing escalations, and coordinating with dealers to resolve vehicle issues efficiently.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 24/7 Monitoring: Monitor DTC/CAN parameters at the Command Centre and raise tickets immediately when an issue is detected.
* Ticketing: Respond to triggered DTC/CAN alerts by creating internal tickets in the DMS system (with automation in phase 2\).
* Customer Assistance: Provide Level 1 (L1\) support over the phone, guiding customers/drivers to resolve minor issues.
* Critical DTCs: For vehicles with critical DTCs (e.g., "Service Now" category), guide them to the nearest dealer.
* Vehicle Breakdown: If a vehicle is immovable, or if further damage could occur, instruct the dealer to reach the vehicle’s location.
* Issue Tracking: Coordinate with dealers to ensure the issue/ticket is resolved completely and in a timely manner.
* Management Reporting: Provide daily, weekly, monthly, and ad\-hoc reports on vehicle issues and resolution status.
* KPI Tracking: Track and report KPI targets in the required format.
* Job Card Analysis: Conduct job card analysis, focusing on cost avoidance, analytics, and reporting for continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**
* Experience in customer support, vehicle service, or command centre operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills for guiding customers and coordinating with dealers.
* Familiarity with DMS systems, ticketing tools, and vehicle diagnostics (DTC/CAN).
* Ability to work in a 24/7 environment and handle critical issues efficiently.
* Strong analytical skills for reporting and KPI tracking.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Location:** 
 Oragadam, Tamil Nadu
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\-2 years
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Automotive
   

  

**Working Days :** 
 6 days (Rotational week off \& National Holidays)
   

  

 MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting\-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go\-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research\-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity \& Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data\-driven solutions.
 



 We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end\-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.
 



 In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.
 








**What will you do in this role?** 



* Business Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.

* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API\-based systems.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

Job Summary :


Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.


Role Definition :


Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.


Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction** \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* **Client Access Setup –** Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues.
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible.
* **Issue Resolution** \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption.
* **Escalation** \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level.
* **Documentation** \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team.


Skills :

**Broad Knowledge** \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem\-Solving** \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication** \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability** \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.


Tasks :

**Responding to Cases** \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics** \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions** \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues** \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario** \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

* Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs.
* Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity.
* Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly.
* Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation.


Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
* 0\-1 year of experience (Experience preferred)
* Key Skills:
	+ Ms. Excel (Intermediate)
	+ Ms. PowerPoint (Basic)
* Problem Solving (Intermediate)
* Analytical skills (Basic)
* Active Listening, Understanding \& Empathy (Advanced)
* Email Writing skills (Intermediate)
* Fundamental understanding of the Customer Support process and techniques
* Proficient in the English language
* Basic understanding of the customer environment and NIQ tools in use
* Exchanges straightforward information
* Technically/digitally savvy

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

description:

 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Executive Support \& IT Operations provides end\-to\-end L1, L2, and L3 technical support, with a strong focus on Executive/VIP Support. The role supports Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, Windows and macOS endpoints, Exchange Online, Zoom and Zoom Rooms, Jira Service Management, PagerDuty, and SharePoint. Responsibilities include resolving complex incidents, managing executive devices and technology refreshes, supporting leadership meetings and company events, administering user access and endpoint policies, and improving support operations through documentation, reporting, and PowerShell automation. The engineer also mentors junior team members and collaborates with global IT teams to deliver secure, reliable, and customer\-focused technology services.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Zelis is seeking an experienced
 **IT Support Engineer** 
 to provide combined
 **L1, L2, and L3 technical support** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **Executive/VIP White Glove Support and IT Operations** 
 .

The engineer will own technical issues from initial intake through resolution while providing proactive, discreet, and highly responsive support across Microsoft technologies, endpoints, collaboration platforms, incidents, events, automation, and service improvement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Executive and VIP Support

* Manage Jira VIP incidents and service requests, ensuring rapid acknowledgement, clear communication, appropriate escalation, and timely resolution.
* Support executive Windows and macOS devices, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, peripherals, connectivity, and collaboration tools.

 L1, L2, and L3 Technical Support

* Identify recurring issues and implement improvements that increase first\-contact resolution and reduce repeat incidents.


 Microsoft and Endpoint Administration
   

  

* Manage and support Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including virtual machines, user accounts, groups, identity services, endpoints, and device policies.
* Administer and troubleshoot Exchange Online, including mailboxes, permissions, distribution groups, shared mailboxes, email, and calendar issues.
* Support employee onboarding, access changes, and offboarding in coordination with HR, security, and application owners.
