title: Apprentice
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a dedicated and motivated individual to join our team as a Apprentice Technician in the IT industry. As an Apprentice Technician, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop skills in troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining computer hardware systems. This is an entry\-level position suitable for individuals with a passion for technology and a desire to kick\-start their career in the field.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with experienced technicians and be exposed to a wide range of computer hardware components and systems. You will provide support and assistance in diagnosing and resolving technical issues, as well as participate in the installation and configuration of computer hardware/Software.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Assist in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving hardware and software issues
* Perform routine maintenance and repairs on computer systems, including replacing faulty components
* Install, configure, and test computer hardware components and peripherals
* Assist in the monitoring and maintenance of network security systems.
* Troubleshoot network issues and perform necessary repairs or replacements.
* Assist in the installation of computer networks, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Provide technical support to end\-users in a timely and efficient manner
* Collaborate with team members to ensure the smooth operation of SITA systems
* Keep accurate records of repairs, maintenance tasks, and inventory
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in computer hardware technology and industry trends.


**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE:**
 No prior experience required. Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Education \& Qualifications**
* Diploma, Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field equivalent.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware components and systems
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of network hardware, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Should be flexible to work evenings or weekends as required.
* This role requires flexibility to work in rotating shifts, including night shifts.
* Ability to stay composed and perform effectively in high\-pressure environments.


 Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

* Must be able to adapt quickly to new processes, tools, and technologies.


  

  

* Having valid Indian passport will be an advantage.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
 **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** 
 and
 **Airport Council International** 
 \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like
 **Pluralsight** 
 for technology upskilling,
 **Harvard Business Publishing** 
 for people leadership,
 **Stanford** 
 for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
   

  

 🙌

 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required

description:

**NewCo Build**
**Job Description**
**Job Title Change Management Specialist**
**Function: (Category for Job Posting)**
**Job Summary:**
 The Service Management (SM) Change Management Specialist role is responsible for monitoring the ongoing ‘wellnesses of Information Technology (IT) Change Management processes, procedures and policies. The role drives the analytical review of the relevant processes, scheduled reporting and other metrics to confirm that the end\-to\-end processes are operating in a Business as Usual (BAU) mode or to identify exceptions to same. The role leads discussions with Change Lead and /or business leaders on identified process exceptions and recommends potential solutions to rectify breaks in a specific process. The role requires a solid working knowledge of and certification in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework as part of the role’s core mandate to drive best practices in the alignment of business needs to IT capabilities. The role acts as thought leader in the use of the Service Management tool as trainer to the user population and are advanced users of its monitoring capabilities for IT’s processes. The role may have management responsibility for the Process Analysts who provide the process analytics and is generally guided by the Change Process Lead.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Designs, assesses and delivers the performance analysis of all day\-to\-day Change process under its remit to determine the stability of local, area, global IT applications and the effectiveness of their processes, procedures and policies. Examines Critical Success Factors (CSF), Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and other key metrics produced on a daily, weekly or monthly basis as a critical component of the analysis.
* Defines and coordinates senior level meetings inclusive of monthly services reviews and more frequent meetings to identify root cause of change failures with intent to improve production stability. Identifies change caused outages in co\-ordination with Incident Management and drives input into Continuous Service Improvement and/or Risk Registers.
* Engages with Incident, Problem, Release Management and consults in major outage discussions/meetings as a thought leader on current processes and adds valued insight across senior members of the organization on efforts to restore overall services.
* Actively participates and works with lead/ other stakeholders in design, build and maintenance of CMDB
* Assumes and drives responsibility for escalation actions, as needed, when it is observed that the appropriate IT process is not being adhered to.
* Organizes and leads appropriate post mortem activities with senior members of the organization on Change processes not executed appropriately and drives follow through on actions identified as a result.
* Drives adherence to NewCo build’s compliance standards of IT processes and procedures wherever applicable. Develops and directs practices to improve compliance mandates and/or identifies and implements improvements in process/procedures to support existing compliance directives.
* Leads and coordinates meetings with all levels of the organization directly or under guidance of Lead to review existing KPIs and other metrics aligned to a specific process to drive continued improvements and production stability and/or end user satisfaction. Identifies \& assesses risks, forecasts challenges and opportunities and provides related recommendations including the proposed creation of new KPIs and other modifications based on analysis.
* Engages with vendors for getting root cause and solution of the issues as required.
* Researches, recommends, develops, and implements updates and amendments to the Service Management tool to reflect identified enhancements or changes to process and procedures. Partners with the Quality Management and Automation team to develop and implement necessary modifications to the tool so that it reflects the latest services, procedures and activities.
* Designs and develops training materials, communiques and related documentation to inform and train IT users in the Change process and tool and to embed the process as part of the required business knowledge of the IT organization.
* Ascertains best practices in aligning business needs to an IT organization by maintaining a strong knowledge of industry standards in process management through formal certification and training in the ITIL framework and a knowledge of current and proposed future state of IT processes and procedures
* A good knowledge in dashboards and reporting
* Willingness to work on required automation initiatives and understanding of the same will be added advantage
* Should be willing to work during weekends and in rotational shifts


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires a strong analytical acumen and solution orientation to understand the nuances of Change Management process across cultures and geographic regions as well as within the IT organization. The role additionally requires consultative questioning and influence management skills as well as solid business knowledge of IT services and capabilities to identify the source of a service break and recommend viable solutions that will properly and efficiently resume service delivery.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* A comprehensive knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes in general and Change Management in particular with an eye to progressive levels of certification as required. Proven experience to leverage and interpret the ITIL process in enhancing current business process and procedures
* Solid advanced interpersonal skills to engage, as a thought leader, senior executives of the firm, in cross business discussions within a matrixed, geographically dispersed organization and to build a solid network of peers and others of influence. Uses these relationships to connect colleagues, challenge insightfully to improve processes and propose credible options
* Well defined consultative skills to conduct effective questioning , hone in on key issues to formulate ideas and materials as well as present those ideas clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization including senior and/or executive management
* Advanced oral, presentation and written communication skills in the English language. Exhibits the ability to adapt communication style to the style of others, developing rapport and staying calm under pressure and to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Has an active learning acumen about the application/infrastructure delivery and related operations organizations to engage team members in issues resolution with confidence and credibility
* Strong analytical and problem solving ability to escalate and negotiate complex and conflicting issues in IT technical investigations, handle multiple and shifting priorities across a broad spectrum of operating environments and to drive solutions that are both financially sound and operationally feasible.
* Excellent Microsoft Office experience, predominantly Excel, Visio and PowerPoint. Strong skills in knowledge sharing tools such as SharePoint
* Assists the Change Management Process Lead with resolving team conflicts, providing peer mentoring, and with the implementation \& communication of difficult decisions; is able to manage team or project by delegating work effectively and using appropriate resources
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and also during weekends


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 Contingent on location, the role can be an individual contributor or may manage Change Management Analysts. As manager, the role requires seasoned management skills inclusive of recommending staff for hire to SM / Change Management Lead, setting objectives aligned to those for the lead and SM as a whole, reviewing accomplishments, coaching for success and counselling for improvement. Assigned staff may be remote based and/or in a work from home setting that will require distance management skills across locations, cultures and time zones. The role itself is generally guided by the Change Management Lead
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
 The role may also require the periodic allocation of additional time on the job to support multiple demands and escalating issues.
   

  

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experience
   

  

**Experience:**
 Approximately 8 to 10 years of experience in an Operational/Service Management role with at least 3\-5 years in Change Management.
   

  

**Certification Requirements:**
 ITIL v2 or v3 Foundations training, or higher level of ITIL Certification as may be required

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation and stability of services. The position includes providing support through remote and onsite engagements, adhering to established procedures and operational frameworks to maintain high\-quality service delivery and minimize downtime.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform and Azure DevOps.

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to Kubernetes, AKS clusters and related components like Istio, GitOps, Autoscaling, Helm, Kustomize etc. Need to troubleshoot issues related to Terraform during AKS Cluster deployment.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure.
  

  

ITSM: Need to work on incidents, Change Requests, RCAs, CMDB etc.
  

  

Documentation: Need to create documentation related to AKS.
  

  

Shifts and On\-call: Need to work on night shifts and on\-calls on a rotational basis, as and when required by the team.
  

  

Meetings and Calls: Need to participate in various calls and discussions with different teams as AKS SME and to share required inputs as Kubernetes / AKS SME.  

  

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps.


Kubernetes : In\-depth knowledge of Kubernetes concepts, architecture, and administration.
  

  

Should have in\-depth knowledge on core Kubernetes concepts like Pods, Deployments, Services, Namespaces, PVs, PVCs, Storage Classes, Role Assignments, Kubernetes Networking, PDBs, HPA etc. Need to have proficiency on working with kubectl tool. Need to have good knowledge and understanding on YAML files related to Kubernetes.
  

  

AKS : Should have in\-depth knowledge on AKS concepts like Node Pools, AKS RBAC, AKS upgradation, Node OS upgradation, AKS Monitoring, AKS Logging, Workload Identity etc.
  

  

Azure DevOps: Working knowledge of Azure DevOps , which includes Azure Repo, branching strategy, pull requests, and git commands. Must know how to use Azure DevOps through IDE tool like VS Code.
  

  

Azure : Proficiency in using Azure services, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  

  

Should have good knowledge on Azure Services like VNet, Subnet, UDR, NSG, Private Endpoint, Private DNS, Managed Identity, Role Assignment, Key Vault, Storage Account , Load Balancer etc.
  

  

Terraform: Should have experience in using terraform to deploy Azure Services and AKS Cluster.
  

  

AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform.
  

  

Monitoring and Logging: Should have good knowledge on monitoring and logging solutions to gain insights into cluster performance, application behavior, and resource usage.
  

  

Security: Should have good knowledge on security best practices for AKS, including RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), network policies, and secure container images.
  

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to AKS clusters, Kubernetes, Terraform, and infrastructure components.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure, using in\-line or blue\-green upgradation approach.
  

  

GitOps : Working knowledge of any of the GitOps tool (Flux / ArgoCD) is preferred.
  

  

Service Mesh : Knowledge of a Service Mesh product (ex: Istio) is preferred.
  

  

Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve issues related to Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  

  

Cloud Native Ecosystem: Awareness of other cloud\-native tools and technologies such as Istio, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

Communication and Teamwork: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Kubernetes.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Support Engineer – L1
   

  

**Location:** 
 Onsite – Bangalore
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Position Summary**
 To enhance our global support team, we are hiring a Technical Support Engineer – L1 with strong and proven customer service experience in the IT market to be based in our Bangalore, India office. The role will provide professional technical support to Kaseya customers through chats, phones, and tickets, while meeting or exceeding internal KPI targets and expectations. The successful candidate will bring strong problem\-solving skills, technical troubleshooting expertise, and a professional, courteous, customer\-first attitude.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide L1 technical support to Kaseya customers through chat, phone, and ticket\-based channels while maintaining a professional and customer\-first approach.
* Troubleshoot Linux/UNIX and Windows operating systems, including system boot, BIOS/UEFI, hardware, and Windows Server issues.
* Perform basic virtualization troubleshooting across VMware and Hyper\-V environments.

* Troubleshoot storage and recovery environments involving NAS, SAN, tape, USB, RAID, virtual storage, and common file systems such as NTFS, FAT, and ext4\.
* Troubleshoot networking issues using the OSI model and TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS concepts, CLI tools, firewall rules, ports, latency, and packet\-related troubleshooting.

**Required Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Windows Server Core administration, Active Directory permissions/ACLs, Group administration, storage technologies, file systems, and backup/recovery concepts.
* Basic knowledge of networking and troubleshooting, including OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, firewall rules, ports, latency, and CLI tools such as ping, ipconfig, Nmap, and traceroute.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven customer service experience in an IT support environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Industry\-accepted certification or equivalent work experience in CompTIA A\+.
* CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Server\+, or CompTIA Security\+ certification or equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator certification or equivalent experience.
* Red Hat Linux certification or equivalent experience.
* VMware VCP certification or equivalent virtualization experience.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification or equivalent cloud experience.
* Additional hands\-on experience with MS Exchange Server, MS SQL, or Oracle Database.


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

description:

title: IT Executive
description:
Job Tittle: IT Executive
 



 Shift: Rotational shift
 



 Location Bangalore
 



  





**About the company** 




  





 Pixis (Leapus Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a next\-generation marketing\-AI platform that harnesses the targeting capabilities of social media and digital advertising platforms. It takes an end\-to\-end approach to the identification, creation, and optimisation of ads — collecting data, understanding target\-group behaviour, creating the ad, and delivering the right content at the right time, so every customer receives uniquely relevant advertising on a one\-to\-one basis. Pixis works with brands such as Swiggy, Amazon, Rapido, HDFC Bank, TATA AIG, Yes Bank, GoAir, Livspace, and MPL Gaming, delivering an average upside of around 50% on CPL, CPI, CPC, and CPM, along with a significant improvement in acquired customer LTV.
 



  





**Role summary** 




 The IT Executive handles day\-to\-day IT support for employees, maintains the IT asset inventory, manages the office network, and assists the IT Manager with new IT projects and system rollouts. The role requires a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on IT operations experience and a strong, practical grasp of IT infrastructure and best practices.
 



  





**Scope** 




 The role is based in Bangalore, India and supports the Bangalore office and India\-based employees, with remote support extended to other Pixis group entities as needed. The IT Executive works closely with the People team on new\-hire and exit processes and with vendors on hardware procurement and repairs.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 Responsibilities are organised by area and are carried out under the direction of the IT Manager.
 



**IT Support** 




 • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and access issues for employees on macOS, Windows, and mobile devices.
 



 • Log and track tickets, resolve them within agreed timelines, and escalate to the IT Manager when needed.
 



 • Set up laptops and accounts for new hires; recover devices and revoke access when employees exit.
 



 • Maintain simple how\-to guides and conduct IT orientation for new employees.
 



**IT Asset Inventory** 




 • Maintain an up\-to\-date inventory of all hardware assets — assignment, serial number, condition, warranty, and location.
 



 • Coordinate laptop procurement, tagging, deployment, repairs, and secure disposal of old equipment.
 



 • Track software licenses and remove unused licenses to control cost.
 



**Network Management** 




 • Manage and monitor the office network — firewalls, switches, Wi\-Fi access points, and internet links.
 



 • Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues; make routine configuration changes as approved.
 



 • Keep network documentation current and coordinate with ISP and building IT teams when required.
 



**IT Projects \& Systems** 




 • Assist in the design and deployment of new IT systems and services — office setups, network upgrades, and tool rollouts.
 



 • Assess vendors and test new hardware and software before company\-wide rollout.
 



 • Document setup steps and standards for the changes delivered.
 



**Monitoring \& Improvement** 




 • Monitor the performance of IT systems and report issues, ticket trends, and costs to the IT Manager.
 



 • Recommend improvements to IT infrastructure, tools, and processes. • Ensure endpoint security basics are in place — device management enrolment, patching, and antivirus/EDR coverage.
 



**Vendor Coordination** 




 • Liaise with hardware suppliers, repair centres, ISPs, and software vendors for quotes, orders, warranty claims, and renewals.
 



 • Maintain vendor contact details and the renewal calendar.
 



  





**Required qualifications** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience working in IT operations or IT support.
* Excellent working knowledge of computer systems, security, network and systems administration, databases and data storage systems, and phone systems.
* Hands\-on experience with office networking — firewalls, switches, and access points — including basic configuration and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Windows and macOS troubleshooting, and of Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 user administration.
* Strong critical thinking and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent IT skills and a strong ability to prioritise across tickets, projects, and walk\-up requests.
* A firm grasp of IT infrastructure and operations best practices.
* Good communication skills — able to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical employees and leadership.

title: IT Admin and Support Specialist
description:
ReOrbit is looking for an IT Admin and Support Specialist to provide hands\-on IT support and administration for our growing Bangalore office.
   

  

 As our IT Admin and Support Specialist, you will be the primary on\-site IT presence in Bangalore, ensuring that employees, devices and local infrastructure are properly supported and ready to operate. You will take ownership of everything from hardware lifecycle management and employee onboarding to access controls, device management and local IT troubleshooting.
   

  

 You will work closely with ReOrbit's IT Infrastructure, Operations \& Support teams, particularly HQ in Helsinki, helping to implement global standards, policies and security requirements locally. You will also play an important role in establishing Bangalore as part of ReOrbit's follow\-the\-sun support model, providing remote support to colleagues across other locations when required.
   

  

 It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start\-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the local hardware inventory for the Bangalore office, including device setup, repair, replacement, lifecycle management and shipment coordination.
* Provide hands\-on support for regional IT projects, technology rollouts and infrastructure initiatives in Bangalore.
* Own the onboarding and offboarding process for Bangalore employees, including device provisioning, account setup, security requirements and access controls.
* Manage and support local physical security systems, including CCTV and access\-related infrastructure.
* Support the implementation of HQ\-driven security policies, processes and IT standards at the Bangalore location.
* Support Microsoft Active Directory design and administration, including Group Policy management and cloud or hybrid server environments.
* Manage software licences and subscriptions for Bangalore\-based users and devices.
* Deploy and maintain standardised laptop and mobile device configurations.
* Troubleshoot local server, infrastructure and end\-user technology issues.
* Manage Windows support tickets and provide timely resolution or escalation where required.
* Administer MDM enrolment and device lifecycle processes for Bangalore devices.
* Provide remote support to other ReOrbit locations as part of the follow\-the\-sun IT support model.
* Coordinate with the global IT team and escalate infrastructure, security or service issues to Helsinki when required.
* Maintain accurate documentation of local IT assets, configurations, procedures and support activities.


**Skills And Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration and end\-user support, ideally supporting a regional, satellite or multi\-site office.
* Hands\-on experience with hardware inventory management, device repair and replacement, and end\-to\-end device lifecycle management.
* Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, security and physical access controls.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy and cloud or hybrid server administration.
* Experience with MDM solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools for device management and onboarding or offboarding.
* Strong Windows end\-user support and troubleshooting skills.
* Comfortable working as the primary on\-site IT presence and independently managing local priorities while escalating to global teams when needed.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to support and implement globally defined policies and processes locally.
* Strong organisational and documentation skills.


**What does ReOrbit do?**
 ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software\-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.
   

  

 ReOrbit’s top\-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in\-house software, procure hardware from the best\-in\-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**Working at ReOrbit**
 At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.
   

  

 We offer
   

  

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance \- but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society.


 Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications
   

  

 and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era.
   

  

 The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies
   

  

*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

title: Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer - SaaS Product Support
description:
Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer \- SaaS Product Support
 


 Bengaluru \| Hybrid • Full\-time \| UK business hours • Compensation: up to 5 LPA
 





 Technical Support Engineer \| Application Support Engineer \| Product Support \| Software Support \| SaaS Support \| Customer Support \| Ticket Management \| Incident Management
 




 About the role
 


 Script Assist is hiring junior Technical Support / Application Support Engineers to investigate and resolve customer issues within our software platform.
 





 We are primarily looking for people with approximately 6\-24 months of professional support experience who already understand how to work from a ticket queue, respond to customer or user issues, gather information, investigate a problem, follow a support process, escalate appropriately, document what happened and keep ownership until resolution.
 





 You do not need healthcare experience. You do need some genuine professional experience supporting a software application, SaaS product or digital platform.
 




 You may currently be working as a:
 


 •  Technical Support Engineer
 





 •  Application Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Analyst
 





 •  Application Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Engineer
 





 •  Product Support Associate
 





 •  Software Support Engineer
 





 •  Software Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Associate
 





 •  SaaS Support Analyst
 





 •  SaaS Support Engineer
 





 •  Production Support Analyst
 





 •  Support Engineer
 





 •  Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Analyst
 





 •  Client Support Analyst
 





 •  Technical Customer Support Executive
 





 Your exact title is not important. What matters is that your current or previous work involved responding to software/application support tickets and helping resolve user or customer issues.
 




 About Script Assist
 


 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company. Our software supports complex private clinical and pharmacy services and connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 





 Our platform contains many interconnected workflows, users and roles, permissions, statuses, customer data, configuration, integrations and operational processes. Our support team helps customers understand and resolve problems when something does not behave as expected.
 





 Healthcare is a complex environment, but previous healthcare experience is not required. We will teach you the product and healthcare workflows.
 




  





 What you will do
 


 •  Receive and manage customer support tickets.
 





 •  Respond to customers and users clearly and professionally.
 





 •  Investigate reported software problems.
 





 •  Gather the information needed to understand an issue.
 





 •  Reproduce problems where possible.
 





 •  Review application behaviour and available information.
 





 •  Identify straightforward causes and resolutions.
 





 •  Escalate more complex issues with clear notes and evidence.
 





 •  Maintain accurate ticket histories and track issues through to resolution.
 





 •  Communicate updates to customers.
 





 •  Work with Product, Engineering, QA and Operations.
 





 •  Retest issues after fixes.
 





 •  Help maintain support documentation and identify repeated problems.
 





 •  Learn increasingly complex areas of the Script Assist platform.
 




 The type of person we want
 


 You are likely to have approximately 6\-24 months of experience working in some form of software or application support. You already understand what it means to:
 





 •  Work from a queue and manage tickets or cases.
 





 •  Meet response expectations.
 





 •  Ask users the right questions.
 





 •  Document an issue properly.
 





 •  Follow up with another team and escalate when appropriate.
 





 •  Keep customers updated and close issues properly.
 





 You should also have very good spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, good organisation, a logical approach to problems, strong ownership, the ability to learn new software quickly and confidence communicating with customers and colleagues.
 




 Useful experience
 


 •  Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk or Salesforce.
 





 •  CRM or ticketing platforms.
 





 •  Incident management, application support, SaaS support or product support.
 





 •  Software troubleshooting, production support or issue reproduction.
 





 •  Basic SQL, databases, APIs or software testing.
 





 •  Root\-cause analysis.
 





 You do not need all of these.
 




 Healthcare experience
 


 Previous experience with healthcare software, EHR / EMR, HIS / HMIS, Practice Management Systems, clinical software or pharmacy software would be useful, but is not required.
 





 We are deliberately open to strong junior support candidates from other SaaS, fintech, ERP, e\-commerce, workflow, logistics or enterprise software businesses.
 




 What this role is not
 


 This is not primarily desktop or infrastructure support. Experience focused mainly on laptop repair, hardware support, printer support, network support, router / switch administration, Windows installation, NOC monitoring or generic IT helpdesk is less relevant.
 





 We want candidates whose experience is primarily about supporting users of software applications or digital products. This is also not a Software Developer, QA Tester, Automation Tester or Manual Testing role. We are recruiting for Customer / Product / Application Support.
 




 Why join Script Assist?
 


 This is an opportunity to build a career inside a growing international software company. You will work closely with Support, Product, Engineering, QA and Operations and gain experience supporting a sophisticated live SaaS platform.
 





 Strong performers can progress into Senior Technical Support, Product Support, Application Support, Technical Operations, Implementation, Business Analysis, Customer Success, QA or Product.
 




  






 If you already understand ticket\-based software support and want to develop quickly inside a more complex product environment, we would like to hear from you.

This hybrid role combines system administration, identity and access management (IAM), AI\-enhanced workflow optimization, data pipeline oversight, and advanced tier\-2/3 support across business applications to ensure the security, performance, and reliability of our data platforms.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* Manage user provisioning, site administration, and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) across core data platforms, including Tableau Online, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Altimate AI, AWS EC2, Revifi, Obsidian, and Wisdom AI.
* Administer OKTA groups, application tiles, API credentials, and execute routine OAuth token rotations across all supported tools.

* Facilitate the deployment and publication of optimized dashboards post\-Change Advisory Board (CAB) approval.
* Conduct daily health checks on Fivetran connectors, provision new integrations, refresh expired tokens, validate data syncs, and partner with Fivetran support for advanced troubleshooting.
* Track dbt job execution and speed. Leverage Altimate AI to automate model documentation, enforce testing, track column\-level lineage, and perform blast radius impact analysis before code deployments.
* Maintain and support background engineering scripts and cron jobs on EC2 instances. Handle user/role administration, rotate credentials, and troubleshoot process failures.
* Monitor virtual warehouse compute performance, storage utilization, and query runtimes in Snowflake.
* Utilize Altimate AI FinOps features alongside Snowflake's auto\-suspend and scaling policies to pinpoint resource\-heavy queries, right\-size compute instances, and drive cost efficiencies.
* Provide ongoing administration and technical support for Wisdom AI, managing non\-SCIM manual user onboarding, RBAC, JIRA ticket workflows, and OKTA tile configurations upon manager approvals.
* Partner with Revifi support to resolve issues related to platform spend, data observability, and governance.

* Spearhead Proofs of Concept (POCs) for evaluating new platforms, connectors, and AI tools, collaborating across teams for seamless implementation.
* Author and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), system configurations, and user documentation.


**Requirements:**
* Proven experience administering SaaS and cloud environments, particularly Tableau Online, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Altimate AI, AWS EC2, and specialized application platforms like Wisdom AI.


**Required Skills:**
* Deep knowledge of OKTA, RBAC methodologies, OAuth token management, non\-SCIM user provisioning, IP allowlisting, and executing UAR compliance audits.
* Familiarity with Altimate AI capabilities and AI\-assisted data tools for user support, documentation, and query execution.
* Advanced SQL proficiency for system troubleshooting and query optimization; capable of managing automated bash/Python scripts within Linux/EC2 environments.
* Strong grasp of modern ELT/ETL pipelines, data synchronization, and data quality platforms (e.g., Revifi).
* Skilled in navigating JIRA, Salesforce ticketing, Git version control, and Change Advisory Board (CAB) deployment standards.

description:

This role combines application ownership accountability with deep integration and API development expertise, serving as the central technical authority for the DocuSign platform within Schneider Electric's global IT landscape.

 Application Ownership

 Configuration \& Workflow Automation

**Technical Services Manager (TSM) \-7\+ yrs exp\-Immediate Joiner\-Pan India**




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Technical Services Manager (TSM)** 
 to serve as a trusted technical advisor for SAP Enterprise Cloud Services customers. The TSM will drive cloud transformation initiatives, SAP upgrade programs, migration projects, and operational excellence across complex SAP landscapes.
 



 This role requires strong expertise in
 **SAP Basis, SAP HANA, SAP S/4HANA, cloud technologies, upgrades, migrations, and ECS operations** 
 . The ideal candidate will collaborate with customers, SAP engineering teams, cloud providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project execution while maximizing business value and customer satisfaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Technical Service Management** 



* Act as the primary technical advisor and trusted partner for assigned SAP ECS customers.
* Deliver proactive technical service management to improve customer outcomes and satisfaction.
* Manage day\-to\-day SAP ECS service delivery and operational governance.
* Lead service review meetings and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, operational standards, and SAP best practices.
* Provide executive\-level reporting, stakeholder management, and technical governance.



**SAP Upgrade \& Transformation Projects** 



* Lead end\-to\-end SAP upgrade projects across SAP ECS customer landscapes.
* Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP NetWeaver, Kernel, and Operating System upgrade activities.
* Conduct technical assessments, upgrade planning, risk management, and execution.
* Coordinate testing, cutover planning, go\-live support, and post\-upgrade stabilization.
* Drive infrastructure modernization and platform upgrade initiatives.



**Cloud Migration \& RISE with SAP** 



* Lead cloud transformation and migration projects into SAP ECS and RISE with SAP environments.
* Manage migration initiatives from on\-premise landscapes to hyperscaler platforms including:
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Support SAP S/4HANA transformations and SAP HANA migrations.
* Conduct landscape assessments and recommend cloud transformation strategies.
* Drive cloud onboarding and adoption programs.



**Operations \& Incident Management** 



* Monitor system health, availability, performance, and capacity management.
* Manage critical incidents, major escalations, and root cause analysis activities.
* Coordinate change management, release management, and maintenance planning.
* Ensure successful execution of system copies, refreshes, and landscape optimization activities.
* Identify automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality.



**High Availability \& Compliance** 



* Support High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and Business Continuity requirements.
* Ensure security, compliance, audit readiness, and governance across SAP cloud environments.
* Design and recommend resilient architectures that maximize system performance and availability.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Collaborate closely with SAP Engineering, Operations, Architecture, Cloud Infrastructure, and Customer teams.
* Partner with customers to understand business transformation goals and challenges.
* Recommend SAP Enterprise Cloud Services offerings and technical solutions aligned with business objectives.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Technical Expertise** 



* Strong experience in:
* SAP Basis Administration
* SAP HANA
* SAP S/4HANA
* SAP NetWeaver
* SAP ECS Operations
* SAP Upgrades and Migrations
* Cloud Transformation Programs
* Comprehensive understanding of:
* SAP S/4HANA Architecture
* SAP Conversion \& Migration Methodologies
* SAP Upgrade Tools and Processes
* SAP HANA Architecture



**Cloud \& Infrastructure Knowledge** 



* Solid hands\-on knowledge of hyperscaler platforms:
* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Understanding of:
* High Availability (HA) Architectures
* Disaster Recovery (DR) Solutions
* Network Technologies
* Load Balancers
* Virtual Machines and Virtualization Technologies



**Professional Experience** 



* Experience in technical planning, implementation, configuration, and integration of SAP solutions.
* Proven experience managing SAP upgrade, migration, and cloud transformation projects.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting experience with a focus on customer success and satisfaction.
* Experience leading complex technical engagements across global environments.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with RISE with SAP engagements.
* Knowledge of SAP cloud operations governance and service delivery frameworks.
* Familiarity with automation and operational excellence initiatives.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive strategic discussions.



  





  





  





  





  





**Role Type** 




 Technical Services Manager (TSM)
 



**Domain Focus** 




 SAP Basis \| SAP S/4HANA \| SAP HANA \| Cloud Migrations \| SAP ECS \| RISE with SAP \| Technical Service Management \| Upgrades \& Transformations \| Azure \| AWS \| GCP \| HA/DR \| Operations \& Governance
 



  





 Candidates must have prior experience in TSM (Upgrade / Migration)
 



 Candidates must have hands\-on experience with ECS

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As the Escalation Manager, Weekend Global Coverage, you will serve as the crucial command lead safeguarding customer trust during high\-stakes, critical events across AMER, APJ, and EMEA. Operating within our global follow\-the\-sun coverage model, you are the decisive voice when a Sev1 or critical customer event occurs, rapidly uniting engineering, support, and executive leadership to stabilize complex enterprise scenarios. This high\-impact role sets the standard for weekend operational excellence, turning chaotic technical crises into clear, swift paths to resolution and ensuring seamless cross\-regional transitions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Command Critical Escalations: Serve as the accountable incident commander for major customer escalations (CIEs/Sev1s) during the weekend US coverage window, establishing clear decision rights, working cadences, and swift mitigation strategies.
* Unify Cross\-Functional Teams: Mobilize and align Support, Escalations Engineering, Service Delivery, and Account teams to ensure technical responders have immediate context and unblocked paths to restore customer environments.
* Lead Executive \& Customer Communications: Translate fast\-moving, complex technical diagnostic details into precise, highly coherent updates for executive leadership and global enterprise customers, keeping stakeholders continuously aligned.
* Drive Global Follow\-the\-Sun Handovers: Execute complete, high\-quality shift handovers across regional teams, eliminating duplicated investigation, protecting customer context, and ensuring zero loss of momentum across time zones.
* Prevent Recurrent Risk: Track service restoration through to post\-incident review, capturing actionable root\-cause insights and partnering with functional owners to eliminate systemic operational or product risks.


**What You Bring**
* Incident Leadership Mastery: Proven background leading cross\-functional response teams through severe enterprise outages, data access incidents, or business\-critical infrastructure events under high\-pressure conditions.
* Strategic Communication \& Command: Superior ability to lead war rooms and synthesize complex enterprise technical issues into clear, impactful executive briefings and step\-by\-step customer action plans.
* Enterprise Tech \& Process Savvy: Functional understanding of enterprise infrastructure (such as storage, cloud platforms, or virtualization) alongside disciplined adherence to incident management frameworks.
* Operational Drive \& Ownership: High organization skills to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, establish rapid accountability, and meticulously track follow\-up commitments to complete resolution.
* Location \& Shift Availability: Ability to work a fixed Thursday–Monday operational shift structure. We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

 Summary \-

* Strong communication skills and attention to detail

title: Technical Support Receptionist
description:
### **Description**

  

As a Receptionist supporting our Technical Support team, you are the crucial first point of contact for our customers. In this high\-volume role, you will answer incoming calls, capture key details about customer issues, and perform seamless warm transfers to available Tech Support Agents. You will also ensure misrouted calls reach the correct departments efficiently while maintaining a professional and welcoming demeanor.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Call Handling \& Intake:** Answer incoming calls promptly, maintaining a high volume of 30–40 calls daily per team member.
* **Troubleshooting Documentation:** Active\-listen to customer issues, capturing detailed, accurate notes on their technical inquiries and symptoms.
* **Warm Transfers:** Execute seamless, warm hand\-offs of qualified technical issues to available Tech Support agents with context provided.
* **Call Routing:** Direct misrouted or non\-technical calls efficiently to the appropriate internal departments.
* **Customer Care:** Act as the first point of contact, providing a professional and welcoming initial impression for all incoming callers.
* **High\-Level Escalation:** Solve complex hardware and firmware challenges, providing real\-time guidance on on\-site wiring, terminations, and device programming.
* **Agile Queue Management:** Thrive in a high\-volume environment, managing a "round\-robin" flow of emails and chats with precision and speed.
* **Emphasize Ownership, Urgency, and Positive Persistence:** Own issues that are presented to you and drive them with the urgency you would if it were you waiting for the solution. Persist in your efforts to resolve issues \- engaging with necessary resources inside and outside your team.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

 **Technical Mastery*** **Education:** B.E./B.Sc. in Electronics, Electrical, or Telecommunications.
* **Experience:** 1\+ years in a technical helpdesk or hardware support role.
* **The "Toolbox":** Solid understanding of electronic components (Relays, Resistors, etc.), low\-voltage power principles, and the ability to read circuit diagrams.
* **Networking:** Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, and networking troubleshooting. **CCNA or CompTIA Network\+** certifications are a major plus.

**Communication \& Soft Skills*** **Clarity:** You can explain a complex electrical ground loop issue simply and professionally.
* **Ownership:** A "stick\-to\-it" mindset. You own the problem until the dealer’s door locks and unlocks as intended.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable toggling between high\-level cloud software (SaaS) and "boots\-on\-the\-ground" hardware issues.
* **Communication:** Exceptional communication skills to deal with global clientele. We're looking at folks who have managed global communications in the past.

  

### **About Brivo**

  

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.  

  

As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.  

  

With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.  

  

*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Sectigo**

Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.
   

  

  

  

**Simplicity at Scale.**
  

  

  

 How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as \#OneSectigo by living out our core values \- Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are looking for a talented Technical Support Specialist to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
   

  





 The
 **Technical Support Specialist** 
 is the
 **first line of support** 
 for Sectigo's growing global customer base — enterprises, partners, and organizations that rely on our industry\-leading security solutions to protect their digital infrastructure. This individual works in a structured, collaborative support environment where their networking knowledge, troubleshooting instincts, and customer communication skills are put to work every day.
   

  

  

  

 Please Note: The Reporting Manager and the Work Arrangement requirements may be modified and redesigned based on business needs to ensure operational flexibility and organizational effectiveness.
   

  





  

  

 This is a full\-time and in\-office position, working 5 days a week from our Chennai office at DLF IT Park, Manapakkam.
   

  





 Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:
   

  





**Customer Support \& Engagement**



* Serve as the
 **first point of contact** 
 for inbound technical support requests submitted via phone, email, and chat.
* Deliver prompt, clear, empathetic, and professional responses to customers of varying technical backgrounds.
* Conduct structured troubleshooting conversations to quickly identify, isolate, and document customer issues.
* Guide customers step\-by\-step through technical problems using approved knowledge base articles and support workflows.
* Proactively communicate case status updates to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the resolution process.



**Technical Troubleshooting \& Issue Management**



* Apply strong
 **network and systems troubleshooting skills** 
 to diagnose and resolve common technical issues.
* Utilize internal tools, ticketing systems, and external resources to investigate reported problems efficiently.
* Prioritize and manage multiple open cases simultaneously, adhering to SLA (Service Level Agreement) response and resolution targets.
* Accurately document all findings, steps taken, and outcomes in the support ticketing system to support auditability and root cause tracking.
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate trends to Team Leads for further investigation.



**Escalation \& Team Collaboration**



* Recognize when a case requires escalation and ensure a
 **high\-quality handoff** 
 to senior support staff or specialist teams, complete with:
	+ Clear problem summaries
	+ Diagnostic data, logs, and screenshots
	+ Reproduction steps and customer environment details
* Collaborate with Shift Leads, Team Leads, and cross\-functional teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Participate in team meetings, quality reviews, and training sessions to continuously sharpen your skills.



**Knowledge \& Process Contribution**



* Contribute to the team's internal
 **knowledge base** 
 by documenting resolved issues, common troubleshooting steps, and customer\-facing FAQs.
* Follow established support procedures to ensure consistency, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by flagging process gaps or recurring friction points to team leadership.
* Participate in additional projects and initiatives aligned with the team's goals and Requirements



 Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Education:**



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Administration, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience is strongly recommended.



**Experience:**



* Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support, help desk, IT administration, or network operations role.
* 1–3 years of experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using ticketing or service desk platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills are required. Additional language proficiency is a significant asset.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and network troubleshooting methodologies is required.
* Working knowledge of DNS (Domain Name System) — record types, resolution, and common misconfigurations is required.
* Familiarity with Active Directory and directory services concepts is required.
* Experience with Windows Server and/or Linux environments is required.
* Comfort using command\-line tools for diagnostics (e.g., ping, tracert, nslookup, curl, netstat) is required.
* Understanding of web technologies including HTTP/HTTPS, web servers, and hosting platforms is required.
* Familiarity with API request/response structures and basic web security principles is required.



 The following certifications are considered an excellent fit for this role and will be given significant weight in the hiring process:
   

  




* CompTIA Network\+ or CompTIA Security\+
* Cisco CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)
* CompTIA A\+ or CompTIA CySA\+
* Microsoft, AWS, or equivalent cloud/infrastructure certifications are also an asset.



**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**



* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with attention to detail and ability to multitask.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in different time zones, rotational shifts with Skeletal staffing on weekends.
* Superior customer service and phone mannerism required to handle support of Sectigo's customer base.
* Experience working with customers across geographies like US \& UK customers.
* Computer literacy skills, including the use of email, and word processing applications.
* Possess qualities such as integrity, curiosity, fair\-mindedness, and a persuasive, team player.
* Ability to thrive in a start\-up environment while applying existing skill sets and training to increase knowledge base.
* Must be able to work shifts, including holidays based on business needs, with possible weekends and after\-hours.
* Must be willing to carry the after\-hour support pager.


**Additional Information**

**Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**




 At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.
   

  





 Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.
   

  





**Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:**




 To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.
   

  





**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**
  

  

  

 At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.
