title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Junior Engineer - EUC & IT Procurement
description:
Junior Engineer \- EUC \& IT Procurement
 



  





 Gradiant India Private Limited Chennai, India

With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end\-to\-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission\-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston\-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
 



 Discover us at www.gradiant.com.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 The L1 IT Infrastructure Administrator \& IT Procurement Specialist is responsible for providing first\-level IT infrastructure support and managing end\-user computing services, while playing a key role in IT procurement activities. A significant focus of this role is engaging with internal business stakeholders to understand their technology requirements, identifying and evaluating suitable vendors and solutions, coordinating procurement activities, and ensuring partner deliverables are tracked and fulfilled on time. Contract negotiation and partner finalization are handled by a dedicated Procurement team; this role focuses on the upstream requirements and solution\-alignment work as well as downstream delivery follow\-up.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**IT Procurement \& Vendor Coordination** 



* Engage with internal stakeholders (IT, Finance, Operations, HR, etc.) to gather and clarify business technology requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear technical and functional specifications for vendor evaluation.
* Research, identify, and shortlist vendors based on capability, fit, track record, and pricing benchmarks.
* Prepare structured vendor comparison reports covering: Product/service suitability, Pricing and cost structures, Delivery timelines, Support terms
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations; validate technical compliance with requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors during active engagements, ensuring: Timely delivery, Milestone tracking, Escalation of delays or quality issues
* Maintain procurement trackers for: Purchase requests, Expected vs. actual delivery, Issue resolution status
* Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams for: Purchase Requisitions (PRs), Purchase Orders (POs), Service Entry Sheets (SES), Invoice approvals
* Track IT contracts, software subscriptions, and warranties; proactively manage renewals.
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory including hardware, software licenses, and accessories.
* Ensure license compliance and monitor minimum stock levels.
* Support vendor onboarding documentation and maintain updated supplier records.
* Assist in budgeting, cost tracking, and identifying IT cost optimization opportunities.
* Ensure all procurement activities adhere to company policies, approval workflows, and audit standards.



**IT Infrastructure Support (L1\)** 



* Provide Level 1 support for end\-user devices including laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Support Microsoft 365 services such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
* Manage user accounts in: Active Directory, Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365
* Handle device onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle management.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, and connectivity issues.
* Assist in deployment and management of Microsoft Intune\-managed devices.
* Support endpoint security tools including: Antivirus, BitLocker, Conditional Access policies
* Monitor IT alerts and escalate issues to higher support levels when needed.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Support office infrastructure including switches, Wi\-Fi access points, conference room systems, and ISP connectivity.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty claims, and service requests.



  





**Requirements** 




 Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



**Procurement \& Vendor Management Skills :** 
 Business Requirements Gathering \& Stakeholder Engagement, Vendor Research, Identification \& Shortlisting, Solution Evaluation \& Fit Assessment, Quotation Evaluation \& Vendor Comparison Reporting, Purchase Requisition (PR) \& Purchase Order (PO) Process, Partner Delivery Tracking \& Follow\-Up, Contract and Renewal Tracking, Inventory \& Asset Management, Cost Analysis and Spend Optimization.
 



**Technical Skills :** 
 Windows 10/11 Administration, Microsoft 365 Administration, Active Directory \& Azure AD, Microsoft Intune (basic administration), Networking Fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi), Hardware troubleshooting and deployment, IT Service Management (ITIL Foundation preferred)

 2–5 years of experience in IT Infrastructure Support with minimum 2 years in supporting IT Procurement

We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Diagnostic Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**Company Overview:**
 https://www.msxi.com/en/
   

  

 At
 **MSX International** 
 , we’ve been partnering with leading automotive companies for over 25 years, helping them enhance their retail strategies and streamline operations. Our expertise in areas like dealer performance, repair optimization, and consumer engagement positions us as a trusted partner in the evolving mobility industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 The Diagnostic Support Engineer will be responsible for monitoring DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) and CAN (Controller Area Network) parameters at the Command Centre (CC) 24/7\. The role involves guiding customers and drivers, managing escalations, and coordinating with dealers to resolve vehicle issues efficiently.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 24/7 Monitoring: Monitor DTC/CAN parameters at the Command Centre and raise tickets immediately when an issue is detected.
* Ticketing: Respond to triggered DTC/CAN alerts by creating internal tickets in the DMS system (with automation in phase 2\).
* Customer Assistance: Provide Level 1 (L1\) support over the phone, guiding customers/drivers to resolve minor issues.
* Critical DTCs: For vehicles with critical DTCs (e.g., "Service Now" category), guide them to the nearest dealer.
* Vehicle Breakdown: If a vehicle is immovable, or if further damage could occur, instruct the dealer to reach the vehicle’s location.
* Issue Tracking: Coordinate with dealers to ensure the issue/ticket is resolved completely and in a timely manner.
* Management Reporting: Provide daily, weekly, monthly, and ad\-hoc reports on vehicle issues and resolution status.
* KPI Tracking: Track and report KPI targets in the required format.
* Job Card Analysis: Conduct job card analysis, focusing on cost avoidance, analytics, and reporting for continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**
* Experience in customer support, vehicle service, or command centre operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills for guiding customers and coordinating with dealers.
* Familiarity with DMS systems, ticketing tools, and vehicle diagnostics (DTC/CAN).
* Ability to work in a 24/7 environment and handle critical issues efficiently.
* Strong analytical skills for reporting and KPI tracking.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Location:** 
 Oragadam, Tamil Nadu
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\-2 years
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Automotive
   

  

**Working Days :** 
 6 days (Rotational week off \& National Holidays)
   

  

 MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting\-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go\-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research\-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

Job Summary :


Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.


Role Definition :


Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.


Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction** \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* **Client Access Setup –** Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues.
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible.
* **Issue Resolution** \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption.
* **Escalation** \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level.
* **Documentation** \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team.


Skills :

**Broad Knowledge** \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem\-Solving** \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication** \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability** \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.


Tasks :

**Responding to Cases** \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics** \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions** \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues** \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario** \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

* Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs.
* Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity.
* Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly.
* Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation.


Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
* 0\-1 year of experience (Experience preferred)
* Key Skills:
	+ Ms. Excel (Intermediate)
	+ Ms. PowerPoint (Basic)
* Problem Solving (Intermediate)
* Analytical skills (Basic)
* Active Listening, Understanding \& Empathy (Advanced)
* Email Writing skills (Intermediate)
* Fundamental understanding of the Customer Support process and techniques
* Proficient in the English language
* Basic understanding of the customer environment and NIQ tools in use
* Exchanges straightforward information
* Technically/digitally savvy

* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Software Asset Management Analyst I
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& License Analyst I is the front line of the software service, working the high\-volume request queues to tight turnaround targets: listed software requests within 3 days, standard SaaS provisioning within 1 day, and licence\-issue resolution for users who cannot get into the software they need. The role is measured on speed and accuracy — the queue is large enough that consistency matters more than individual heroics, and errors here surface later as compliance gaps or duplicate spend.
   

  

 The associate works one of the three IST\-anchored shifts under that shift's Level III lead, with a Level II analyst mentoring day to day. Five of these roles exist — one on APAC and two each on EMEA and NAMER. The role is deliberately bounded: anything carrying legal, privacy or commercial judgment — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases, contract events — is escalated rather than decided, and knowing where that line sits is a core competency of the job.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Listed Software Request Fulfilment
* Execute listed\-software requests via storefront and ticket queues, consistently achieving the 3\-day turnaround SLA.
* Optimize license utilization by identifying reusable entitlements before proceeding with new fulfillment or procurement.
* Validate requester eligibility against product constraints and delivery restrictions to ensure compliant fulfillment.
* Maintain real\-time accuracy of asset and entitlement records throughout the license lifecycle.
* SaaS Provisioning \& Access Verification
* Fulfill standard SaaS requests within 24 hours, verifying active user access prior to ticket closure.
* Apply precise account tiering (e.g., Developer vs. Collaborator) to match publisher\-specific license structures.
* Audit automated provisioning outputs, proactively flagging and resolving failures to prevent service gaps.
* Manage routine deprovisioning; escalate complex scenarios involving data\-loss risks to Level II analysts.
* Licence Issue Resolution \& User Support
* Resolve technical license issues—including activation and access errors—within shift\-specific resolution targets.
* Guide users through software deployment, including the configuration of hosted floating\-license pools.
* Escalate server\-side technical issues to Level III and commercial/legal inquiries to Level II with detailed context.
* Deliver clear, professional user support to drive high customer satisfaction scores (CSAT).
* Queue Hygiene, Data Handling \& Documentation
* Uphold rigorous ticket hygiene and category coding to ensure accurate reporting and trend analysis.
* Protect sensitive data by immediately transferring tickets containing keys or audit info to private queues.
* Enforce operational boundaries by escalating unlisted software and high\-risk use cases rather than self\-actioning.
* Proactively monitor intake forms to flag ageing items for handover before the shift window closes.
* Adhere strictly to SOPs while contributing improvements to the shared knowledge base.


**PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS**
 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* Listed Software Turnaround: fulfil listed\-software requests within the 3\-day target.
* SaaS Provisioning Turnaround: complete standard SaaS provisioning within the 1\-day target, with user access verified before closure.
* First\-Time\-Right: sustain high accuracy on catalogue item, edition, quantity and tier selection, since rework here creates duplicate spend and compliance noise.
* Escalation Discipline: 100% of bounded exclusions — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases — escalated rather than actioned.
* Data Handling: 100% of sensitive tickets moved to the private queue on identification.
* Ticket Hygiene: correct category coding and complete records on every ticket worked.
* Customer Satisfaction: meet the shift's customer satisfaction and time\-to\-resolve targets.


**TOOLS \& SYSTEMS**
* Queue \& Ticketing: the enterprise ticketing queue system with category coding, issue tracking, and the private queue for sensitive tickets.
* Storefront \& Provisioning: the internal software storefront and catalogue, and the provisioning and automated deprovisioning platforms.
* Entitlement Records: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and assignment records.
* Reference \& Knowledge: the SOP knowledge base, product catalogue and publisher playbooks.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Mandatory**
* 1–3\+ years in IT service desk, software provisioning, asset administration or a comparable high\-volume transactional operations role.
* Demonstrated accuracy and throughput on a ticket\-based queue against defined turnaround targets.
* Basic understanding of software licensing concepts — entitlement, assignment, seat counts and the difference between installed and SaaS delivery.
* Sound judgment about the limits of the role: able to recognise a request that must be escalated rather than fulfilled.
* Comfortable working one of three IST\-anchored shifts, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear, courteous English communication with end users.

title: Human Resources Information System Specialist
description:
A Fortune 200 company building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Human Resources Information System Specialist to own the HR technology backbone for a centre that is scaling past two thousand employees this year.
 



**The systems you would run** 



* Administer and configure the core HRIS (employee records, org structure, workflows, approvals) across every India entity the centre supports
* Own end to end data integrity for hires, transfers, promotions and exits, including audit trails for statutory reporting
* Build and maintain integrations between the HRIS, payroll, benefits and time and attendance platforms
* Manage user access, security roles and periodic access reviews in line with the parent company's global controls



**What breaks when HRIS data is wrong** 




 Payroll runs late, statutory filings get flagged, and managers lose trust in headcount numbers used for budgeting. This role exists to make sure that never happens by catching data issues before they reach downstream systems, and by building validation checks that flag anomalies automatically rather than waiting for someone to notice a mismatched report.
 



**What we need from day one** 




 Two to five years working directly inside an HRIS platform (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox or similar), strong Excel and reporting skills, comfort writing SOPs for a global stakeholder base, and the judgment to know when a data anomaly is a typo versus a process gap that needs escalating. Experience supporting a multinational or GCC environment is a strong plus.
 



 Based out of Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune or Remote (India), with periodic travel to other India office locations as the centre grows.
 



**After you apply** 




 The process runs HR Screening, followed by a data and systems assignment, a hiring manager conversation, and a short culture round with the India HR leadership team.
 



 One application is kept on file and considered against this role as well as future HRIS and HR technology openings that come up across Flexiple's client roster.

title: CyberArk Engineer @ Mumbai
description:
**Technical Skills:** 




  





 The L2 PIM/PAM Engineer is responsible for day\-to\-day administration, onboarding, and incident troubleshooting across enterprise Privileged Access Management platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Microsoft Entra PIM). In addition to operational maintenance, this role actively validates, audits, and assesses technical controls to ensure privileged accounts adhere to strict zero\-trust and least\-privilege standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Implementation \& Support (L2 Operations)** 



* Handle Day\-2 operations, ticket escalations, and incident resolution for PAM components (Safe management, account onboarding, CPM/PSM failures, and policy errors).
* Onboard target systems (Windows, Linux, databases, network devices, and cloud infrastructure) into PAM vaults with automated credential rotation.
* Manage Just\-In\-Time (JIT) access requests, time\-bound approvals, and role\-activation workflows in Microsoft Entra PIM and PAM solutions.
* Monitor health checks for core PAM services (Vaults, Proxies, Discovery agents, Session Recording servers) and coordinate with vendor support or L3 teams for complex outages.
* Configure, test, and maintain custom plugins, CPM platform management policies, and connection components.



**Technical Controls Assessment \& Validation** 



* Conduct routine technical assessments to verify that credential auto\-rotation, check\-in/check\-out policies, and password complexity controls function across all onboarded targets.
* Validate that Privileged Session Monitoring (PSM) and keylogging controls capture and index administrative sessions without bypassing.
* Audit Entra PIM policies: verify mandatory MFA triggers, justification requirements, approval chains, and maximum activation duration limits.
* Perform discovery scans to identify unmanaged privileged accounts, service accounts, and shadow admins across Active Directory, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Generate compliance evidence and remediate gaps aligned with audit standards (CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, SOC 2\).



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Core Platforms:** 
 Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise PAM tool (CyberArk PAS/Privilege Cloud, BeyondTrust Password Safe, Delinea/Thycotic) and Cloud PIM (Microsoft Entra ID PIM).
* **Operating Systems \& Networking:** 
 Working knowledge of Windows Server (Active Directory, Kerberos, GPOs), Linux/Unix (SSH, PAM modules, sudoers), and networking fundamentals (firewall ports, DNS, RDP, SSH).
* **Scripting:** 
 Basic PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting skills to assist with automated onboarding, discovery parsing, and API calls.
* **Security Principles:** 
 Solid understanding of Least Privilege, Zero Trust, MFA, Session Isolation, and Break\-Glass procedures.



**Preferred Certifications** 



* CyberArk Defender (PAM\-DEF) or Sentry (PAM\-SEN)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* CompTIA Security\+ or SSCP

title: Senior Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Transport Surveillance L3 / SME**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Transport Surveillance and Restoration**
* Monitor and analyze alarms through Assure1, ZDAF, vendor EMS/NMS and Salesforce.
* Perform L3 troubleshooting across DWDM, CWDM, OTN, SDH/SONET, Carrier Ethernet and optical backhaul networks.
* Troubleshoot LOS, LOF, AIS, RDI, OTU/ODU defects, BER/FEC errors, optical\-power degradation, communication failures and repetitive alarms.
* Analyze Rx/Tx power, span loss, OSNR, Q\-factor, BER/FEC, protection status and performance counters.
* Identify whether the fault resides with the network element, fiber span, card/port, OSP, field cabling, power, software or upstream/downstream network.
* Coordinate restoration with Transport Engineering, IP Network, Field Operations, OSP, Event Management and vendor teams.
* Support traffic rerouting, protection switching, circuit grooming, cross\-connect validation and emergency restoration.
* Lead technical troubleshooting during major outages, bridges and war\-room discussions.
* Review noisy nodes, repetitive alarms and Top\-Talker spans and recommend permanent corrective actions.


**TAC and Advanced Technical Support**
* Act as the internal escalation point for complex incidents that cannot be resolved by L1/L2 Transport teams.
* Collect and analyze:
+ Device and system logs
+ Alarm histories
+ Software and firmware versions
+ Card and controller status
+ Configuration differences
+ Crash, process or communication logs

* Identify known software defects, hardware compatibility issues and platform limitations using OEM documentation and release notes.
* Validate software upgrade paths, hardware compatibility, licenses, storage, configuration backups and rollback readiness.
* Recommend software upgrades, patches, configuration changes, card replacement or RMA based on technical findings.
* Support failed software upgrades, partial card upgrades, controller synchronization issues and rollback activities.
* Review and validate MOPs, pre\-checks, post\-checks, rollback plans and maintenance\-window readiness.
* Open and manage technical cases with Ciena, Nokia, Infinera, ADVA/Adtran, Cisco or other OEM TAC teams.
* Provide complete logs, topology details, impact analysis and troubleshooting evidence to OEMs.
* Track vendor TAC cases until a permanent resolution, patch, workaround or hardware replacement is delivered.
* Support testing and validation of vendor\-recommended fixes before implementation in the production network.
* Maintain a knowledge base of known defects, workarounds, upgrade recommendations and recurring platform issues.


**Technical Skills**
**Technologies**
* DWDM, CWDM, OTN, SDH and SONET
* ROADM, WSS, EDFA/Raman amplification
* Transponders, muxponders and optical line systems
* OTU/ODU mapping and Carrier Ethernet services
* Optical power, span loss, OSNR, BER, FEC and Q\-factor
* Protection mechanisms such as 1\+1, SNCP/MSP and OTN/ROADM protection


**Platforms**
 Hands\-on experience with at least two of the following:
   

  

* Ciena 6500, RLS or Waveserver
* Nokia 1830 PSS
* Infinera optical platforms
* ADVA/Adtran FSP 3000 or FSP 150
* Cisco NCS optical platforms


**Tools and Systems**
* Assure1, ZDAF, Netcool or equivalent alarm\-correlation tools
* Salesforce, ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms
* Ciena MCP/OneControl, Nokia NSP/WaveSuite and equivalent vendor EMS/NMS
* Linux/Unix and CLI troubleshooting
* TL1, SNMP, NETCONF or RESTCONF
* Wireshark and log\-analysis tools
* Basic Python, SQL, PowerShell or automation knowledge preferred


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, IT or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of Transport/Optical NOC experience for an L3 Engineer.
* 8\+ years for an SME/TAC\-level role.
* Strong experience supporting carrier\-grade telecom or ISP networks.
* Experience handling major incidents, software upgrades, vendor escalations, RCA and field coordination.
* Ability to work independently in a 24x7 rotational environment.


**SME and Leadership Expectations**
* Mentor and coach L1/L2 Transport engineers.
* Review troubleshooting quality, restoration decisions and RCA accuracy.
* Conduct technical training and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Develop SOPs, MOPs, troubleshooting guides and escalation playbooks.
* Present recurring issues, platform risks and improvement plans to management and stakeholders.
* Maintain detailed technical records for future troubleshooting and operational continuity.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Accuracy and timeliness of alarm validation and fault isolation
* Restoration and escalation turnaround time
* Reduction in repetitive and noisy alarms
* Quality of TAC case submissions and vendor follow\-up
* Software\-upgrade and rollback success rate
* RCA and permanent\-fix completion
* Investigation\-backlog reduction
* Technical ticket and documentation quality
* Improvement in L1/L2 capability through coaching
* Reduction in repeat platform, software and hardware incidents


**Ideal Candidate**
 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on
 **L3 Optical Transport Engineer with TAC\-level troubleshooting capability** 
 , able to restore live services, analyze complex software and hardware failures, manage OEM escalations and drive permanent resolution of recurring network issues.

 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
   

  





**About the Role** 




 Agfa is looking for an experienced
 **Problem Manager** 
 to join its Global ICS (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end Problem Management process across a complex ecosystem of internal IT teams, managed service providers, and strategic technology partners. Your primary objective will be to identify, analyze, and eliminate the root causes of recurring incidents, thereby improving service stability and enhancing the overall user experience.
 



 As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will facilitate root cause investigations, and ensure that sustainable corrective actions are implemented. You will play a critical role in reducing operational risk, improving service performance, and driving continuous improvement across Agfa's global IT landscape.
 



**About You (Skills Required)** 




 You are a proactive and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex operational challenges and driving service improvements. You excel at working with diverse stakeholders, influencing teams without direct authority, and coordinating efforts across multiple service providers.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong analytical and root cause investigation capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* A structured and process\-oriented approach to service management.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and service stability.



**What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Lead and continuously improve the global Problem Management process.
* Coordinate problem investigations across internal teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities for recurring and major incidents.
* Ensure the identification, tracking, and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Facilitate collaboration between technical teams to resolve complex and cross\-functional problems.
* Provide regular status updates and reporting to business stakeholders and leadership.
* Manage escalations related to problem investigations and resolution activities.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and identify opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Perform trend analysis, reporting, and metrics tracking to proactively identify improvement opportunities.
* Act as backup for the Incident Manager when required.



**What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven track record in Problem Management roles.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes and best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher certification is preferred.
* Experience working in SIAM (Service Integration and Management) and multi\-supplier environments.
* Understanding of service integration, governance, and operational reporting.

Support Technician \| scanO
   

  

 Company: Trismus Healthcare Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (scanO)
   

 Location: Pune, Corporate Office
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site
   

 Reports To: Head of Customer Support / Operations
   

  

 About scanO
   

  

 scanO builds AI\-powered oral health screening solutions for dental clinics, including scanO air, our screening unit; scanO engage, our practitioner platform; and scanO care, our patient app.
   

  

 Over 400 units are live across clinics in India, the UK, UAE, and South Africa. When something does not work, clinics rely on our support team. How quickly and effectively we resolve those issues directly impacts their experience with scanO.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a technically strong and customer\-focused Support Technician to join our support desk.
   

  

 Clinics will reach out through email, phone, and WhatsApp with issues ranging from “the scan will not start” to “this AI report looks incorrect.”
   

  

 You will diagnose issues, resolve what you can remotely, escalate technical problems to the appropriate engineer or field technician, and follow through until the clinic is operational again.
   

  

 You will also maintain accurate records of our installed device fleet and help convert real customer issues into actionable feedback for our product, engineering, ML, and clinical teams.
   

  

 This is a technical support role, not a call centre role. You should be able to understand how the device, application, and network work together well enough to isolate and troubleshoot faults remotely.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Own the Support Queue
   

 Respond to support requests received through support@scanoai.com, phone, and WhatsApp within defined response timelines. Log every issue, maintain accurate statuses, and close the loop with the clinic.
   

  

 2\. Diagnose Issues Remotely
   

 Troubleshoot device, application, connectivity, and user\-related issues through phone, chat, and screen sharing. Reproduce issues wherever possible before escalating them.
   

  

 3\. Escalate \& Follow Through
   

 Raise clear and reproducible bug reports for the engineering team, including logs, unit ID, firmware version, and reproduction steps. Track escalations until resolution and keep the customer informed.
   

  

 4\. Coordinate Field Service
   

 Coordinate technician visits, part replacements, and unit returns with the operations team. Track units from pickup through service and redeployment.
   

  

 5\. Maintain the Fleet Record
   

 Keep accurate records of installed units, including clinic details, unit serial numbers, firmware versions, warranty status, open faults, and service history.
   

  

 6\. Report AI Output Corrections
   

 Collect cases where clinicians dispute or correct AI\-generated reports and share them with the ML and clinical teams, along with relevant images and context.
   

  

 7\. Identify Recurring Patterns
   

 Prepare a weekly summary covering support volumes, recurring faults, and major issue drivers to help the team address root causes instead of individual symptoms.
   

  

 8\. Build the Knowledge Base
   

 Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and clinic\-facing how\-to documentation as the product evolves.
   

  

 9\. Support the Field Team
   

 Provide remote technical assistance during installations, camps, demos, inaugurations, and escalations.

 Diploma or degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field

 Marathi or another regional language is an advantage

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Support Specialist (Security & Network)
description:
*Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle.*
*The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry’s first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human\-in\-the\-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*
*Built cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve.*
*Securonix is recognized as a six\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always\-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience.*
*Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long\-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve.*
*With more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work.*
* We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability.
* We are customer driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes.
* We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast.


*That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations.*
**Role Summary**
 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
   

  

 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 Network Security Ownership
   

  

* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.


 Threat Detection \& Incident Response
   

  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.


 Security Operations Engineering
   

  

* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.


 Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation
   

  

* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.


 Risk, Governance \& Assurance
   

  

* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.


 Architecture \& Strategic Hardening
   

  

* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.


**Required Experience**
* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


**Preferred Experience**
* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.


**Benefits**
*As a full\-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:*
* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents\-in\-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

*Securonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

title: IT Systems Administrator
description:
**About The Role**
 Protsahan India Foundation operates 5 centres in Delhi, with 50\+ staff, each managing their own devices, alongside shared infrastructure — CCTVs, biometric attendance systems, WiFi networks, and programme equipment. As we scale, formal IT management is required for each of the 5 centers and the administrative office location.
   

  

 The IT Systems Administrator will own all of this — not as a helpdesk ticket\-taker, but as the person who makes sure none of it fails. You will be the single point of accountability for IT infrastructure, device health, data security, and digital compliance across all locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Device Management
* Manage 50\+ laptops across 6 locations: setup, configuration, asset tagging, condition tracking, maintenance, and repair
* Maintain the IT asset register per Protsahan’s asset management SOPs — every device tracked by location, user, and condition
* Coordinate hardware procurement: obtain quotes, recommend vendors, and process purchase requests through Finance
* Manage device allocation for new joiners and secure retrieval at exit — within the timelines defined in HR SOPs
* Initiate and document write\-off requests for end\-of\-life devices per the disposal policy
* Network and Connectivity
* Manage WiFi, LAN, and internet connectivity at all 6 centre locations
* Troubleshoot network outages and connectivity issues; escalate to ISP vendors where required
* Maintain router and network device configurations; document network topology for each location
* Coordinate with ISP vendors on service quality, renewals, and upgrades
* CCTV Systems
* Maintain and monitor CCTV infrastructure at all 6 locations
* Manage CCTV storage: ensure recording continuity, footage retention per policy, and periodic storage health checks
* Control access to CCTV footage — only authorised personnel per the IT and Data Protection Policy
* Coordinate with CCTV vendors for installation, repair, and expansion
* Biometric Attendance Systems
* Maintain biometric attendance devices at all locations; ensure data sync and accuracy
* Coordinate with HR on attendance data extraction and troubleshoot device failures
* Manage device firmware and software updates; coordinate vendor support for hardware issues
* IT Helpdesk and Staff Support
* First\-line IT support for all 50\+ staff across 6 locations — hardware issues, software queries, account access problems
* Respond to support requests within 24 hours; resolve or escalate within 3 working days
* Provide hands\-on support at centre locations through scheduled visits (minimum monthly) and emergency visits when required
* Conduct basic IT literacy orientation for new staff on Day 1 as part of the onboarding process
* Google Workspace Administration
* Administer Protsahan’s Google Workspace: create and deactivate user accounts, manage shared drives, set access permissions
* Enforce the Shared Drive folder structure per ADM SOPs — ensure staff create and store files in Shared Drive, not personal My Drive
* Manage storage quotas, conduct periodic access audits, and generate usage reports for ED
* Troubleshoot Google Workspace issues for staff
* IT Security and Data Protection Compliance
* Enforce Protsahan’s IT and Data Protection Policy across all locations
* Implement and maintain password policies, device locking, and access control practices
* Support compliance with DPDP Act 2023 requirements — data inventory, access logs, incident response
* Conduct quarterly IT security audits across all 6 locations and report findings to ED
* Manage software licensing: track all licences, renewals, and compliance — no unlicensed software on Protsahan devices
* Programme Equipment Support
* Support Canon DSLR camera geotagging setup at all GECs: Canon Camera Connect app pairing, Location Services configuration, and staff training per SOP\-EE\-07
* Troubleshoot programme AV equipment, projectors, and other tech used in GEC activities
* Ensure camera and device firmware is kept up to date
* Vendor Management
* Maintain a vendor register for all IT service providers: ISP, hardware, CCTV, biometric, software
* Obtain comparative quotes for hardware and service procurement per Finance SOPs
* Monitor vendor service quality and SLA compliance; escalate persistent issues to ED


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field
* 2 to 4 years of experience in IT administration, systems administration, or IT helpdesk
* Hands\-on experience managing Google Workspace (user admin, Shared Drive, permissions)
* Working knowledge of WiFi and LAN network management
* Experience with CCTV systems and/or biometric attendance devices
* Basic understanding of data protection and IT security principles
* Ability to work independently across multiple locations with minimal supervision
* Willingness to travel across all 6 Delhi centre locations as required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience in an NGO or social sector organisation
* Familiarity with DPDP Act 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection) requirements
* Experience with asset management and maintaining IT asset registers
* Relevant certifications: CompTIA A\+, Google Workspace Administrator, or equivalent


**What We Expect**
 This role is not a 9\-to\-5 desk job. When the biometric device at a centre fails on a Monday morning, you are the person who resolves it — not who logs a ticket and waits. You will be expected to:
   

  

* Be responsive. Staff across 6 locations depend on functional equipment to run their programmes.
* Be proactive. Don’t wait for things to break — maintain, audit, update.
* Own the documentation. Every device, every vendor, every access permission must be on record — not in your head.
* Understand the stakes. Protsahan works with vulnerable children. IT failures have programme consequences. Data breaches have child protection consequences.


**How To Apply**
 Send your CV and a brief note on your relevant experience to hr@protsahan.co.in with the subject line: Application — IT Systems Administrator.

* Enterprise Internet, DIA, VPN and Leased Line solution planning
* Metro Ethernet and Carrier Ethernet solution design
* ILL and fixed broadband (FTTH/GPON) planning and optimization
* Network topology, path design, redundancy and resiliency planning
* Voice integration: PBX/PABX/IP PBX, FXO/FXS, SIP lines and SIP trunks
* Strong IP and transport domain expertise with deep understanding of fiber technologies


**The skills you bring:**
 Service order intake, verification and validation in CIA Logical
   

  

 Cross\-functional coordination with PDF, Engineering, Sales, NOC and Field Operations
   

  

 High\-level and low\-level design creation for B2B enterprise services
   

  

 Design accuracy verification, solution validation and technical feasibility review
   

  

 Capacity, bandwidth and service feasibility planning
   

  

 BOQ/BOM preparation and equipment issuance process management
   

  

 Configuration data recording, documentation management and design governance
   

  

 Order closure and clean hand\-off to provisioning (Linxwork)
   

  

 SLA\-driven design delivery, KPI tracking (On\-time %, FTR) and performance reporting
   

  

 Design error analysis, escalation handling and rework coordination
   

  

 Network migration, upgrade and change management planning
   

  

 Root cause analysis for recurring design/planning issues and risk mitigation
   

  

 Clear communication and stakeholder management across internal and customer teams
   

  

**Tools and Reporting**
 CIA Logical web system (service order and design management)
   

  

 Linxwork / Links Work (interface for design hand\-off to provisioning)
   

  

 Lotus Notes or equivalent (equipment issuance and approvals)
   

  

 N2000 or equivalent Network Management System (design verification and configuration view)
   

  

 GIS and network inventory / asset management systems
   

  

 Reporting tools (design data records, KPI tracking)
   

  

 MS Vision and network documentation tools
   

  

 ITSM / ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Remedy) for design\-related requests

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Application Support Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 NEXThink
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 Responsible to own NEXTHINK platform, analyze the real\-time data from the solution and to take necessary timely actions to improve the overall End User services.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
 Monitor the End user experience dashboards, digital scores, and alerts daily to check the overall performance scores of end users.
   

  

 Identify the top issues that are impacting the user experience scores
   

  

 Analyze the details of the issues and identify probable root cause of the issues and work with relevant teams to take necessary actions.
   

  

 Log proactive tickets for the identified issues and assign it to the relevant teams and track the issue until it is fixed to close the ticket.
   

  

 Create new investigations, dashboards, metrices, campaigns and reports to identify, track and resolve ongoing activities or identify potential issues that can be prevented to avoid outages and multiple tickets/calls flooding the service desk
   

  

 Coordinate with other service teams to ensure the identified issues are addressed by ways of proactive actions, logging tickets with relevant product vendors, track the progress of the cases and report the same to all stake holders.
   

  

 Would be responsible in developing, maintaining, and governing the usage of the scripts (Solutions) for the L1 engineers/ServiceNow/RTS teams who would use these to resolve known issues.
   

  

 Create, test, and maintain remote action solutions (Self Heal Use cases)
   

  

 Perform testing of collector upgrade packages, co\-ordinate with business owners and support teams for collector upgrade roll out. Co\-ordinate with Win10 engineering team to incorporate the new package into the core application list
   

  

 Escalate the problem tickets to Nexthink vendor
   

  

 Co\-ordinate with NEXTHINK vendor in performing new feature testing and troubleshooting critical applications
   

  

**Must Have Skills/Qualifications**
 Excellent Administration and Support skills on Windows 10 and MAC (where applicable)
   

  

 System Scripting and/or programming skills, preferably with PowerShell
   

  

 Should have at least fundamental certification in cloud technologies like Azure/AWS.
   

  

 Good verbal and written communication skills to connect with customers/teams at varying levels of the organization
   

  

**Nice To Have Skills/Qualifications**
 Project Management and ITIL Certifications.
   

  

 Familiar with Software Deployment Tools like SCCM, Intune and JAMF (where applicable)

title: Support Team Lead
description:
Accertify enables commerce by doing one thing extraordinarily well: pinpointing fraud. The company's Predictive Yes Platform helps businesses say yes to more \- more good customers, more revenue, and more growth \- without getting burned. It's a precise, confident, data\-backed yes, made possible by joining signals across the entire customer lifecycle through unmatched data volume, layered AI\-powered models, and a consortium approach that protects clients from bad actors spotted anywhere in the network while unlocking business with good actors verified anywhere in the network. With more than 10 billion transactions and over $1 trillion in commerce processed in 2025 alone, Accertify delivers the intelligence and precision that fraud and payments teams need to say yes confidently and enable growth. That's the More Yes difference.
   

  

 We are hiring a
 **Support Team Lead** 
 to play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional service to high\-profile clients across diverse industries. In this position, you will provide technical setup and support, troubleshoot system connectivity issues, and configure fraud detection tools tailored to client needs. Collaborating closely with internal teams and clients, you will help identify emerging fraud trends, implement innovative solutions, and ensure seamless integration of our SaaS platforms. This role demands strong communication skills, a proactive approach to problem\-solving, and a commitment to maintaining a best\-in\-class customer experience.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support and set up for our clients regarding our Fraud, Chargeback, User Behavior, Account Protection, and Payment Gateway functionalities
* Troubleshoot client issues connecting to our systems. Monitor for system alerts. Contact clients when interruptions in their data feed occur
* Develop and deploy fraud transaction screening rules and methodologies
* Configure Fraud Analyst user interface to client’s specifications
* Work closely with clients to identify new features and functionality for Interceptas
* Work closely with Accertify Subject Matter Experts to evaluate and identify emerging technologies/fraud trends and adopt new approaches and features as needed
* Develop a strong relationship with clients to deliver exceptional service and ensure that expectations are exceeded
* Train and guide junior analysts with job tasks.
* Act as a liaison between external clients and internal departments including Account Management, Operations, and Development teams
* Collaborate and attend meetings as assigned


**Skills \& Qualifications**
 This is a high\-visibility role that requires excellent communication skills, as well as a dynamic, energetic approach to problem\-solving to support a best\-in\-class customer experience. Specific qualifications include:
   

  

* Experience working directly with clients in a customer\-facing support or service environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Experience troubleshooting software applications and technical issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Positive, energetic, and customer\-focused attitude with a strong commitment to service excellence.
* Highly detail\-oriented with a focus on accuracy, quality, and follow\-through.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience supporting Client Services, Customer Support, Client Success, or Client Operations functions, including managing service\-related inquiries and coordinating cross\-functional efforts to resolve client issues.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and ownership mindset are strongly preferred.
* Previous experience working in a fast\-paced, client\-centric environment is highly preferred.
* Internal Candidates with a minimum of 2 years of experience supporting Client Services, Customer Support, Client Success, or Client Operations functions within Accertify are highly preferred.


**Additional Details**
* 1\-3 years of experience with online credit card fraud prevention is a plus
* 1 \-3 years of experience supporting payment transactions with a card processor
* 1 \-3 years of experience supporting chargeback processes
* Work model: Hybrid (2 days in\-office per week)
* Little to no travel is required in this position.


**Why Join Accertify?**
 At Accertify, we offer more than just a paycheck—we invest in our people through competitive rewards, meaningful benefits, professional development opportunities, flexible ways of working, and programs that support your overall well\-being. Join a team that values growth, collaboration, and innovation while empowering you to make an impact and build a rewarding career.

 https://www.cvent.com/in/hospitality\-cloud/cvent\-social\-tables
   

  

 Department for the product : Event Diagramming. As our clients' primary point of contact, you will spend approximately 90% of your day assisting clients over the phone or via chat and email.
