title: People Systems Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
 At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast\-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
   

  

 As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future\-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting\-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Workday Analyst serves as a functional and technical expert for Workday HCM and related modules. This role partners closely with HR, Finance, and IT to optimize system functionality, configure enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and drive Workday best practices. The ideal candidate has deep Workday knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Reporting to the People system Manager, based in Sydney, the Senior/ People system analyst is needed to provide expert systems support with Workday and other integrated systems as needed.
   

  

 One component of this role is to help optimize the Workday system by streamlining business processes and enabling enhancements such as reporting automation and dashboards, providing coaching and guidance to the broader team, training and presenting to business and People \& Culture stakeholders and ticket resolution.
   

  

 The Senior /People Systems Analyst will also be required to support across other People related systems and tools including survey tool, recruitment, remuneration and consolidate and provide reporting and key People \& Culture metrics.
   

  

**What We 'll Do**
**System Administration \& Configuration**
* Lead configuration, testing, and deployment of Workday modules such as HCM, Talent, Absence, and Compensation.
* Manage Workday security, business processes and reporting.
* Evaluate existing configurations and recommend optimizations aligned with business strategy and Workday best practices.


**Support \& Troubleshooting**
* Serve as the primary escalation point for Workday issues and inquiries.
* Diagnose root causes, resolve system errors, and coordinate fixes with IT or internal teams.
* Maintain data integrity through audits, validation, and quality checks.


**Enhancements \& Projects**
* Lead Workday enhancement cycles, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, and deployment.
* Manage semi\-annual Workday releases, assess tenant impacts, and communicate changes to stakeholders.
* Support system\-related HR initiatives such as process improvements, workflow automation, and new module implementations.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Build advanced custom reports, dashboards, metrics, and scorecards using Workday Reporting.
* Provide actionable analytics and insights to HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and confidentiality standards.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to understand operational needs and deliver effective Workday solutions.
* Train end users, develop documentation, and enhance Workday adoption across the organization.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance the employee experience using Workday tools


**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental \& Health \& Safety**
* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually \& Comply with all Company policies related to H\&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.


**Unleash your potential**
 To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Workday experience, including configuration and administration.
* Expertise in at least two Workday modules (e.g., HCM Core, Compensation, Absence, Payroll and Talent).
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Experience with Workday report writing and complex calculated fields.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


**Core Competencies**
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadline
* Strong business acumen
* Collaborative and proactive partnership mindset
* Continuous improvement mentality


**Preferred**
* Workday Pro or Workday certification(s).
* Experience with Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio).
* Familiarity with release management processes and Workday tenants (sandbox, preview, production).
* Prior experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Working at Bravura**
 Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
   

  

  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
* 2 paid volunteering days and a range of community\-based initiatives to get involved in
* Parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Free meals/free transport/cab service


**So, what’s next?**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
   

  

 Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
   

  

 All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Senior Technology Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
 McDermott is seeking an experienced Technology Specialist to design, implement, optimize, and support enterprise cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). This role is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, highly available, and cost\-effective cloud platforms that support business critical applications, infrastructure services, and emerging AI workloads.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, security, automation, disaster recovery, and cloud operations. Experience supporting AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Copilot is preferred.
   

  

 This individual will work closely with infrastructure, security, application, and business teams to drive cloud modernization, operational excellence, and AI platform enablement across the enterprise.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Design, implement, and support enterprise cloud infrastructure in Azure and AWS.
* Architect highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions.
* Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives from on premises environments.
* Manage cloud resources including compute, networking, storage, and platform services.
* Develop and maintain cloud architecture standards, governance frameworks, and operational procedures.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Conditional Access policies.
* Support compliance, audit, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements.

* Automate infrastructure deployments and operational processes using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, PowerShell, and Python.
* Partner with application and data teams to support AI and machine learning workloads, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Monitor cloud platform health, performance, utilization, and costs.
* Evaluate emerging cloud and AI technologies and recommend adoption strategies.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 7\+ years of Microsoft Azure infrastructure experience.
* 3\+ years of AWS infrastructure experience.
* Experience designing and supporting cloud environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, cloud governance, and operational support.
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud or multi cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem solving skills.
* Technical Skills
+ Microsoft Azure
+ Amazon Web Services (AWS)
+ Microsoft Entra ID
+ AWS IAM
+ Windows Server and Linux Administration
+ Azure and AWS Networking
+ DNS, Load Balancers, Firewalls
+ Terraform, Bicep
+ Azure DevOps and GitHub
+ PowerShell and Python
+ Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, Application Insights
+ Cost Management and Resource Optimization
+ AI Platform Experience


**Preferred Qualifications and Education:**
* Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or generative AI platforms.
* Experience with cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Experience supporting global enterprise environments.
* Technical Skills
+ Azure OpenAI Service
+ Azure AI Foundry
+ Microsoft Copilot
+ AWS Bedrock
+ RAG Architectures

+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)

The ideal candidate combines infrastructure, networking, identity, and security knowledge with exposure to AI platforms and technologies, helping McDermott enable both its cloud strategy and growing AI initiatives.


 \#DICE

Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

title: Assistant Manager - Seller Support Operations
description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**
 At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where
 *fun meets results* 
 !
   

  

 Seller Support AM will be the primary driver of First Mile efficiency for seller support. Your mission is to bridge the gap between Seller expectations and Hub execution. You are responsible for identifying why pickups fail and ensuring those issues are resolved before the seller has to contact us.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Reporting to:** 
 Senior Manager \- Seller Experience (Flipkart HQ)
   

  

* Role Summary


 You will be the primary driver of First Mile efficiency. Your mission is to bridge the gap between Seller expectations and Hub execution. You are responsible for identifying why pickups fail and ensuring those issues are resolved before the seller has to contact us.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Hub Performance Intervention: Visit and coordinate with pickup hubs daily to identify "un\-attempted" or "failed" pickups.
* Tactical Problem Solving: Resolve ground\-level
* Contact Deflection: Proactively analyze the "Seller Contact" queue. Identify the top 5 reasons sellers are calling and implement ground\-level fixes to stop those contacts at the source.
* SLA Enforcement: Ensure that every shipment marked for pickup is processed within the designated window, preventing any "aging" of orders.
* Performance Scorecard (Quarterly Evaluation)


 Your success is measured by the movement of these three dials:
   

  

* Contact Reduction \- Decrease the % seller support tickets.
* Repeat Contacts \- Ensure sellers don't contact repeatedly in a week/month for the same issue
* Pickup Pendency Ageing \- Ensure no pickups in the designated hubs have ageing of more than 2 days at any time
* Candidate Requirements
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in First Mile operations (preferably in E\-commerce, Food\-tech, or Courier Express).
* Execution Focus: Proven ability to work a 6\-day week in a high\-intensity environment.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use Excel/Dashboards to identify which specific hubs are failing and why.
* Local Language: Proficiency in the local language of the region is highly preferred to manage ground staff and vendors effectively.
* Soft Skills: Ability to influence without authority is high desired
* Open To Travel \- You should be able to travel to different locations within the city for seller/hub visits.
* 6 Days per Week (On\-field/Hub\-based as required)


**Why Join Us?**
* Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and providing opportunities for career advancement.
* Comprehensive Training: We offer extensive paid training to ensure you’re equipped for success.
* Team\-Oriented Culture: Work in a collaborative, supportive environment with peers who are passionate about what they do.
* Diversity \& Inclusion: We celebrate the unique perspectives and contributions of all our employees.
* Fun Workplace: Join a vibrant team that knows how to have fun! From team engagement activities to social events, we foster a lively and inclusive work environment where you’ll build strong connections.
* State\-of\-the\-Art Offices: Work in our modern, well\-equipped offices designed to enhance collaboration and productivity.
* Rewarding Work: Help businesses grow while making a real difference in people’s lives!

title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
description:
**About Signant Health** 




 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 The
 **IT Applications Engineer** 
 is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function** 



* Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
* Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
* Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
* Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
* Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
* Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
* AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
* Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




**Essential:** 



* NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
* Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
* Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
* APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
* Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
* Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
* ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.



  





**Desirable:** 



* Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
* Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
* Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
* Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



  





 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



  





 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



  





 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
 



  





 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

**About this opportunity:**
 SME responsible for Transport Fixed Network Design for B2B Corporate Services.Covers service order management, circuit design (MPLS\-VPN, Fiber, GPON),port reservation,VLAN/VC/PW ID/VPRN ID verification, equipment issuance,and design closure into the provisioning system (Linxwork).
   

  

**What you will do:**
* IP/MPLS network design for telecom / ISP B2B networks
* L2/L3 VPN technologies: IP/MPLS VPNs, VPLS, EVPN
* Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS and static routing
* IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnet planning and routing table validation
* VLAN, VRF and QoS design and classification
* MPLS\-VPN circuit design, HQ path verification and resiliency planning
* VLAN, VC, PW ID and VPRN ID parameter design for service activation
* Fiber termination and media planning \& design (FTTH, GPON, Copper, L2\)
* Last\-mile connectivity and access technology design (ADSL, SHDSL, GPON, MPLS)
* Enterprise Internet, DIA, VPN and Leased Line solution planning
* Metro Ethernet and Carrier Ethernet solution design
* ILL and fixed broadband (FTTH/GPON) planning and optimization
* Network topology, path design, redundancy and resiliency planning
* Voice integration: PBX/PABX/IP PBX, FXO/FXS, SIP lines and SIP trunks
* Strong IP and transport domain expertise with deep understanding of fiber technologies


**The skills you bring:**
 Service order intake, verification and validation in CIA Logical
   

  

 Cross\-functional coordination with PDF, Engineering, Sales, NOC and Field Operations
   

  

 High\-level and low\-level design creation for B2B enterprise services
   

  

 Design accuracy verification, solution validation and technical feasibility review
   

  

 Capacity, bandwidth and service feasibility planning
   

  

 BOQ/BOM preparation and equipment issuance process management
   

  

 Configuration data recording, documentation management and design governance
   

  

 Order closure and clean hand\-off to provisioning (Linxwork)
   

  

 SLA\-driven design delivery, KPI tracking (On\-time %, FTR) and performance reporting
   

  

 Design error analysis, escalation handling and rework coordination
   

  

 Network migration, upgrade and change management planning
   

  

 Root cause analysis for recurring design/planning issues and risk mitigation
   

  

 Clear communication and stakeholder management across internal and customer teams
   

  

**Tools and Reporting**
 CIA Logical web system (service order and design management)
   

  

 Linxwork / Links Work (interface for design hand\-off to provisioning)
   

  

 Lotus Notes or equivalent (equipment issuance and approvals)
   

  

 N2000 or equivalent Network Management System (design verification and configuration view)
   

  

 GIS and network inventory / asset management systems

Summary:  

We are seeking a skilled Beyond Trust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) Specialist to join our IT security team. Security and Compliance:

o Analyze and respond to security incidents related to privileged access.

User Training and Support:

o Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to EPM solutions.  

o Develop and update documentation and training materials.  

Continuous Improvement:  

o Stay up to date with the latest security threats, trends, and technologies.  

o Recommend and implement improvements to EPM policies and configurations.  

o Participate in security assessments and risk management activities.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:

o Proven experience in implementing and managing Beyond Trust EPM solutions.  

o Strong knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems.  

o Experience with endpoint security and privilege management.  

Skills and Competencies:  

o Deep understanding of least privilege access principles and practices.  

o Proficiency in configuring and managing EPM policies and rules.  

o Familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and other endpoint management tools.  

o Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.  

o Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  

o Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  

  

Additional Information:
  

o Relevant certifications such as Beyond Trust Certified Engineer (BTCE), Certified Information

description:

The Full Stack Developer position provides technical expertise in building modern solutions using AI\-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and documentation without compromising architecture, security, code quality, or accountability. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field

**Position Overview:**
 The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Regional IT Operations Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.


**Incident \& Service Request Management**
* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.


**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**
* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**
* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.


**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**
* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.


**Business Continuity \& Operational Readiness**
* Support business continuity by ensuring IT systems remain operational across all regional locations.
* Coordinate IT readiness for new operational sites, office relocations and infrastructure expansion projects.
* Participate in disaster recovery activities, system recovery testing and operational contingency planning where applicable.
* Ensure critical operational systems supporting logistics and customer service remain available with minimal downtime.
* Provide IT support during peak business periods and critical operational events to ensure uninterrupted business operations.


**Information Security \& IT Governance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies, information security standards and regulatory requirements across all regional locations.
* Support implementation of IT security controls, endpoint protection, user access management and system compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate timely installation of software updates, security patches and antivirus definitions in collaboration with Corporate IT and support vendors.
* Report IT security incidents, system vulnerabilities and policy deviations, ensuring timely corrective actions.
* Promote awareness of information security best practices among regional users.


**Cross\-functional Stakeholder Support**
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR and other business functions to understand IT support requirements and ensure timely service delivery.
* Coordinate with Corporate IT teams for system upgrades, application deployments, infrastructure enhancements and enterprise\-wide IT initiatives.
* Provide IT support for new branch openings, relocations, office expansions and operational infrastructure changes.
* Assist business users during rollout of new applications, hardware and technology solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with stakeholders regarding incident status, planned maintenance and system availability.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring IT issues and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of new technologies, automation initiatives and digital solutions that improve business productivity.
* Recommend improvements to IT support processes, knowledge documentation and service delivery standards.
* Contribute to regional IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of customer service, collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Apprentice
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a dedicated and motivated individual to join our team as a Apprentice Technician in the IT industry. As an Apprentice Technician, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop skills in troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining computer hardware systems. This is an entry\-level position suitable for individuals with a passion for technology and a desire to kick\-start their career in the field.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with experienced technicians and be exposed to a wide range of computer hardware components and systems. You will provide support and assistance in diagnosing and resolving technical issues, as well as participate in the installation and configuration of computer hardware/Software.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Assist in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving hardware and software issues
* Perform routine maintenance and repairs on computer systems, including replacing faulty components
* Install, configure, and test computer hardware components and peripherals
* Assist in the monitoring and maintenance of network security systems.
* Troubleshoot network issues and perform necessary repairs or replacements.
* Assist in the installation of computer networks, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Provide technical support to end\-users in a timely and efficient manner
* Collaborate with team members to ensure the smooth operation of SITA systems
* Keep accurate records of repairs, maintenance tasks, and inventory
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in computer hardware technology and industry trends.


**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE:**
 No prior experience required. Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Education \& Qualifications**
* Diploma, Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field equivalent.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware components and systems
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of network hardware, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Should be flexible to work evenings or weekends as required.
* This role requires flexibility to work in rotating shifts, including night shifts.
* Ability to stay composed and perform effectively in high\-pressure environments.


 Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

* Must be able to adapt quickly to new processes, tools, and technologies.


  

  

* Having valid Indian passport will be an advantage.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
 **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** 
 and
 **Airport Council International** 
 \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like
 **Pluralsight** 
 for technology upskilling,
 **Harvard Business Publishing** 
 for people leadership,
 **Stanford** 
 for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
   

  

 🙌
 **Competitive Benefits:** 
 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Job Description**
**Job Title Change Management Specialist**
**Function: (Category for Job Posting)**
**Job Summary:**
 The Service Management (SM) Change Management Specialist role is responsible for monitoring the ongoing ‘wellnesses of Information Technology (IT) Change Management processes, procedures and policies. The role drives the analytical review of the relevant processes, scheduled reporting and other metrics to confirm that the end\-to\-end processes are operating in a Business as Usual (BAU) mode or to identify exceptions to same. The role leads discussions with Change Lead and /or business leaders on identified process exceptions and recommends potential solutions to rectify breaks in a specific process. The role requires a solid working knowledge of and certification in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework as part of the role’s core mandate to drive best practices in the alignment of business needs to IT capabilities. The role acts as thought leader in the use of the Service Management tool as trainer to the user population and are advanced users of its monitoring capabilities for IT’s processes. The role may have management responsibility for the Process Analysts who provide the process analytics and is generally guided by the Change Process Lead.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Designs, assesses and delivers the performance analysis of all day\-to\-day Change process under its remit to determine the stability of local, area, global IT applications and the effectiveness of their processes, procedures and policies. Examines Critical Success Factors (CSF), Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and other key metrics produced on a daily, weekly or monthly basis as a critical component of the analysis.
* Defines and coordinates senior level meetings inclusive of monthly services reviews and more frequent meetings to identify root cause of change failures with intent to improve production stability. Identifies change caused outages in co\-ordination with Incident Management and drives input into Continuous Service Improvement and/or Risk Registers.
* Engages with Incident, Problem, Release Management and consults in major outage discussions/meetings as a thought leader on current processes and adds valued insight across senior members of the organization on efforts to restore overall services.
* Actively participates and works with lead/ other stakeholders in design, build and maintenance of CMDB
* Assumes and drives responsibility for escalation actions, as needed, when it is observed that the appropriate IT process is not being adhered to.
* Organizes and leads appropriate post mortem activities with senior members of the organization on Change processes not executed appropriately and drives follow through on actions identified as a result.
* Drives adherence to NewCo build’s compliance standards of IT processes and procedures wherever applicable. Develops and directs practices to improve compliance mandates and/or identifies and implements improvements in process/procedures to support existing compliance directives.
* Leads and coordinates meetings with all levels of the organization directly or under guidance of Lead to review existing KPIs and other metrics aligned to a specific process to drive continued improvements and production stability and/or end user satisfaction. Identifies \& assesses risks, forecasts challenges and opportunities and provides related recommendations including the proposed creation of new KPIs and other modifications based on analysis.
* Engages with vendors for getting root cause and solution of the issues as required.
* Researches, recommends, develops, and implements updates and amendments to the Service Management tool to reflect identified enhancements or changes to process and procedures. Partners with the Quality Management and Automation team to develop and implement necessary modifications to the tool so that it reflects the latest services, procedures and activities.
* Designs and develops training materials, communiques and related documentation to inform and train IT users in the Change process and tool and to embed the process as part of the required business knowledge of the IT organization.
* Ascertains best practices in aligning business needs to an IT organization by maintaining a strong knowledge of industry standards in process management through formal certification and training in the ITIL framework and a knowledge of current and proposed future state of IT processes and procedures
* A good knowledge in dashboards and reporting
* Willingness to work on required automation initiatives and understanding of the same will be added advantage
* Should be willing to work during weekends and in rotational shifts


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires a strong analytical acumen and solution orientation to understand the nuances of Change Management process across cultures and geographic regions as well as within the IT organization. The role additionally requires consultative questioning and influence management skills as well as solid business knowledge of IT services and capabilities to identify the source of a service break and recommend viable solutions that will properly and efficiently resume service delivery.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* A comprehensive knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes in general and Change Management in particular with an eye to progressive levels of certification as required. Proven experience to leverage and interpret the ITIL process in enhancing current business process and procedures
* Solid advanced interpersonal skills to engage, as a thought leader, senior executives of the firm, in cross business discussions within a matrixed, geographically dispersed organization and to build a solid network of peers and others of influence. Uses these relationships to connect colleagues, challenge insightfully to improve processes and propose credible options
* Well defined consultative skills to conduct effective questioning , hone in on key issues to formulate ideas and materials as well as present those ideas clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization including senior and/or executive management
* Advanced oral, presentation and written communication skills in the English language. Exhibits the ability to adapt communication style to the style of others, developing rapport and staying calm under pressure and to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Has an active learning acumen about the application/infrastructure delivery and related operations organizations to engage team members in issues resolution with confidence and credibility
* Strong analytical and problem solving ability to escalate and negotiate complex and conflicting issues in IT technical investigations, handle multiple and shifting priorities across a broad spectrum of operating environments and to drive solutions that are both financially sound and operationally feasible.
* Excellent Microsoft Office experience, predominantly Excel, Visio and PowerPoint. Strong skills in knowledge sharing tools such as SharePoint
* Assists the Change Management Process Lead with resolving team conflicts, providing peer mentoring, and with the implementation \& communication of difficult decisions; is able to manage team or project by delegating work effectively and using appropriate resources
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and also during weekends


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 Contingent on location, the role can be an individual contributor or may manage Change Management Analysts. As manager, the role requires seasoned management skills inclusive of recommending staff for hire to SM / Change Management Lead, setting objectives aligned to those for the lead and SM as a whole, reviewing accomplishments, coaching for success and counselling for improvement. Assigned staff may be remote based and/or in a work from home setting that will require distance management skills across locations, cultures and time zones. The role itself is generally guided by the Change Management Lead
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
 The role may also require the periodic allocation of additional time on the job to support multiple demands and escalating issues.
   

  

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experience
   

  

**Experience:**
 Approximately 8 to 10 years of experience in an Operational/Service Management role with at least 3\-5 years in Change Management.
   

  

**Certification Requirements:**
 ITIL v2 or v3 Foundations training, or higher level of ITIL Certification as may be required

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 You will be responsible for leading mid\-size application managed services engagements, managing stakeholders and contractual obligations as the Service Manager.
   

  

 You will be responsible to execute sound Service management and transition plans by engaging with multidisciplinary teams, and by identifying, managing and mitigating risk
   

  

 You will be responsible to develop relationships across the business to understand requirements, applying business and technical acumen to solve business problems, with the vision to Grow, Sustain and Improve the through strong ITSM principles, process, automation, innovation and better ways of working.
   

  

 You will be responsible for Service onboarding, Service Transition, Service operations using ITSM leading practices for products, applications and services delivered at EY.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Accountable as the point of contact for the service delivery of the Application System
* Enable ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change) end\-to\-end
* Ensure service stability, availability, and reliability
* Drive proactive issue prevention \& risk mitigation
* Establish and maintain operational runbooks \& SOPs
* Manage and communicate with key stakeholders on a weekly and daily basis on the operational support of the Application System
* Monitor and ensure SLAs are met, issues escalated and prioritized
* Work with client 3rd party vendors to resolve issues related to the Application System
* Manage a team of Application Developers, Functional testers, Business Analyst, Technical Architects and Platform and DevOps Engineers to manage the Application System
* Execute Managed Services and Implement continuous improvements framework including but not limited to Application Management, Automated provisioning, CI/CD pipeline, etc.
* Work with Build teams to integrate new or enhanced product features for the Application System
* Provide relevant reporting and trend analysis statistics to pro\-actively support and improve the project and operation metrics
* Ensure there are cost controls enabled to avoid leakage
* Coach the team to drive for results applying problem solving skills, architectural thinking, continuous improvements through technology and process and communication efficiency


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 As the Service Manager with transition experience
   

  

* Strong ITSM process ownership (Incident, Problem, Change)
* Focus on service stability, availability, and SLA adherence
* Drive RCA and proactive issue prevention
* Emphasis on delivery excellence and service reliability
* Lead a motivated and skilled team of Business Analyst, Application Developers and Technical Architects
* Should be conversant with ITSM \& Service Management frameworks
* Execute service transition (knowledge transfer, readiness, stabilization) ensuring smooth shift to steady state
* Manage operational readiness, risks, and coordination across build, vendor, and support teams during transition
* Ability to multitask in fast\-paced environment
* Communication skills (written/oral)
* Willingness to travel


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Certification in ITIL 4 foundation and higher levels, or Lean\-Six Sigma certifications, or Prince2, or PMP from PMI
* Knowledgeable on Java, or .Net or SaaS products (Guidewire, Salesforce, SAP etc)
* Knowledgeable in cloud based products SAP, Azure/GCP/AWS cloud
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of delivery management and transition and practice development.
* Supervise financial management of engagements to deliver value to clients and to the firm.
* Adoption new outsourcing delivery models \& trends.
* Deliver outsourcing programmes, demonstrate expert consulting skills and advanced level of industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to lead outsourcing services assignments.
* People capability development and management for the practice.
* Should be willing to work in shifts and on\-call support.


**What We Look For**
* Demonstrated expertise in leading and growing mid\-scale Managed Services engagements
* Strong experience in stakeholder management, ability in liaisoning, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with multiple teams with use of complex technologies.
* Proven experience in IT Service Management principles, methods and practices
* Experience Service Designing, Service Transition and
* Confidently articulates Service Management principles and maintains an in\-depth knowledge
* A bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Engineering or similar discipline
* 10\-15 years of experience with minimum 3 years leading mid\-scale Managed Services projects
* Managed muti\-year SOW with contract value ranging from 1\-5 million USD per year
* Managed a reasonably sized team (20\-30 FTEs) across locations, in an onshore\-offshore model
* Experience working in multiple industries preferably Insurance/Financial services/Banking domains
* Executed Application engagements across or one of the technologies \- Java, .Net, Guidewire, Salesforce, SAP products on cloud.
* Should have executed Service Transitions, Service Design and has hands on experience in taking applications to Steady State in Mandatory for more than 3 clients.
* Hands\-on experience in driving services to steady state (3\+ clients)


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

description:
**Job Title:** ServiceDesk Coordinator (Helpdesk coordinator)

**Location:** Kochi

**Job Summary:**

The Service Desk Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day\-to\-day activities of the IT service desk or help desk team. They play a key role in ensuring that customer issues and technical support requests are addressed promptly and efficiently.

**Main Responsibilities:**

**Team Supervision:**

· Manage a team of service desk technicians or support staff.

· Provide guidance, coaching, and training to team members.

· Monitor team performance and ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).

**Ticket Management:**

· Receive, prioritize, and assign service requests and incidents to appropriate team members.

· Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all tickets.

· Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution and escalation as needed.

**Customer Support:**

· Act as the point of contact for customers and end\-users seeking technical assistance.

· Respond to customer inquiries and resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem\-solving.

**Process Improvement:**

· Identify opportunities to improve service desk processes and workflows.

· Implement best practices to enhance efficiency and customer service.

· Document and update standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Technical Knowledge:**

· Stay up\-to\-date with IT industry trends and technologies.

· Provide technical guidance and expertise to team members when needed.

· Assist with complex technical issues and escalations.

**Reporting and Metrics:**

· Generate reports on service desk performance, including ticket volumes, response times, and resolution rates.

· Analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

· Prepare regular reports for management.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

· Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers.

· Assist in procurement and asset management activities as necessary.

**Security and Compliance:**

· Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures.

· Assist in incident response and security\-related tasks as required.

**General Responsibilities:**

· Maintain and update configuration documents.

· Maintain assets and software licenses/subscriptions.

· Vendor coordination and support

**Qualification:**

· Graduate or above

· 1\+ years of total experience

· ManageEngine service desk application (Optional)

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Familiarity with the ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) framework is a plus.

**Skills:**

· Ticket registration via Phone and email

· Logging and categorization of tickets

· Assign the engineers.

· Prepare and submit monthly reports.

· Maintain SLAs and do timely escalations.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

· Ability to speak and write clearly and accurately in English.
