title: End User Support Engineer (L2/L3) - DWS
description:
Reference 26000HWH
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**End User Support Engineer (L2/L3\) \- Digital Workplace Services**
**Job Summary**
 The End User Support Engineer is responsible for managing, supporting, and maintaining end\-user computing infrastructure, workplace technologies, and associated services to ensure high availability, operational excellence, and exceptional user experience. The role provides Level 2 and Level 3 technical support, drives service improvements through automation and process optimization, manages printer services, coordinates with vendors, and ensures compliance with security, operational, and governance standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Profile required**
**End User Support \& Service Operations**
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for end\-user infrastructure, systems, applications, and workplace technologies.
* Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, authorized application software, and system management tools.
* Respond to incidents, service requests, and technical queries from users, service providers, site personnel, and external vendors.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, operating system, and infrastructure issues.
* Ensure timely issue resolution while meeting service level agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate with GTS teams, infrastructure teams, and external vendors for issue resolution and service improvements.
* Maintain operational stability and ensure minimal downtime across supported environments.
* Work experience in End point device management (including laptop, Mobile device) via Microsoft Intune portal.


**Infrastructure \& System Management**
* Participate in the planning, implementation, and support of IT infrastructure and operational support systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain systems to ensure maximum availability, performance, and reliability.
* Maintain security, backup, recovery, and redundancy strategies.
* Support endpoint management activities, including device deployment, software distribution, patch management, and compliance monitoring.
* Ensure all supported systems adhere to organizational security and compliance requirements.


**Printer Management \& Support**
* Manage and support enterprise printing services, including network printers, multifunction devices (MFDs), and print servers (HP, Canon).
* Install, configure, troubleshoot, maintain, and replace printers as required by coordinating with cross functional departments like Network (HCS) and EVS (End point team).
* Coordinate printer deployment, relocation, upgrade, and decommissioning activities.
* Troubleshoot print queues, printer drivers, connectivity issues, firmware updates, and print management applications.
* Monitor printer availability and service health to minimize business impact.
* Manage printer\-related incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.


**Vendor Coordination \& Governance**
* Act as the primary liaison between IT teams and external vendors for support services and issue resolution.
* Coordinate vendor activities for hardware replacement, break\-fix support, warranty claims, and technical escalations.
* Maintain vendor contacts, support documentation, service agreements, and escalation matrices.
* Conduct Monthly Vendor Review Meetings to discuss:
+ Open incidents and escalations
+ Service performance and SLA compliance
+ Printer service performance
+ Improvement opportunities
+ Risks and mitigation plans
+ Action item tracking and closure

* Monitor vendor performance and drive accountability against contractual obligations and service expectations.


**Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**
* Develop, document, and maintain support processes, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual effort.
* Create and implement automation scripts, self\-heal solutions, DIY initiatives, and process improvements.
* Drive operational excellence by ensuring compliance with SOPs, governance standards, and operational KPIs.
* Contribute innovative solutions that improve productivity, service quality, and customer experience.


**Project Support**
* Support infrastructure and workplace technology projects.
* Ensure assigned project tasks are completed within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to achieve project objectives successfully.


**Knowledge Management \& Team Development**
* Participate in learning and development activities covering technical, process, and behavioral competencies.
* Share knowledge and best practices with team members.
* Conduct at least two internal knowledge\-sharing sessions annually.
* Pursue relevant certifications aligned with organizational and technology requirements.


**Technical Skills Required**
**End User Computing**
* Windows 10/11 Administration
* Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
* Active Directory \& Azure Active Directory
* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager
* Software Deployment \& Packaging
* Device Imaging \& Provisioning
* Endpoint Security Solutions


**Infrastructure Support**
* Hardware Troubleshooting (Desktop, Laptop, Docking Stations, Mobile Devices)
* VPN and Remote Access Support
* Basic Networking (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi)
* Patch Management
* System Monitoring Tools
* ITSM Tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira, etc.)


**Printer \& Asset Management**
* Enterprise Printer Support
* Print Server Administration
* Multifunction Device (MFD) Support
* Asset Lifecycle Management
* Warranty and Vendor Management


**Automation \& Scripting**
* PowerShell (Preferred)
* Process Automation
* Self\-Heal Script Development


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong customer service orientation
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ownership and accountability
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to work under pressure and manage priorities effectively


**Education \& Experience**
**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
   

  

**Experience**
* 4 to 8\+ years of experience in End User Computing (EUC), Desktop Support, Digital Workplace Services, or IT Infrastructure Support.
* Experience managing enterprise end\-user environments, printer services, vendor coordination, and L2/L3 support operations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Microsoft Certified Endpoint Administrator Associate
* Microsoft 365 Administrator
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL Foundation
* CompTIA A\+ / Network\+


**Success Criteria**
 The successful candidate will deliver stable, secure, and scalable end\-user services, maintain operational excellence, proactively drive automation and innovation, effectively manage vendor relationships and printer services, and consistently provide a best\-in\-class user experience while ensuring compliance with organizational standards and business objectives.
   

  

**Why join us**
 “We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status”
   

  

**Business insight**
 At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious.
   

  

 Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating and taking action are part of our DNA.
   

  

 If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!
   

  

 Still hesitating?
   

  

 You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.

They are translated in our business activity (ESG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
 ZeroFox seeks a Sr. IT Specialist to support a growing multinational cybersecurity company. The successful candidate will work with the corporate IT team on daily operations and long\-term IT goals, covering in\-house support, global team assistance across India and other locations, and end\-to\-end employee onboarding and offboarding.
   

  

 Role and Responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to in\-house and remote IT requests from employees via walk\-in, email, and service tickets; document all interactions in the ITSM ticketing system.
* Support the India office and global teams, handling incidents and requests across time zones.
* Resolve employee issues through cross\-departmental collaboration; stay current on software and hardware updates.
* Work with employees and IT staff to gather requirements, assess impact on existing systems, and implement solutions.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and IT documentation.
* Procure, configure, and stage devices (laptops, peripherals, mobile) fully before a new hire's first day.
* Enroll devices via MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji) and provision accounts through IdP platforms (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) with appropriate SSO, MFA, and access rights.
* Coordinate with HR and department leads to complete onboarding tasks on schedule for local and global hires.
* Execute offboarding procedures — account deprovisioning, device retrieval or remote wipe, and license reclamation.
* Maintain an accurate catalog of hardware assets, software licenses, and user assignments.
* Administer MDM and IdP platforms for policy configuration, compliance, and user lifecycle management across global endpoints.
* Manage ITSM tools for incident tracking, change management, and asset management.
* Perform hardware installation, configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and repairs for computers, handheld devices, and peripherals.
* Work with the systems team to ensure applications are patched on time per security and compliance requirements.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* 3\+ years of IT support or similar experience.
* 1\+ years working with various hardware and software, including Apple laptops.
* Hands\-on experience with MDM platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune, or Kandji) for device enrollment, policy enforcement, and compliance.
* Proficiency with IdP solutions (Okta, Azure AD, or OneLogin) including SSO, MFA, and user lifecycle management.
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk or Freshservice) for ticketing, SLA tracking, and asset management.
* Proven ability to manage IT onboarding and offboarding end\-to\-end.
* Ability to support distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and multitasking skills.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Availability to work occasional evenings and weekends.


**Desired Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Prior experience supporting employees across India and global offices.


 Benefits
   

  

* Amazing Product: ZeroFOX has created a paradigm shifting cyber security product
* Awesome Culture: ZeroFOX is a community – most describe our team as a group of close knit, incredibly talented, and highly caffeinated people. All are encouraged and required to incorporate innovative ideas and prototypes into our product. Suggestions around streamlining communication, development practices and operations are welcomed
* Get Things Done: Innovation is woven into the fabric of our organization. Every aspect of our operations is purposeful; enabling us to research, develop and innovate faster than the competition
* Benefits: Competitive compensation and benefits package available

**Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation**

* Approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud support, infrastructure operations, platform support, or a related technical support role.

* Hands on experience on full\-stack observability platforms like Grafana (including but not limited to querying logs, metrics, traces, setting up dashboards \& alerts).

* Strong troubleshooting, communication, ownership, and collaboration skills. Willingness to work rotational shifts and provide weekend support when required.


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to AI, ML, data\-intensive workloads, or GPU\-enabled environments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts (including Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or Pulumi).
* Experience supporting enterprise, industrial, regulated, or mission\-critical environments.
* CKA certification will be an added advantage.


**Success Measure** 
 s
   

  

* Critical and complex support issues are resolved promptly, clearly, and efficiently.
* Customers experience minimal disruption, timely communication, and high service reliability.
* Customer satisfaction and response times show continuous improvement.
* Support knowledge, troubleshooting guides, and playbooks are structured for effective reuse.
* Recurring issues are identified, escalated, and reduced over time.


**Why join Falkor?**
 You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.
   

  

**At Falkor, You'll Have The Opportunity To**

 Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains
   

  

 Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation
   

  

 Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally
   

  

 Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries
   

  

 We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.
   

  

**About Falkor**
 Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy\-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle.
   

  

 By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance.
   

  

**Ready to apply?**

Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.
   

  

 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Helpdesk Engineer
description:
**Summary:** 
 This role involves providing hands\-on L1/L2 IT support to users, enhancing the existing Helpdesk team. The primary goal is to ensure efficient technical support while maintaining system security and operational excellence.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
* Provide first and second\-level technical support to end\-users, resolving hardware, software, and network\-related incidents and requests.
* Utilize ServiceNow as the primary ticketing system for incident and service request management, ensuring accurate and timely documentation, prioritization, and resolution.
* Administer and support mobile device management solutions, including AirWatch, for the deployment, configuration, and security of corporate mobile devices.
* Leverage Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) for software deployment, patch management, operating system deployment, and inventory management of end\-user devices.
* Assist in identifying and remediating security vulnerabilities on end\-user devices and associated infrastructure, adhering to established security policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and execute IT\-related aspects of office moves, new employee onboarding, and equipment changes, ensuring seamless transitions.
* Provide remote IT support and ensure the functionality of IT infrastructure in regional and satellite offices.
* Offer on\-site and remote IT support for company events, ensuring the reliable operation of AV equipment, network connectivity, and other IT resources.


**Key Requirements:**
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and endpoint management.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM/ticketing platform.
* Experience with asset and inventory management.
* Exposure to Windows migration, patch management, and vulnerability remediation.


**Nice to Have:**
* Experience with mobile device management solutions.
* Familiarity with IT compliance regulations.
* Knowledge of IT security best practices.


**Other Details:**
* Contract Duration: 6 Months
* Shift Timing: 6\.30 am to 3\.30 pm and 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday.
* Work Environment: Requires working from the office.

title: Senior Specialist
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That\`s why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimageable with us.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are seeking an IT Service Solution Expert with strong expertise in
 **SolidWorks PDM,** 
 working knowledge of
 **SolidWorks Manage PLM** 
 , and proficiency with
 **SolidWorks CAD, SQL Server/T\-SQL** 
 , and reporting tools. This role supports engineering data management, reporting, and IT Service Management processes (including incidents, requests, and changes).
   

  

 The role administers the
 **SolidWorks PDM and Manage** 
 environment, aligns engineering workflows with ITIL practices, and partners with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, manage data lifecycles, and resolve Tier 1\-2 support requests.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Platform Administration and Architecture**
* Implement, configure, and optimize SolidWorks PDM workflows, vaults, archive servers, data structures, and security controls.
* Configure SolidWorks Manage dashboards, processes, objects, and metadata mappings.
* Maintain integrations with SolidWorks environments and administer related Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Maintain and support the IIS web server.


**PLM Collaboration and Solution Delivery**
* Collaborate with SolidWorks Manage PLM IT partners to gather requirements and deliver scalable engineering data management solutions.
* Translate business needs into clear technical specifications for PDM and Manage enhancements.
* Lead requirements gathering sessions and document user stories, administrative tasks, and sprint activities in Jira.


**Reporting, Analytics, and Integration**
* Develop and optimize SQL Server and T\-SQL queries for reporting, data analysis, and process automation.
* Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using SolidWorks Manage reporting, SSRS, Power BI, or equivalent BI tools.
* Support data exchange pipelines between SolidWorks Manage and downstream ERP/MRP systems.


**ITSM Operations and Support**
* Manage IT Service Management activities for incidents, service requests, and changes within ServiceNow.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues related to PDM/Manage login, local cache, replication, onboarding, access provisioning, and template deployment.
* Track SLAs, document resolutions, manage incident lifecycles, and coordinate root cause analysis with preventive actions.
* Develop and maintain best\-practice standards, templates, and documentation (SOPs, work instructions, runbooks).


**Change Management, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement**
* Design and improve approval workflows, revision control, and lifecycle states across PDM and Manage.
* Coordinate Engineering Change Orders and Engineering Change Requests through ITIL\-aligned change workflows.
* Connect ServiceNow Change Management processes with engineering design changes to support compliance, data governance, and security standards.
* Collaborate with IT and partners on server upgrades, client software rollouts, and disaster recovery testing.
* Nice to Have
* Integrations via APIs (UPTIMIZE DTI, Customer Experience Product).
* PDM Backups for Disaster recovery.
* Active Directory for PDM Professional password authentication (Single Sign\-On)
* Upgrading Server Software Components and SMTP integration for PDM Professional notifications.


**Your Role**
* Strong experience with SQL Server queries and T\-SQL; ability to optimize queries.
* Working knowledge and specialization in SolidWorks PDM.
* Preferred knowledge in SolidWorks Manage PLM.
* General knowledge of SolidWorks CAD platforms.
* Experience delivering and supporting IIS Web Sites, logs, and servers; familiarity with log viewers, monitoring, and app pools.
* Proficiency in report and dashboard generation.
* Experience in IT Service Management (incident, request, change) with ServiceNow.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills; ability to work with cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SolidWorks PDM/PLM certifications or demonstrated project experience.
* Experience integrating PLM with ERP/CRM ecosystems.
* Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and security principles in manufacturing environments.
* ITIL certification or strong ITIL\-aligned process understanding.
* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience (including VAR backgrounds such as Trimech, Hawk Ridge, or GoEngineer).
* 2\-4 years of experience administering SolidWorks PDM Professional and SolidWorks Manage.
* Experience in a structured ITIL service desk or service operation environment.
* Certifications (highly desirable): SolidWorks CPAP, ITIL 4 Foundation or higher, and Jira for agile delivery.
* Foundational understanding of Windows Server environments and SQL database queries.
* Communication for Export/Import for ERP/SAP/MRP/Other DB systems.


 Skills \& Tools
   

  

* SolidWorks PDM
* SolidWorks Manage PLM (preferred)
* SolidWorks CAD platforms
* SQL Server, T\-SQL
* SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services)
* Power BI (or equivalent BI tools)
* ServiceNow ITSM (incidents, requests, changes)
* Data integration, data modeling, reporting
* Jira (requirements, user stories, sprint tracking)
* ITIL processes (Service Management, Change Management)
* API integrations (optional: UPTIMIZE DTI, Customer Experience Product)
* Cross\-functional collaboration, stakeholder management


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent
* 2\-4 years of relevant SolidWorks PDM/PLM experience \& total 6\-8 years of IT experience.
* Experience in ITIL\-aligned service operations


 Certifications (Highly Desirable)
   

  

* SolidWorks Certified PDM Administrator Professional (CPAP)
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
* Jira for Agile delivery


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

title: Customer Support Representative
description:
Analytical Wizards is part of the Definitive Healthcare family. We balance innovation with an open, friendly culture and the backing of a long\-established parent company, known for its ethical reputation. We guide customers from what’s now to what’s next by unlocking the value of their data and applications to solve their challenges, achieving outcomes that benefit both business and society. Our people are our biggest asset, they drive our innovation advantage and we strive to offer a flexible and collaborative workplace where they can thrive. We offer industry\-leading benefits packages to promote a creative and inclusive culture. If driving real change gives you a sense of pride and you are passionate about powering social good, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 Join us as a Customer Support Representative and be at the forefront of providing exceptional support to our valued clients. This role is not just about assistance; it's about becoming an integral part of a team that values your contributions and offers room for advancement.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 As a Customer Support Representative, you will work with the Customer Value Delivery organization to deliver rapid assistance to client inquiries. Your challenge goes beyond just providing support; it's about becoming the linchpin of exceptional customer experiences.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Login Assistance: Aid customers facing login issues, guiding them through the login process, and troubleshooting any problems they encounter.
* Password Resets: Help customers reset their passwords securely, ensuring their accounts remain protected and accessible.
* General Account Maintenance: Assist customers in managing their accounts, updating information, and resolving account\-related queries.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and diagnose software\-related issues, escalating complex problems to the appropriate teams for resolution.
* Customer Communication: Respond to customer inquiries via email, chat, and tickets promptly and professionally, ensuring a positive and empathetic interaction.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and resolutions in our CRM system.
* Knowledge Sharing: Continuously update your knowledge of our software and services to provide effective support and share insights with the team.
* Collaboration: Collaborate and communicate with the broader Support Team, Customer Experience Team, and Product Teams timely and efficiently.


**Qualification:**
* 1\-4 years of experience working in a professional environment, ideally directly within a customer support or custom facing function.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Empathetic and patient demeanor when dealing with customer inquiries.
* Basic technical knowledge and the ability to learn and adapt to new software quickly.
* Previous customer support experience is preferred, but not mandatory.
* A passion for helping people and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service
* Zendesk Experience preferred but not mandatory
* General understanding of US Healthcare System is preferred, not mandatory

title: Technical Services Engineer

Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
   

  

 As an ideal candidate, you will have
   

  

 We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self taught, curious, and multi\-faceted. Our ideal TSE candidate should also have

title: Senior Engineer, NICE CXone
description:
**Description**
 Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
   

  

 Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next\-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
   

  

 This role at Enphase requires working onsite 3 days a week, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join Enphase Energy as a Senior Engineer specializing in NICE CXone, where you will design, implement, and optimize modern contact center solutions. This role focuses on enhancing customer experience through dialer, IVR, and AI\-powered capabilities, while building scalable integrations with enterprise systems like Salesforce. You will play a key role in driving innovation, automation, and operational efficiency across inbound and outbound contact center environments.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Design, configure, and support NICE CXone Dialer campaigns (Predictive, Progressive, Preview, Agentless)
* Develop and enhance IVR workflows using NICE CXone Studio for self\-service and intelligent routing
* Manage skills, queues, and routing strategies to optimize contact center operations
* Build and maintain integrations with Salesforce and enterprise systems (APIs, CTI, workflows)
* Configure and support AI capabilities such as Agent Assist, Interaction Analytics, and intelligent routing
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability of contact center services
* Analyze KPIs and recommend automation and performance improvements to enhance CX and agent productivity


**Who You Are \& What You Bring**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in NICE CXone administration, Dialer, and IVR development
* Strong expertise in Salesforce integration, CTI, and API\-based integrations (REST/SOAP)
* Solid understanding of ACD, routing strategies, and contact center technologies
* Experience with AI\-driven CX capabilities (Copilot, analytics, virtual agents) is a plus
* Exposure to cloud contact center solutions, middleware (e.g., Boomi), and omnichannel platforms
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate with business and technical stakeholders

description:

 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

 What you will need
   

  

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Implementation and/or Customer Experience at a rapidly growing SaaS company.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 Effy (Rayles and Roobie Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a Chennai\-based custom software development company and Freshworks Premium System Integration Partner, building integrations, middleware/APIs, and marketplace apps for clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors. This role owns quality assurance across all client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps and also acts as the technical point of contact for support requests raised by clients, customers, and partners making this a hybrid QA and technical support/customer success role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Quality Assurance \- Integrations \& Marketplace Apps
* Design, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases for all client integrations (API\-led, point\-to\-point, cloud\-based, and event\-driven) across platforms such as Freshdesk, Freshservice, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, Freshmarketer, and third\-party systems (e.g., Shopify, Magento, ServiceNow, and Azure AD).
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing for all Freshworks marketplace apps prior to release and after every update.
* Validate data migrations and middleware/API connections for data accuracy, reliability, and basic security considerations.
* Log, track, and triage defects through resolution, working closely with developers and project managers.
* Contribute to building and maintaining automated test scripts and suites where applicable to improve coverage and release speed.
* Support release management by signing off on builds before deployment to production or the Freshworks Marketplace.
* Maintain test documentation, checklists, and QA metrics/reports for ongoing and completed projects.
* Technical Customer Success \& Support
* Serve as the first technical point of contact for support requests from clients, customers, and partners across all live integrations and marketplace apps.
* Triage, reproduce, and resolve reported issues; escalate complex or product\-level bugs to the relevant development team with clear reproduction steps.
* Track support tickets end\-to\-end, ensuring timely responses and resolutions in line with agreed SLAs.
* Communicate clearly with clients, customers, and partners, translating technical issues and fixes into plain\-language updates.
* Maintain and update internal knowledge bases, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides based on recurring issues.
* Identify patterns in support requests and feed them back into the QA process to prevent recurrence.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in software testing/QA, ideally including SaaS integrations or API testing.
* Solid understanding of manual and automated testing methodologies (functional, regression, integration, UAT).
* Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman and REST/SOAP testing tools.
* Working knowledge of issue\-tracking tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile/sprint\-based delivery.
* Basic understanding of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB for data validation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical clients.
* Customer\-facing experience or demonstrated comfort handling support tickets and client communication.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with close attention to detail.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior hands\-on experience with Freshworks products (Freshdesk, Freshservice, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, or Freshmarketer) as a user, tester, or support agent.
* Experience testing marketplace/plugin apps for any SaaS ecosystem (Freshworks, Salesforce, Zendesk, Shopify, etc.).
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Postman collections/Newman) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with middleware, webhooks, or event\-driven integration testing.
* Basic proficiency in JavaScript, Node.js, or Python.
* Prior experience in a customer success, technical support, or solutions engineering role.
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification.



  





 What We Offer
 


* The opportunity to own quality end\-to\-end across a live, growing portfolio of client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps.
* Direct exposure to enterprise clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors.
* A collaborative, culture\-first engineering environment centered on client success and continuous learning.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience.

description:
**Department:**

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced IT Support Specialist – Senior to lead high\-quality end\-user support, hardware troubleshooting, and application assistance across Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms. Beyond hands\-on resolution, this role owns AV operations governance, mentors junior support staff, drives process and automation improvements across the end user onsite support and service desk, and works closely with internal teams and vendors to ensure seamless, scalable IT service delivery and continuous improvement mindset.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
**End\-User \& IT Support:**
* Provide Level 2/3 support for laptops (hardware diagnostics, replacements, vendor coordination) and act as the escalation point for complex or repeat issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Windows, Linux (Ubuntu), and macOS, mentor junior technicians on advanced diagnostics.
* Managed imaging, OS deployment, software installation, driver updates, and post\-deployment validation.
* Coordinated with imaging, networking, and security teams to ensure smooth migration
* Support internal and SaaS\-based applications, including email, VPNs, printers, and network connectivity.
* Own and continuously improve IT ticketing workflows to track incidents and service requests, identifying recurring issues for permanent fixes.
* Build and maintain documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting playbooks; review and standardize documentation created by junior team members.
* Lead workstation visits for physical connectivity or issue diagnosis and act as senior point of contact for new hire setup (monitors and other asset installation).


**Gen AI \& Automation for End\-User Support and Service Desk Operations**
* Identify repetitive, high\-volume ticket categories (password resets, access requests, standard hardware issues) and design automation or self\-service workflows to reduce manual effort.
* Collaborated with automation teams supporting infrastructure automation initiatives
* Proven hands\-on experience in Automation on service improvements and volume reduction.
* Evaluate and pilot Gen AI\-powered tools (AI chatbots, virtual agents, knowledge\-based copilots) for L1/L2 query deflection and faster first\-response times.
* Use Gen AI tools to draft, summarize, and continuously refine SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks, and knowledge base articles from historical ticket data.
* Partner with IT Infrastructure and vendors to implement automated asset lifecycle workflows (auto\-provisioning, auto\-ticket routing, auto\-CMDB updates) to reduce manual tracking errors.
* Analyse ticket trends and service desk metrics using AI/analytics tools to proactively flag recurring problems and recommend root\-cause fixes.
* Automated routine administrative activities using PowerShell, Workflows and AI Tools


**IT Hardware Asset Lifecycle Management, Audits and Compliance**
* Own the full lifecycle of IT hardware assets from request, procurement, deployment, refresh, return, and disposal.
* Ensure all assets are accurately recorded and maintained in the CMDB/Asset Management System, drive data accuracy audits.
* Track ownership, location, warranty, lifecycle status, and asset tags.
* Drive inventory hygiene, OOW disposal, and laptop readiness tracking; manage spare inventory with 100% matching on procurement versus allocation.
* Lead periodic physical and system\-based asset audits and report on compliance gaps.
* Ensure PC refresh activities follow policy, and CMDB records remain accurate.


**Audio\-Visual (AV) Support**
* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot AV equipment for meetings and events, including complex or executive\-level setups, Tow\-Halls setup and Management.
* Support audio systems, microphones, and video conferencing solutions; troubleshoot escalations from junior AV support staff.
* Ensure flawless AV execution for in\-person and virtual events, including contingency planning for critical meetings.


**Collaboration \& Vendor Management**
* Work closely with IT Infrastructure, AV, Security, and Facilities teams on cross\-functional initiatives, representing the service desk in planning discussions.
* Coordinate with and manage third\-party vendors for warranty claims, service fulfilment, and SLA adherence.
* Ensure hardware call logs are placed on time with no impact to users; own BAU continuity for the support function.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (B.Sc., B.Tech.) or diploma in Computer Science, Electronics, AV, or related fields.
* 10–12 years of hands\-on IT support experience across multi\-OS environments, including experience mentoring or leading junior support staff.
* Proficient in troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and Linux (Mandatory Requirement).
* Experience in Windows, macOS, Office 365, Active Directory, and endpoint management tools (e.g., Intune, SCCM, JAMF).
* Experience of networking fundamentals and remote access technologies (VPN, VDI, etc.).
* Strong working knowledge of Active Directory, remote support tools, and endpoint security practices.
* Hands\-on experience implementing Gen AI or automation tools (chatbots, RPA, workflow automation) within an IT support or service desk environment.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; ability to guide and coach junior team members.
* 5 Days Work from Office in a Week (No work from home option).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Apple ACSP, ITIL Foundation/Intermediate is a plus.
* Experience supporting hybrid (remote \+ in\-office) workforce environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, asset management tools, and service desk automation/AI platforms (e.g., ServiceNow AI, Microsoft Copilot, chatbot tools).
* Hands on experience in PowerShell or Python

description:
**About Us:**
 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 We are looking for a talented and driven Implementation Engineer to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will design and implement integration solutions, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams to deliver tailored solutions for our enterprise clients. You will serve as the subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform components, working alongside customers, project managers, solution consultants, and teams across different geographies to deliver seamless automations, custom solutions, and integrations.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Two or more years of experience in Enterprise Content Professional Services.
* one or more years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and testing API integrations and solutions, with above average knowledge of RESTful APIs.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, Web Service Consumption, SOQL, and Salesforce Reporting.
* Expert knowledge of Excel Model, SSO, SMTP, SCIM and Salesforce Setup.
* Expert knowledge of LiveDoc \& LiveForm is preferred.
* Ability to lead projects with teams located in different geographies.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering efforts on large\-scale projects.
* Strong written and oral communication skills with a proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers at all levels.
* Self\-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrates strong self\-learning capabilities with the aptitude to quickly grasp new product features, technologies, and concepts.
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capability.
* Advanced proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
* Understanding of New Product Development Methodologies and Emerging Technologies (Mobile, Security, Internet, etc.).
* Strong facilitation, project management, and organisational skills.
* Strong relationship development and people management skills.
* Experience collaborating with and providing business recommendations to management.
* Comfortable writing and troubleshooting Python code snippets.
* Experience utilising AI tools and building agents to drive efficiency and quality improvement.
* Experience in the Business Requirements Creation Process for a technical product or similar experience.
* Experience with Seismic or another Sales Enablement platform is a plus.
* Experience in Product Management on a Technical Product is a plus.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Collaborate with business development, product management, and engineering teams to create and deploy integration solutions for complex client needs.
* Lead requirement gathering sessions with enterprise customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, and integration objectives.
* Serve as subject matter expert on Seismic’s platform capabilities, APIs, out\-of\-the\-box offerings, and custom integrations.
* Provide strategic and hands\-on technical guidance to clients throughout the evaluation, implementation, and post\-deployment phases.
* Communicate and present solutions effectively to client executives and technical teams.
* Serve as technical lead across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes in collaboration with cross\-functional teams across different geographies.
* Identify and mitigate risks in technical workstreams, escalating critical issues as needed.
* Develop creative, robust, scalable, and reusable strategies to support evolving business needs.
* Deliver ongoing support and services for existing customers in alignment with SLAs; manage customer escalations while seeking technical resolution.
* Conduct virtual and on\-site training sessions to enable customer success.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to advocate for customer\-driven enhancements and feature requests.
* Seek out new industry and technology trends and apply this knowledge to solve business problems.

description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

**The Role**
**Managed Services** 
 is provided to our R\&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
   

  

 Our
 **Managed Services Team** 
 comprises 90\+ consultants in Europe, of which 5\+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
   

  

 Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance consultants to join the Managed Services team and support our Vault Safety solution after implementation.
   

  

**As a Safety Consultant** 
 , you will support a group of biopharmaceutical customers assigned to you. Your task will be to understand their business processes, provide guidance, discuss Vault changes, and apply all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer’s requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
   

  

**To thrive in this role** 
 , you are able to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. You enjoy working in fast paced environments, are a team player and fast learner .
   

  

 This is a remote, full\-time role with Veeva with occasional travel to the Veeva Hyderabad site.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Help to keep up to date and implement new features within the Veeva Safety suite
* Work closely with customer business and IT staff to understand their requirements
* Think critically to help design the solution your customers request as well as the solution they have not requested but may need
* Act as customer liaison, managing communication between implementation and maintenance teams, customer stakeholders, and internal Veeva Product teams
* Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post\-implementation programs focused on the holistic success of the customer
* Drive change management methodology for our customers switching from on\-premises to SaaS solutions


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations
* Must have a decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any home\-grown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in the previous employments
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements, create corresponding solution designs, and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design and deliver Vault Safety
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements
* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success


****Nice to Have****
* Proven track record supporting high impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business, or IT lead, and/or business sponsor
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in services delivery management and/or systems implementation
* Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health Insurance fully covered for family, including Employee’s parents

 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

****This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role with a required work\-from\-office presence five days a week.****
**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (100% Onsite)
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a proactive Datacenter Operations Engineer with a strong background in operating systems, command\-line management, and mobile/tablet infrastructure. In this role, you will support our Navi Mumbai datacenter and test lab infrastructure, with a primary focus on maintaining Linux, macOS, and mobile device fleets (Android \& iOS) deployed in the environment.
   

  

 Unlike traditional datacenter roles centered on server component replacement, this position heavily emphasizes OS\-level troubleshooting, device provisioning, command\-line operations, network connectivity, and mobile endpoint lifecycle management. You will work onsite in Navi Mumbai while collaborating closely with global engineering teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Linux, macOS \& Mobile Infrastructure Management
* Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain local Linux and macOS endpoints, server environments, and test rigs using command\-line interface (CLI) utilities.
* Manage, provision, and troubleshoot onsite mobile hardware fleets (Android smartphones, tablets, iPads, and iOS test platforms).
* Perform device onboarding, OS flashing/updates, configuration resets, and script\-driven automated deployments across mobile and desktop platforms.
* Diagnose OS\-level connectivity, permission, software installation, and performance issues on mobile devices and workstations.
* Datacenter Operations \& Networking
* Manage physical rack infrastructure, including cabling (copper/fiber), Wi\-Fi Access Points (APs), and Power Distribution Units (PDUs).
* Perform daily environment inspections, monitoring rack temperatures, power draw, Wi\-Fi signal/AP status, and physical port links.
* Maintain structured inventory and tracking for all endpoint hardware, mobile devices, tablets, test bench rigs, and networking gear using asset tagging systems.
* Incident Management \& Documentation
* Track, manage, and resolve Level 2 technical support tickets end\-to\-end within Jira, ensuring compliance with operational SLAs.
* Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), system build guides, and infrastructure workflows in Confluence.
* Collaborate with global, cross\-functional engineering teams to escalate platform\-level software/network issues and implement fixes.
* Secondary / As\-Needed Hardware Support
* Provide occasional, low\-frequency assistance with standard rack\-mount hardware rack/stack and basic cabling (heavy server component break\-fix is minimal for this role).
* Escort and supervise external vendors for third\-party facility, ISP, or hardware maintenance.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Core Requirements
* Communication: Business\-level fluency in spoken and written English, with the ability to clearly articulate technical issues, write concise Jira updates, and collaborate seamlessly with global remote teams.
* Experience: 2–4 years in IT operations, systems administration, or specialized datacenter/lab support roles.
* Operating Systems \& CLI: Strong hands\-on proficiency with Linux (Ubuntu/RHEL/Debian) and macOS, with proven ability to navigate systems, troubleshoot issues, and execute tasks efficiently via Command Line Interface (CLI).
* Mobile Hardware \& Management: Demonstrable experience managing and troubleshooting Android and iOS mobile devices/tablets at scale in an enterprise, testing, or lab setting.
* Networking Basics: Solid understanding of IP networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi AP placement/troubleshooting, switching, and physical connectivity.
* Tools \& Process: Direct operational experience using Jira for ticket lifecycle tracking and Confluence for technical documentation.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical troubleshooting skills with a proactive approach to resolving OS and infrastructure issues.
* Preferred / "Nice\-to\-Have" Skills
* Hands\-on scripting experience in Bash, Python, or configuration automation toolsets (e.g., Ansible) for device/system tasks.
* Experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) software (e.g., Jamf, Workspace ONE, Intune).
* Familiarity with enterprise productivity suites like Google Workspace.


**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**
* 100% Onsite: Requires daily on\-premise presence at the Navi Mumbai facility.
* Physical Ability: Comfortable working with rack\-mounted equipment, mobile testing racks, and routine physical cable routing.


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required

title: Application Platform & Operations IT Analyst
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You And This Role**
 Designs, develops, and supports solutions and processes to meet business needs and requirements. Works in a business process, enabling, or implementation team, and applies general knowledge of Information Systems, which is typically developed through formal education.
   

  

 In this role, you will require conceptual knowledge of theories, practices, and procedures as well as having general business knowledge developed through education or prior experience related to your discipline and functional area. You will need to have the ability to exchange straightforward information with others and ask questions to check for understanding.
   

  

 It is your responsibility to use established procedures and practice to analyze and resolve standard problems. You will be accountable for assigned contributions with no direct supervisory responsibilities. Your performance impacts your own work with limited impact on your team. You will need to use established procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Gathers and analyzes business requirements for assigned functional and technical areas
* Works closely with business process teams, technical teams and other stakeholders to design and build objects which meet requirements
* Documents detailed designs
* Builds, tests and implements application objects
* Assists with issue resolution
* Helps ensure that functional and technical designs meet business requirements, conform to Dow architecture standards, and optimize productivity and long\-term product/system vision.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in IT discipline preferred and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.


**Required Skills**
* On premise and cloud deployment/upgrade experience
* Good expertise within DevSecOps practices
* Hands\-on experience with DevSecOps toolset is a plus
* Azure DevOps / GitHub
* AKS / Containers
* Strong working experience in a cloud environment (Azure)
* Visual Studio and Git
* CI/CD pipeline experience is a plus
* Automation and scripting skills like PowerShell, Azure CLI, and IaC templates
* Linux administration experience is a plus
* Software lifecycle management experience
* Good communication, troubleshooting, documentation, and time\-management skills


**Preferred Skills**
* Development skills – development lifecycle, tools, and patterns; prior development background is a plus
* Knowledge with C\#, Python, \& scripting
* Secure coding knowledge is a plus (vulnerability management)
* Networking skills / knowledge – firewall rules, etc.
* AI skills – building and using agents, MCP
* Continuous learning to stay on top of industry best practices and trends


**Additional Notes**
* No relocation support is provided on the role.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).

* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.

description:
